```ts
// A scripted hub for runner tests: a Bun.serve WebSocket at /api/runner/ws that speaks the runner protocol. It checks
// the bearer token before the upgrade, validates every runner message with core's schemas (and every event with
// parseRunnerEvent), keeps acknowledged positions per outbox epoch as the hub does, and by default welcomes each
// hello, acknowledges each events message and answers each heartbeat. Tests script the rest through the connections.
import {
  type HubMessage,
  HubMessageSchema,
  parseRunnerEvent,
  type RawRunnerEvent,
  type RunnerCommand,
  type RunnerMessage,
  RunnerMessageSchema,
} from '@agflow/core';
import type { ServerWebSocket } from 'bun';

export type WelcomeMessage = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'welcome' }>;
export type HelloMessage = Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'hello' }>;
export type ResultMessage = Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'result' }>;

/** Fields over the default welcome, or false for no welcome. */
export type WelcomeFields = Partial<WelcomeMessage> | false;

export interface FakeHubOptions {
  /** The CLI token the hub accepts; any other bearer gets 401 before the upgrade. Unset: every bearer. */
  token?: string;
  /**
   * How a hello is answered: a welcome made of these fields over the defaults, or nothing (false), in which case
   * the test sends the welcome itself. A function decides per connection.
   */
  welcome?: WelcomeFields | ((hello: HelloMessage, connection: FakeConnection) => WelcomeFields);
  /** Acknowledge each events message cumulatively; true by default. */
  autoAck?: boolean;
  /** Answer each heartbeat with heartbeat_ack; true by default. */
  heartbeatAck?: boolean;
}

export interface FakeConnection {
  /** 0 for the first connection, then 1, 2 and so on. */
  index: number;
  authorization: string | null;
  /** The valid messages this connection sent, in order. */
  messages: RunnerMessage[];
  /** The close code and reason the hub saw (1006 for a terminated socket), or null while open. */
  closed: { code: number; reason: string } | null;
  send(message: HubMessage): void;
  /** Sends text as it is, valid or not. */
  sendRaw(text: string): void;
  close(code?: number, reason?: string): void;
  terminate(): void;
}

export interface FakeHub {
  /** The hub's http URL; the runner derives ws://.../api/runner/ws from it. */
  url: string;
  connections: FakeConnection[];
  /** Every message that failed core's schemas, with the reason. Tests expect it to stay empty. */
  invalid: { text: string; error: string }[];
  /** Every valid message of every connection, in arrival order. */
  messages(): RunnerMessage[];
  /** Every event of every events message, in arrival order (replays included). */
  events(): RawRunnerEvent[];
  /** The results received, by command id. */
  results: Map<string, ResultMessage>;
  /** The hub's acknowledged position for an outbox epoch. */
  ackedSeq(outboxEpoch: string): number;
  /** Sends a command on the newest connection with the next id; gives the id. */
  command(command: RunnerCommand): string;
  /** Resolves with the check's first truthy value; rejects after timeoutMs. */
  waitFor<T>(check: () => T | null | undefined | false, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<T>;
  /** Resolves with connection number index once it is open. */
  connection(index: number, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<FakeConnection>;
  stop(): void;
}

const HUB_EPOCH = 1;
const RUNNER_ID = 'R-1';

/** A schema-valid welcome with the fake hub's defaults, for tests that send one by hand. */
export function testWelcome(ackedSeq: number, fields: Partial<WelcomeMessage> = {}): WelcomeMessage {
  return { ...defaultWelcome(ackedSeq), ...fields };
}

function defaultWelcome(ackedSeq: number): WelcomeMessage {
  return {
    t: 'welcome',
    runnerId: RUNNER_ID,
    hubEpoch: HUB_EPOCH,
    hubTime: Date.now(),
    ackedSeq,
    wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow/',
    stop: [],
    timings: { heartbeatMs: 15_000, deadLinkMs: 45_000, handoffMs: 180_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 },
  };
}

interface SocketData {
  connection: FakeConnection;
}

export function startFakeHub(options: FakeHubOptions = {}): FakeHub {
  const connections: FakeConnection[] = [];
  const invalid: { text: string; error: string }[] = [];
  const all: RunnerMessage[] = [];
  const events: RawRunnerEvent[] = [];
  const results = new Map<string, ResultMessage>();
  const acked = new Map<string, number>();
  let commandSeq = 0;

  const welcomeFor = (hello: HelloMessage, connection: FakeConnection): WelcomeMessage | null => {
    // Design 6.3: acked_seq = max(acked_seq, firstSeq - 1), kept per outbox epoch.
    const position = Math.max(acked.get(hello.outboxEpoch) ?? 0, hello.firstSeq - 1);
    acked.set(hello.outboxEpoch, position);
    const fields = typeof options.welcome === 'function' ? options.welcome(hello, connection) : options.welcome;
    if (fields === false) return null;
    return { ...defaultWelcome(position), ...fields };
  };

  const receive = (ws: ServerWebSocket<SocketData>, text: string) => {
    const { connection } = ws.data;
    let json: unknown;
    try {
      json = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      invalid.push({ text, error: 'not JSON' });
      return;
    }
    const parsed = RunnerMessageSchema.safeParse(json);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      invalid.push({ text, error: parsed.error.message });
      return;
    }
    const message = parsed.data;
    connection.messages.push(message);
    all.push(message);
    switch (message.t) {
      case 'hello': {
        const welcome = welcomeFor(message, connection);
        if (welcome) connection.send(welcome);
        return;
      }
      case 'heartbeat':
        if (options.heartbeatAck === false) return;
        connection.send({ t: 'heartbeat_ack', at: message.at, hubTime: Date.now() });
        return;
      case 'events': {
        for (const event of message.events) {
          const check = parseRunnerEvent(event);
          if (!check.ok) invalid.push({ text: JSON.stringify(event), error: check.error });
          events.push(event);
        }
        const last = message.events.at(-1);
        if (last && options.autoAck !== false) {
          const position = Math.max(acked.get(message.outboxEpoch) ?? 0, last.seq);
          acked.set(message.outboxEpoch, position);
          connection.send({ t: 'ack', outboxEpoch: message.outboxEpoch, seq: position });
        }
        return;
      }
      case 'result':
        results.set(message.commandId, message);
        return;
    }
  };

  const server = Bun.serve<SocketData>({
    hostname: '127.0.0.1',
    port: 0,
    fetch(request, srv) {
      if (new URL(request.url).pathname !== '/api/runner/ws') return new Response('not found', { status: 404 });
      const authorization = request.headers.get('authorization');
      if (options.token !== undefined && authorization !== `Bearer ${options.token}`) {
        return Response.json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
      }
      const connection: FakeConnection = {
        index: connections.length,
        authorization,
        messages: [],
        closed: null,
        send: () => {
          throw new Error('the connection is not open yet');
        },
        sendRaw: () => {
          throw new Error('the connection is not open yet');
        },
        close: () => {},
        terminate: () => {},
      };
      if (srv.upgrade(request, { data: { connection } })) return undefined;
      return new Response('upgrade failed', { status: 400 });
    },
    websocket: {
      open(ws) {
        const { connection } = ws.data;
        connection.sendRaw = (text) => {
          if (connection.closed === null) ws.send(text);
        };
        connection.send = (message) => {
          // A test that scripts an invalid hub message means to, and uses sendRaw.
          connection.sendRaw(JSON.stringify(HubMessageSchema.parse(message)));
        };
        connection.close = (code = 1000, reason = '') => ws.close(code, reason);
        connection.terminate = () => ws.terminate();
        connections.push(connection);
      },
      message(ws, data) {
        receive(ws, typeof data === 'string' ? data : new TextDecoder().decode(data));
      },
      close(ws, code, reason) {
        ws.data.connection.closed = { code, reason };
      },
    },
  });

  const waitFor = async <T>(check: () => T | null | undefined | false, timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<T> => {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const value = check();
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== false) return value;
      if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`the fake hub waited ${timeoutMs} ms in vain`);
      await Bun.sleep(5);
    }
  };

  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}`,
    connections,
    invalid,
    results,
    messages: () => [...all],
    events: () => [...events],
    ackedSeq: (outboxEpoch) => acked.get(outboxEpoch) ?? 0,
    command(command) {
      const connection = connections.at(-1);
      if (!connection) throw new Error('no runner is connected');
      commandSeq += 1;
      const id = `${HUB_EPOCH}-${RUNNER_ID}-${commandSeq}`;
      connection.send({ t: 'command', id, seq: commandSeq, command });
      return id;
    },
    waitFor,
    connection: (index, timeoutMs) => waitFor(() => connections[index], timeoutMs),
    stop: () => server.stop(true),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

  type Credentials,
  PROTOCOL_VERSION,

} from '@agflow/core';
import { AwakeClock, type ClockSource, systemClock } from '../src/clock';
import { DEFAULT_TIMINGS } from '../src/config';

import type { CommandResult } from '../src/journal';
import {
  type CommandMessage,
  hubWebSocketUrl,
  LinkClient,
  type LinkOptions,
  type LinkState,
  MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES,
  sameHubUrl,
} from '../src/link';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';
import { Outbox } from '../src/outbox';
import { type FakeHub, type FakeHubOptions, startFakeHub, testWelcome } from './fake-hub';

// Each test serves a hub over real sockets, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

const cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
});

const TOKEN = 'cli_secret_token';
const fence = { epoch: 1, counter: 3 };

const facts: AttemptFacts = {
  attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
  fence,
  phase: 'turn',
  eventAgeMs: 120,
  tool: null,
  fsAgeMs: null,
  commitAgeMs: null,
  turns: 2,
  turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
  repeatedCalls: 0,
  continuations: 0,
  vendorErrorMs: 0,
  activeMs: 4_000,
  contextUsed: null,
};

/** Wall time the test can move forward, so the awake clock sees a sleep; timers stay real. */
class ShiftedClock implements ClockSource {
  offset = 0;
  now = (): number => Date.now() + this.offset;
  setTimeout = systemClock.setTimeout;
  clearTimeout = systemClock.clearTimeout;
  setInterval = systemClock.setInterval;
  clearInterval = systemClock.clearInterval;
}

function note(summary: string) {
  return { type: 'attempt.activity', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence, data: { kind: 'note', summary } } as const;
}

type Overrides = Omit<Partial<LinkOptions>, 'timings'> & {
  timings?: Partial<LinkOptions['timings']>;
  /** Runs on the outbox before the link starts. */
  before?: (outbox: Outbox) => void;
};

interface Setup {
  hub: FakeHub;
  link: LinkClient;
  outbox: Outbox;
  db: RunnerDb;
  wall: ShiftedClock;
  clock: AwakeClock;
  logger: ReturnType<typeof memoryLogger>;
  commands: CommandMessage[];
}

function setup(
  hubOptions: FakeHubOptions = {},
  overrides: Overrides = {},
): Setup {
  const hub = startFakeHub({ token: TOKEN, ...hubOptions });
  cleanups.push(() => hub.stop());
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-link-'));
  const db = openRunnerDb(join(dir, 'runner.db'));
  cleanups.push(() => {
    db.close();
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });
  const outbox = new Outbox(db);
  overrides.before?.(outbox);
  const wall = new ShiftedClock();
  const clock = new AwakeClock({ source: wall, gapMs: 5_000 });
  const logger = memoryLogger();
  const commands: CommandMessage[] = [];
  const credentials: Credentials = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
  const { timings, before: _before, ...rest } = overrides;
  const link = new LinkClient({
    credentials: () => credentials,
    hubUrl: hub.url,
    outbox,
    clock,
    logger,
    random: () => 0,
    timings: {
      heartbeat: 10_000,
      deadLink: 10_000,
      handshake: 10_000,
      backoffBase: 10,
      backoffCap: 50,
      ...timings,
    },
    hello: () => ({
      t: 'hello',
      protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      runnerKey: 'rk_test',
      machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
      name: 'laptop',
      agflowVersion: AGFLOW_VERSION,
      platform: 'darwin-arm64',
      settings: { capacity: 2, keepAwake: 'ac', draining: false, ceilings: {}, allowPaidUsage: {}, version: 1 },
      vendors: [],
      quota: [],
      profile: { name: 'standard', weakened: [], dependencyPrep: false },
      git: { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: null },
      state: 'ok',
      stateDetail: null,
      outboxEpoch: outbox.epoch,
      firstSeq: outbox.firstSeq(),
      lastSeq: outbox.lastSeq(),
      lastHubEpoch: null,
      attempts: [],
    }),
    heartbeat: () => ({ attempts: [facts], power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
    handlers: {
      onCommand: async (command) => {
        commands.push(command);
        return { ok: true, data: { kind: command.command.kind } };
      },
    },
    ...rest,
  });
  cleanups.push(() => link.close());
  link.start();
  return { hub, link, outbox, db, wall, clock, logger, commands };
}

const seqs = (events: { seq: number }[]) => events.map((event) => event.seq);
const eventsMessages = (setupHub: FakeHub, index: number) =>

    expect(sameHubUrl('https://example.com/a', 'https://example.com/b')).toBe(false);
    expect(sameHubUrl('not a url', 'not a url')).toBe(false);

    expect(hubWebSocketUrl('http://127.0.0.1:7000')).toBe('ws://127.0.0.1:7000/api/runner/ws');
    expect(hubWebSocketUrl('https://hub.example.com/')).toBe('wss://hub.example.com/api/runner/ws');
    expect(hubWebSocketUrl('https://example.com/agflow/')).toBe('wss://example.com/agflow/api/runner/ws');
    expect(() => hubWebSocketUrl('ftp://example.com')).toThrow(/http/);

    );
    const connection = await hub.connection(0);
    db.sqlite.run("CREATE TRIGGER fail_ack BEFORE UPDATE ON outbox_ack BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ack disk full'); END");
    connection.send(testWelcome(0));
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 1);
    connection.send({ t: 'ack', outboxEpoch: outbox.epoch, seq: 1 });
    await hub.waitFor(() => logger.entries.filter((entry) => entry.fields?.error === 'ack disk full').length === 2);
    expect(link.state).toBe('online');
    expect(outbox.ackedSeq()).toBe(0);
    db.sqlite.run('DROP TRIGGER fail_ack');
    connection.send({ t: 'ack', outboxEpoch: outbox.epoch, seq: 1 });
    expect(await outbox.waitAcked(1, 2_000)).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a throwing welcome handler is logged and the outbox still replays', async () => {
    const { hub, link, logger } = setup({}, {
      before: (box) => box.append(note('replay me')),
      handlers: {
        onCommand: async () => ({ ok: true }),
        onWelcome: () => { throw new Error('welcome handler failed'); },
      },
    });
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 1);
    expect(link.state).toBe('online');
    expect(logger.entries.some((entry) => entry.fields?.error === 'welcome handler failed')).toBe(true);
  });

  test('sends heartbeats every welcome heartbeatMs with the facts; heartbeat_ack keeps the link alive', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 30, deadLinkMs: 200, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 1_000 };
    const { hub, link } = setup({ welcome: { timings } }, { timings: { heartbeat: 60_000, deadLink: 60_000 } });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(link.timings).toEqual({ heartbeatMs: 30, deadLinkMs: 200 });
    await Bun.sleep(500);
    const heartbeats = hub.connections[0]?.messages.filter((message) => message.t === 'heartbeat') ?? [];
    expect(heartbeats.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
    expect(heartbeats[0]).toMatchObject({ attempts: [facts], power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null });
    // Only heartbeat_acks came in for longer than deadLinkMs, and the link stayed up.
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(link.state).toBe('online');
    expect(hub.invalid).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('terminates a link silent for deadLink and reconnects with backoff', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 30, deadLinkMs: 120, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 1_000 };
    const states: string[] = [];
    const { hub } = setup(
      { heartbeatAck: false, welcome: { timings } },
      { handlers: { onCommand: async () => ({ ok: true }), onState: (state) => states.push(state) } },
    );
    const first = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.closed);
    // terminate(), not close(): the hub sees an abnormal closure, not a close frame.
    expect(first.closed?.code).toBe(1006);
    const second = await hub.connection(1);
    expect(second.authorization).toBe(`Bearer ${TOKEN}`);
    expect(states.slice(0, 4)).toEqual(['connecting', 'online', 'backoff', 'connecting']);
  });

  test('reconnect delays grow by backoff while the link stays up less than 60 s', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 30, deadLinkMs: 120, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 1_000 };
    const states: { state: LinkState; at: number; detail: { code: number | null; reason: string } }[] = [];
    const { hub } = setup(
      { heartbeatAck: false, welcome: { timings } },
      {
        random: () => 1,
        timings: { backoffBase: 100, backoffCap: 1_000 },
        handlers: {
          onCommand: async () => ({ ok: true }),
          onState: (state, detail) => states.push({ state, at: performance.now(), detail }),
        },
      },
    );
    await hub.connection(2, 5_000);
    const backoffs = states.filter((entry) => entry.state === 'backoff');
    const reconnects = states.filter((entry, index) => entry.state === 'connecting' && index > 0);
    expect(backoffs[0]?.detail).toEqual({ code: 1006, reason: 'dead link' });
    // random () => 1 takes the whole ceiling: base, then twice base, since the link was up for less than 60 s.
    expect((reconnects[0]?.at as number) - (backoffs[0]?.at as number)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(90);
    expect((reconnects[1]?.at as number) - (backoffs[1]?.at as number)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(180);
  });

  test('a handshake without welcome within the handshake timeout reconnects', async () => {
    const { hub, link } = setup({ welcome: false }, { timings: { handshake: 100 } });
    const first = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.closed);
    expect(first.closed?.code).toBe(1006);
    expect(first.messages.map((message) => message.t)).toEqual(['hello']);
    const second = await hub.connection(1);
    await hub.waitFor(() => second.messages.length > 0);
    expect(second.messages[0]?.t).toBe('hello');
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a clock gap reconnects at once and replays; welcomeSinceGap and lastAckAt follow the hub', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 40, deadLinkMs: 5_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 1_000 };
    const { hub, link, clock, wall, outbox } = setup(
      { autoAck: false, welcome: { timings } },
      {
        // A backoff would take seconds; the reconnect after a gap must not wait for it.
        random: () => 1,
        timings: { backoffBase: 5_000, backoffCap: 5_000 },
        before: (box) => box.append(note('one')),
      },
    );
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(false);
    expect(link.lastAckAt).toBeNull();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(true);
    const atWelcome = link.lastAckAt as number;
    expect(atWelcome).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => (link.lastAckAt as number) > atWelcome);
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 1);
    wall.offset += 60_000;
    clock.awakeNow();
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(false);
    const started = Date.now();
    const second = await hub.connection(1, 2_000);
    expect(Date.now() - started).toBeLessThan(1_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.welcomeSinceGap);
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 2);
    expect(seqs(hub.events())).toEqual([1, 1]);
    expect(second.messages[0]?.t).toBe('hello');
    expect(outbox.ackedSeq()).toBe(0);
    expect((await hub.connection(0)).closed?.code).toBe(1006);
  });

  test('a gap first seen by the close of the dropped socket reconnects at once, not after a backoff', async () => {
    const { hub, link, wall } = setup({}, { random: () => 1, timings: { backoffBase: 5_000, backoffCap: 5_000 } });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    wall.offset += 60_000;
    const started = Date.now();
    (await hub.connection(0)).terminate();
    await hub.connection(1, 2_000);
    expect(Date.now() - started).toBeLessThan(2_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online' && link.welcomeSinceGap);
  });

  test('a gap first seen by a welcome drops that welcome and connects again', async () => {
    const { hub, link, wall } = setup(
      { welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? false : {}) },
      { random: () => 1, timings: { backoffBase: 5_000, backoffCap: 5_000 } },
    );
    const first = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.messages.length > 0);
    wall.offset += 60_000;
    first.send(testWelcome(0));
    const second = await hub.connection(1, 2_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online' && link.welcomeSinceGap);
    expect(second.messages[0]?.t).toBe('hello');
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.closed);
    expect(first.closed?.code).toBe(1006);
  });

  test('welcomeSinceGap reads the clock, so a gap nothing noticed yet already clears it', async () => {
    const { hub, link, wall } = setup({}, { random: () => 1, timings: { backoffBase: 5_000, backoffCap: 5_000 } });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(true);
    wall.offset += 20 * 60_000;
    expect(link.welcomeSinceGap).toBe(false);
    await hub.connection(1, 2_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.welcomeSinceGap);
  });

  test('stays with its hub: credentials for another hub open no socket until they name this hub again', async () => {
    const other = startFakeHub({ token: 'other_token' });
    cleanups.push(() => other.stop());
    // Signed out until the hub exists; the link backs off meanwhile.
    const credentials: { current: Credentials | null } = { current: null };
    const { hub, link, logger } = setup({}, { credentials: () => credentials.current });
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: `${hub.url}/`, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    const before = hub.connections.length;
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: other.url, token: 'other_token', user: 'alice' };
    hub.connections[before - 1]?.terminate();
    await hub.waitFor(() => logger.entries.some((entry) => /signed in to/.test(entry.message)));
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(other.connections).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(before);
    expect(link.state).toBe('backoff');
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    await hub.connection(before, 2_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
  });

  test('replays a long outbox in batches of 100 and counts welcome.ackedSeq as an ack', async () => {
    const { hub, link, outbox } = setup(
      { autoAck: false, welcome: { ackedSeq: 7 } },
      {
        before: (box) => {
          for (let index = 1; index <= 250; index += 1) box.append(note(`event ${index}`));
        },
      },
    );
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(outbox.ackedSeq()).toBe(7);
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 243);
    expect(seqs(hub.events())).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 243 }, (_, index) => index + 8));
    expect(eventsMessages(hub, 0).map((message) => message.events.length)).toEqual([100, 100, 43]);
  });

  test('leaves out of the replay the events resent names, as if sent, so the ack of a later one covers them', async () => {
    const welcomes = [{ ackedSeq: 1 }, { ackedSeq: 3 }];
    const { hub, outbox } = setup(
      { welcome: (_hello, connection) => welcomes[connection.index] ?? {} },
      {
        before: (box) => ['one', 'two', 'three', 'four'].forEach((summary) => box.append(note(summary))),
        resent: (event) => event.seq === 2 || event.seq === 4,
      },
    );
    expect(await outbox.waitAcked(3, 2_000)).toBe(true);
    expect(seqs(hub.events())).toEqual([3]);
    // A replay of nothing but events it leaves out sends nothing, and goes on after them.
    (await hub.connection(0)).terminate();
    await hub.connection(1);
    outbox.append(note('five'));
    expect(await outbox.waitAcked(5, 2_000)).toBe(true);
    expect(seqs(eventsMessages(hub, 1).flatMap((message) => message.events))).toEqual([5]);
    expect(seqs(hub.events())).toEqual([3, 5]);
  });

  test('fills each events message only up to its byte budget, one event at least', async () => {
    const big = 'x'.repeat(Math.floor(MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES / 3));
    const { hub, link, outbox } = setup(
      {},
      {
        before: (box) => {
          for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) box.append(note(`${index} ${big}`));
          box.append(note('small'));
        },
      },
    );
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.events().length === 9);
    const sizes = eventsMessages(hub, 0).map((message) => JSON.stringify(message.events).length);
    expect(sizes.length).toBeGreaterThan(3);
    for (const size of sizes) expect(size).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES);
    expect(await outbox.waitAcked(9, 2_000)).toBe(true);
    expect(seqs(hub.events())).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]);
  });

  test('never sends an event whose transaction rolled back', async () => {
    const { hub, link, outbox, db } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    outbox.append(note('one'));
    const rolledBack = db.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      outbox.append(note('rolled back'));
      throw new Error('the record update failed');
    });
    expect(() => rolledBack()).toThrow(/record update/);
    outbox.append(note('two'));
    expect(await outbox.waitAcked(2, 2_000)).toBe(true);
    const sent = hub.events().map((event) => [event.seq, (event.data as { summary: string }).summary]);
    expect(sent).toEqual([
      [1, 'one'],
      [2, 'two'],
    ]);
  });

  test('hands commands to the handler in arrival order and sends each result as soon as it settles', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    let releaseInterrupt = () => {};
    const interruptHeld = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      releaseInterrupt = resolve;
    });
    const { hub, link } = setup(
      {},
      {
        handlers: {
          onCommand: async (message): Promise<CommandResult> => {
            order.push(message.command.kind);
            if (message.command.kind === 'interrupt') await interruptHeld;
            if (message.command.kind === 'hold_attempt') throw new Error('the attempt is gone');
            return { ok: true, data: { seq: message.seq } };
          },
        },
      },
    );
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    const commands: RunnerCommand[] = [
      { kind: 'interrupt', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence },
      { kind: 'deliver', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence, messages: [], more: 0 },
      { kind: 'hold_attempt', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence },
    ];
    const ids = commands.map((command) => hub.command(command)) as [string, string, string];
    // A slow command never holds back the results of later ones.
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.has(ids[1]) && hub.results.has(ids[2]));
    expect(hub.results.has(ids[0])).toBe(false);
    expect(order).toEqual(['interrupt', 'deliver', 'hold_attempt']);
    releaseInterrupt();
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.has(ids[0]));
    expect(hub.results.get(ids[0])).toEqual({ t: 'result', commandId: ids[0], ok: true, data: { seq: 1 } });
    expect(hub.results.get(ids[1])).toEqual({ t: 'result', commandId: ids[1], ok: true, data: { seq: 2 } });
    expect(hub.results.get(ids[2])).toEqual({
      t: 'result',
      commandId: ids[2],
      ok: false,
      error: 'the attempt is gone',
    });
    expect(hub.invalid).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('sends no result for a command the handler answers null, so the hub sends it again after a welcome', async () => {
    const { hub, link } = setup(
      {},
      {
        handlers: {
          onCommand: async (message): Promise<CommandResult | null> =>
            message.command.kind === 'interrupt' ? null : { ok: true },
        },
      },
    );
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    const unanswered = hub.command({ kind: 'interrupt', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence });
    const answered = hub.command({ kind: 'hold_attempt', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence });
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.has(answered));
    expect(hub.results.has(unanswered)).toBe(false);
    expect(hub.connections[0]?.messages.filter((message) => message.t === 'result')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(hub.invalid).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('calls onWelcome on each welcome, before the messages that follow it', async () => {
    const calls: string[] = [];
    const { hub, link } = setup(
      { welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? false : {}) },
      {
        handlers: {
          onWelcome: (welcome) => calls.push(`welcome ${welcome.stop.map((entry) => entry.attemptId).join(',')}`),
          onCommand: async (message) => {
            calls.push(`command ${message.command.kind}`);
            return { ok: true };
          },
        },
      },
    );
    const first = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.messages.length > 0);
    first.send(testWelcome(0, { stop: [{ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', reason: 'unknown' }] }));
    hub.command({ kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: 'T-4-a1' });
    await hub.waitFor(() => calls.length === 2);
    expect(calls).toEqual(['welcome T-4-a1', 'command cleanup_attempt']);
    expect(link.welcome?.stop).toEqual([{ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', reason: 'unknown' }]);
  });

  test('reconnectNow from onWelcome ends that connection before anything follows the welcome, and connects at once', async () => {
    const calls: string[] = [];
    let link: LinkClient | null = null;
    const { hub, outbox, link: started } = setup(
      {
        autoAck: false,
        welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? false : { hubEpoch: 2 }),
      },
      {
        // A backoff would take seconds; this reconnect must not wait for one.
        random: () => 1,
        timings: { backoffBase: 5_000, backoffCap: 5_000 },
        before: (box) => box.append(note('one')),
        handlers: {
          onWelcome: (welcome) => {

            if (welcome.hubEpoch === 1) link?.reconnectNow('a restored hub');
          },
          onCommand: async (message) => {
            calls.push(`command ${message.command.kind}`);
            return { ok: true };
          },
        },
      },
    );

    await hub.waitFor(() => first.messages.length > 0);
    const at = Date.now();
    first.send(testWelcome(0));
    first.send({ t: 'command', id: '1-R-1-1', seq: 1, command: { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' } });
    const second = await hub.connection(1, 2_000);
    expect(Date.now() - at).toBeLessThan(2_000);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link?.state === 'online' && link.welcomeSinceGap);
    await hub.waitFor(() => eventsMessages(hub, 1).length > 0);
    // Nothing went out or was handled on the first connection after its welcome: no event, no command, no result.
    expect(kinds(hub, 0)).toEqual(['hello']);
    expect(calls).toEqual(['welcome 1', 'welcome 2']);
    expect(hub.results.size).toBe(0);
    expect(seqs(eventsMessages(hub, 1).flatMap((message) => message.events))).toEqual([1]);
    expect(second.messages[0]?.t).toBe('hello');
    expect(outbox.ackedSeq()).toBe(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.closed);
    expect(first.closed?.code).toBe(1006);
  });

  test('logs and ignores a malformed hub message, and answers an unreadable command unsupported', async () => {
    const { hub, link, logger, commands } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    const connection = await hub.connection(0);
    connection.sendRaw('not json');
    connection.sendRaw(JSON.stringify({ t: 'nonsense' }));
    connection.sendRaw(JSON.stringify({ t: 'command', id: '1-R-1-9', seq: 9, command: { kind: 'teleport' } }));
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.get('1-R-1-9'));
    expect(hub.results.get('1-R-1-9')).toEqual({ t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-9', ok: false, error: 'unsupported' });
    expect(commands).toEqual([]);
    const warnings = logger.entries.filter((entry) => entry.level === 'warn').map((entry) => entry.message);
    expect(warnings).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(link.state).toBe('online');
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('close() closes the socket and never reconnects', async () => {
    const { hub, link } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    link.close();
    const first = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => first.closed);
    expect(first.closed?.code).toBe(1000);
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(link.state).toBe('closed');
  });

  test('uses runner.json timings until a welcome overrides them', () => {
    const link = new LinkClient({
      credentials: () => null,
      hubUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:7000',
      outbox: {} as Outbox,
      clock: new AwakeClock({ gapMs: DEFAULT_TIMINGS.tickGap }),

});
```

**File:** `packages/runner/src/link.ts` (new)

```ts
// The runner link (design 6.3): one WebSocket to the hub's GET /api/runner/ws, opened with the CLI token. The runner
// says hello first; after welcome it replays its outbox from welcome.ackedSeq and then streams new events, sends
// heartbeats, and hands each command to the command handler, sending its result back. A link silent for deadLink is
// terminated, a handshake without welcome times out, and a dropped link reconnects with full-jitter backoff, or at
// once after a clock gap. canPushWip (design 7.3, X-11) reads welcomeSinceGap and lastAckAt from here.
import { type Credentials, type HubMessage, parseHubMessage, type RunnerMessage } from '@agflow/core';
import { Backoff } from './backoff';
import { type AwakeClock, type ClockGap, type ClockSource, systemClock } from './clock';
import type { RunnerTimings } from './config';
import type { CommandResult } from './journal';
import { type Logger, noopLogger } from './log';
import type { Outbox, StoredEvent } from './outbox';

/** Gives the CLI's credentials, or null when signed out (X-8; M2c reads credentials.json). */
export type CredentialsProvider = () => Credentials | null | Promise<Credentials | null>;

export type HelloMessage = Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'hello' }>;
export type HeartbeatContent = Omit<Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'heartbeat' }>, 't' | 'at'>;
export type WelcomeMessage = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'welcome' }>;
export type CommandMessage = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'command' }>;

/** idle before start; connecting until welcome; online after it; backoff between connections; closed for good. */
export type LinkState = 'idle' | 'connecting' | 'online' | 'backoff' | 'closed';

export interface LinkHandlers {
  /**
   * Each command, called at once and in arrival order; the result is sent when the promise settles (a rejection
   * answers ok false with its message). The executor decides what runs concurrently. Null answers nothing: the hub
   * keeps the command pending and sends it again after the next welcome.
   */
  onCommand(message: CommandMessage): Promise<CommandResult | null>;
  /** Each welcome, before any message that follows it is handled. */
  onWelcome?(welcome: WelcomeMessage): void;
  /** Each state change, with the close code and reason of the socket that ended (null and '' otherwise). */
  onState?(state: LinkState, detail: { code: number | null; reason: string }): void;
}

export interface LinkOptions {
  credentials: CredentialsProvider;
  /**
   * The hub this runner serves: the one its project key was derived from at start. While the CLI is signed in to
   * another hub (one credentials.json, switched by `agflow login --hub`), the link opens no socket and backs off.
   */
  hubUrl: string;
  outbox: Outbox;
  /** The awake clock: its gaps reconnect the link, and lastAckAt is read on it. */
  clock: AwakeClock;
  /** runner.json's timings; welcome.timings override heartbeat and deadLink. */
  timings: Pick<RunnerTimings, 'heartbeat' | 'deadLink' | 'handshake' | 'backoffBase' | 'backoffCap'>;
  /** Builds the hello sent first on every connection. */
  hello: () => HelloMessage | Promise<HelloMessage>;
  /** The content of each heartbeat: every live attempt's facts, power, disk and acceptingUntil. */
  heartbeat: () => HeartbeatContent;
  /**
   * Whether the hub has had an event already and must not apply it again: the replay leaves it out, as if sent. The
   * runtime names the settings edits a restored hub would apply twice (X-12). None when absent.
   */
  resent?: (event: StoredEvent) => boolean;
  handlers: LinkHandlers;
  logger?: Logger;
  /** Timers; the system's by default. */
  timers?: ClockSource;
  /** For the backoff's jitter. */
  random?: () => number;
}

/** The events of one message at most; a long replay goes out in several. */
const EVENT_BATCH = 100;

/**
 * The serialized events of one message at most, unless a single event is larger (the outbox caps those at
 * MAX_EVENT_BYTES), so no message nears the hub's 16 MB limit, which would close the link before every resend.
 */
export const MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

/** Whether two hub URLs name one hub: the same origin and path, a trailing slash aside. */
export function sameHubUrl(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const normal = (raw: string) => {
    const url = new URL(raw);
    return `${url.origin}${url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')}`;
  };
  try {
    return normal(a) === normal(b);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** ws(s)://<hub>/api/runner/ws for the hub URL the CLI signed in to. */
export function hubWebSocketUrl(hubUrl: string): string {
  const url = new URL(hubUrl);
  if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') {
    throw new Error(`the hub URL must be http or https, not ${url.protocol}`);
  }
  url.protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
  url.pathname = `${url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/runner/ws`;
  url.search = '';
  url.hash = '';
  return url.toString();
}

function describe(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

export class LinkClient {
  private readonly logger: Logger;
  private readonly timers: ClockSource;
  private readonly backoff: Backoff;
  private currentState: LinkState = 'idle';
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null;
  /** Counts connection attempts, so one overtaken while it read the credentials gives up. */
  private generation = 0;
  private lastWelcome: WelcomeMessage | null = null;
  private sinceGap = false;
  private ackAt: number | null = null;
  /** The highest seq sent on the current connection. */
  private sentSeq = 0;
  private reconnectTimer: unknown = null;
  private handshakeTimer: unknown = null;
  private deadTimer: unknown = null;
  private heartbeatTimer: unknown = null;
  private readonly unsubscribe: (() => void)[] = [];

  constructor(private readonly options: LinkOptions) {
    this.logger = options.logger ?? noopLogger;
    this.timers = options.timers ?? systemClock;
    this.backoff = new Backoff({
      base: options.timings.backoffBase,
      cap: options.timings.backoffCap,
      now: () => options.clock.awakeNow(),
      random: options.random,
    });
  }

  get state(): LinkState {
    return this.currentState;
  }

  /** The last welcome, kept across reconnects. */
  get welcome(): WelcomeMessage | null {
    return this.lastWelcome;
  }

  /**
   * Whether a welcome arrived since the last clock gap (canPushWip, X-11). It reads the clock first, so a gap that
   * nothing noticed yet (right after a wake, before the tick) already counts.
   */
  get welcomeSinceGap(): boolean {
    this.options.clock.awakeNow();
    return this.sinceGap;
  }

  /**
   * The awake time of the last heartbeat_ack or welcome, or null before the first (canPushWip, X-11). The grace age
   * is clock.awakeNow() - lastAckAt; reading it notices a pending gap, as welcomeSinceGap does.
   */
  get lastAckAt(): number | null {
    this.options.clock.awakeNow();
    return this.ackAt;
  }

  /** The heartbeat and dead-link intervals in force: the last welcome's, or runner.json's before any. */
  get timings(): { heartbeatMs: number; deadLinkMs: number } {
    const fromHub = this.lastWelcome?.timings;
    return {
      heartbeatMs: fromHub?.heartbeatMs ?? this.options.timings.heartbeat,
      deadLinkMs: fromHub?.deadLinkMs ?? this.options.timings.deadLink,
    };
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.currentState !== 'idle') return;
    this.unsubscribe.push(
      this.options.outbox.onAppend(() => this.pump()),
      this.options.clock.onGap((gap) => this.onGap(gap)),
    );
    void this.connect();
  }

  /** Closes the link for good. */
  close(): void {
    if (this.currentState === 'closed') return;
    for (const stop of this.unsubscribe.splice(0)) stop();
    this.generation += 1;
    this.clearTimers();
    if (this.reconnectTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    const socket = this.socket;
    this.socket = null;
    socket?.close(1000, 'runner closing');
    this.setState('closed', { code: null, reason: '' });
  }

  private setState(state: LinkState, detail: { code: number | null; reason: string }): void {
    if (this.currentState === state) return;
    this.currentState = state;
    this.options.handlers.onState?.(state, detail);
  }

  private async connect(): Promise<void> {
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    this.setState('connecting', { code: null, reason: '' });
    let credentials: Credentials | null;
    try {
      credentials = await this.options.credentials();
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn('cannot read the CLI credentials', { error: describe(error) });
      credentials = null;
    }
    if (generation !== this.generation || this.currentState !== 'connecting') return;
    if (!credentials) {
      this.logger.warn('not signed in to an agflow hub; run agflow login');
      this.scheduleReconnect({ code: null, reason: 'not signed in' });
      return;
    }
    // The CLI token of another hub never goes to this one, and this runner's hello and events never go to another.
    if (!sameHubUrl(credentials.hubUrl, this.options.hubUrl)) {
      this.logger.warn(`the CLI is signed in to ${credentials.hubUrl}; this runner serves ${this.options.hubUrl}`);
      this.scheduleReconnect({ code: null, reason: 'signed in to another hub' });
      return;
    }
    let socket: WebSocket;
    try {
      socket = new WebSocket(hubWebSocketUrl(credentials.hubUrl), {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${credentials.token}` },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn('cannot open the hub link', { error: describe(error) });
      this.scheduleReconnect({ code: null, reason: describe(error) });
      return;
    }
    this.socket = socket;
    this.sentSeq = 0;
    // The handshake covers the upgrade and the welcome.
    this.handshakeTimer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.socket !== socket) return;
      this.logger.warn('the hub sent no welcome in time; reconnecting', { ms: this.options.timings.handshake });
      this.terminate(socket, 'handshake timeout');
    }, this.options.timings.handshake);
    socket.addEventListener('open', () => void this.sendHello(socket));
    socket.addEventListener('message', (event) => this.receive(socket, event.data));
    socket.addEventListener('close', (event) => this.closed(socket, event.code, event.reason));
  }

  private async sendHello(socket: WebSocket): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const hello = await this.options.hello();
      if (this.socket === socket) socket.send(JSON.stringify(hello));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot build the hello', { error: describe(error) });
      if (this.socket === socket) this.terminate(socket, 'no hello');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Ends a socket at once (terminate, not close: a dead peer would never answer a close frame) and goes on as if it
   * had closed, without waiting for its close event.
   */
  private terminate(socket: WebSocket, reason: string): void {
    // Closed first: terminate() may report its own close event at once, which would replace this reason.
    this.closed(socket, 1006, reason);
    socket.terminate();
  }

  private closed(socket: WebSocket, code: number, reason: string): void {
    // A gap that this close is the first to see reconnects at once (onGap replaces the socket), not after a backoff.
    this.options.clock.awakeNow();
    // A socket that a reconnect or close() already replaced has nothing more to say.
    if (this.socket !== socket) return;
    this.socket = null;
    this.clearTimers();
    this.backoff.disconnected();
    this.logger.info('the hub link closed', { code, reason });
    this.scheduleReconnect({ code, reason });
  }

  private scheduleReconnect(detail: { code: number | null; reason: string }): void {
    if (this.currentState === 'closed') return;
    this.setState('backoff', detail);
    const delay = this.backoff.next();
    this.reconnectTimer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => void this.connect(), delay);
  }

  /**
   * Ends the current connection at once and connects again, without a backoff (the runtime does after the welcome of
   * a restored hub, X-12). Called from onWelcome, it ends the connection before anything follows that welcome: no
   * event goes out on it and no later message of it is handled, and the welcome counts for nothing, so no WIP push
   * goes until the next one.
   */
  reconnectNow(reason: string): void {
    if (this.currentState === 'closed') return;
    this.logger.info('reconnecting at once', { reason });
    this.sinceGap = false;
    if (this.reconnectTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    const socket = this.socket;
    this.socket = null;
    this.clearTimers();
    socket?.terminate();
    void this.connect();
  }

  /** A failed welcome's bookkeeping: drop this socket and retry with the normal backoff. */
  reconnectWithBackoff(reason: string): void {
    if (this.socket === null || this.currentState === 'closed') return;
    this.sinceGap = false;
    this.terminate(this.socket, reason);
  }

  /** A sleep or a freeze: no WIP push until the next welcome, and a new link at once. */
  private onGap(gap: ClockGap): void {
    if (this.currentState === 'closed') return;
    this.sinceGap = false;
    this.logger.info('the clock jumped; reconnecting', { gapMs: gap.ms });
    const socket = this.socket;
    this.socket = null;
    this.clearTimers();
    socket?.terminate();
    if (this.reconnectTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.backoff.disconnected();
    void this.connect();
  }

  private receive(socket: WebSocket, data: unknown): void {
    // A gap that this message is the first to see replaces the socket first, so a welcome or ack that waited out a
    // sleep is dropped with the socket it came on.
    this.options.clock.awakeNow();
    if (this.socket !== socket) return;
    // Any inbound message, readable or not, shows the link is alive.
    this.armDeadLink(socket);
    const text = typeof data === 'string' ? data : new TextDecoder().decode(data as ArrayBuffer);
    const parsed = parseHubMessage(text);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      if (parsed.commandId !== null) {
        this.logger.warn('answered an unreadable command unsupported', {
          commandId: parsed.commandId,
          error: parsed.error,
        });
        this.send(socket, { t: 'result', commandId: parsed.commandId, ok: false, error: 'unsupported' });
      } else {
        this.logger.warn('ignored a malformed hub message', { error: parsed.error });
      }
      return;
    }
    const message = parsed.value;
    switch (message.t) {
      case 'welcome':
        this.welcomed(socket, message);
        return;
      case 'ack':
        this.acknowledge(message.outboxEpoch, message.seq);
        return;
      case 'heartbeat_ack':
        this.ackAt = this.options.clock.awakeNow();
        return;
      case 'command':
        this.runCommand(socket, message);
        return;
    }
  }

  private welcomed(socket: WebSocket, welcome: WelcomeMessage): void {
    if (this.handshakeTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.handshakeTimer);
    this.handshakeTimer = null;
    this.lastWelcome = welcome;
    this.sinceGap = true;
    this.ackAt = this.options.clock.awakeNow();
    this.backoff.connected();
    // welcome.ackedSeq is the hub's acknowledged position for the outbox epoch this hello named.
    this.acknowledge(this.options.outbox.epoch, welcome.ackedSeq);
    this.sentSeq = welcome.ackedSeq;
    this.armDeadLink(socket);
    if (this.heartbeatTimer !== null) this.timers.clearInterval(this.heartbeatTimer);
    this.heartbeatTimer = this.timers.setInterval(() => this.sendHeartbeat(socket), welcome.timings.heartbeatMs);
    this.setState('online', { code: null, reason: '' });
    try {
      this.options.handlers.onWelcome?.(welcome);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot handle the welcome', { error: describe(error) });
    }
    this.pump();
  }

  /** A later ack or welcome repeats the hub's position if this local write fails. */
  private acknowledge(epoch: string, seq: number): void {
    try {
      this.options.outbox.ack(epoch, seq);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot record the hub acknowledgement', { error: describe(error) });
    }
  }

  private runCommand(socket: WebSocket, message: CommandMessage): void {
    let pending: Promise<CommandResult | null>;
    try {
      pending = this.options.handlers.onCommand(message);
    } catch (error) {
      pending = Promise.reject(error);
    }
    pending
      .catch((error: unknown): CommandResult => {
        this.logger.error('a command failed', { commandId: message.id, error: describe(error) });
        return { ok: false, error: describe(error) };
      })
      // A result for a link that dropped meanwhile is lost; the hub resends the command and the journal answers it.
      .then((result) => {
        if (result !== null) this.send(socket, { t: 'result', commandId: message.id, ...result });
      });
  }

  private sendHeartbeat(socket: WebSocket): void {
    if (this.socket !== socket) return;
    let content: HeartbeatContent;
    try {
      content = this.options.heartbeat();
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot build the heartbeat', { error: describe(error) });
      return;
    }
    this.send(socket, { t: 'heartbeat', at: this.timers.now(), ...content });
  }

  /**
   * Sends every event after the last one sent, in seq order, while the link is online: at most EVENT_BATCH events
   * and MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES per message, and always at least one event. Events the hub has had (resent) are left
   * out; the cumulative ack of a later one covers them.
   */
  private pump(): void {
    const socket = this.socket;
    if (!socket || this.currentState !== 'online') return;
    const resent = this.options.resent;
    for (;;) {
      const candidates = this.options.outbox.eventsAfter(this.sentSeq, EVENT_BATCH);
      if (candidates.length === 0) return;
      const events: StoredEvent[] = [];
      // The last event sent or left out.
      let through = this.sentSeq;
      // The array's brackets, then each event's JSON and its separating comma.
      let bytes = 2;
      for (const event of candidates) {
        if (resent?.(event)) {
          through = event.seq;
          continue;
        }
        const size = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(event)) + 1;
        if (events.length > 0 && bytes + size > MAX_EVENTS_MESSAGE_BYTES) break;
        events.push(event);
        bytes += size;
        through = event.seq;
      }
      if (events.length > 0 && !this.send(socket, { t: 'events', outboxEpoch: this.options.outbox.epoch, events })) {
        return;
      }
      this.sentSeq = through;
    }
  }

  /** Sends on the socket if it is still the current, open one; gives whether it did. */
  private send(socket: WebSocket, message: RunnerMessage): boolean {
    if (this.socket !== socket || socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return false;
    socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
    return true;
  }

  private armDeadLink(socket: WebSocket): void {
    if (this.lastWelcome === null || this.handshakeTimer !== null) return;
    if (this.deadTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.deadTimer);
    const { deadLinkMs } = this.timings;
    this.deadTimer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.socket !== socket) return;
      this.logger.warn('nothing came from the hub in time; terminating the link', { ms: deadLinkMs });
      this.terminate(socket, 'dead link');
    }, deadLinkMs);
  }

  private clearTimers(): void {
    if (this.handshakeTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.handshakeTimer);
    if (this.deadTimer !== null) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.deadTimer);
    if (this.heartbeatTimer !== null) this.timers.clearInterval(this.heartbeatTimer);
    this.handshakeTimer = null;
    this.deadTimer = null;
    this.heartbeatTimer = null;
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/link.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

`welcome.timings` override runner.json's heartbeat and dead-link timings until the next welcome. A result for a link that dropped meanwhile is not sent; the hub resends the command and the journal answers it. An event that `resent` names still advances the sent position, so the hub's cumulative ack of a later event covers it. `reconnectNow`, called from `onWelcome`, ends the connection before anything that follows the welcome is sent or handled, and that welcome allows no WIP push. A terminated client shows close code 1006 on the hub side, which is how the tests tell terminate from close. Failed outbox acknowledgement writes at welcome or ack are logged; a later ack or welcome repeats the position. A throwing `onWelcome` callback is logged and pump still runs. `reconnectWithBackoff(reason)` drops the current socket, invalidates `welcomeSinceGap`, and uses normal increasing backoff. Tests cover acknowledgement recovery, callback failure, increasing backoff and 1011 replay. The hub closes on gaps after `hello.lastSeq`; omissions within replay up to `hello.lastSeq` remain permitted. Restored-hub settings omissions are bounded by `restoredThrough` and covered by the replacement hello.

### Task 8: Link refusals, needs_login and the runner's HTTP calls

A refused WebSocket upgrade shows the client only 'Expected 101', so a socket that closes before it opened is probed with `GET /api/runner/whoami` (design 6.3, 7.1). On 401, or with credentials that are missing or name another hub, the link enters `needs_login`: it calls `onNeedsLogin` once, stops reconnecting, re-reads the credentials and probes every `loginProbe`, and reconnects once a probe passes. Closes 4403, 4409 on the current socket and 4426 end the link for good with the hub's reason. `hub-http.ts` holds the runner's other calls with the CLI token (design 6.16): `whoami`, `projectStatus` and `uploadTranscript`, which clips the tail to 64 KB at a UTF-8 boundary.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  CLOSE_CODES,
  type Credentials,
  TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES,
  TranscriptInputSchema,
} from '@agflow/core';
import { AwakeClock, type ClockSource, systemClock } from '../src/clock';
import { openRunnerDb } from '../src/db';
import { clipTranscriptTail, RunnerHttpError, RunnerHubHttp } from '../src/hub-http';
import { LinkClient, type LinkHandlers, type LinkOptions, type LinkState } from '../src/link';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';
import { Outbox } from '../src/outbox';
import { type FakeHub, type FakeHubOptions, startFakeHub, testHello } from './fake-hub';

// Each test serves a hub over real sockets, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

const cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
});

const TOKEN = 'cli_secret_token';

/** Wall time the test can move forward, so the awake clock sees a sleep; timers stay real. */
class ShiftedClock implements ClockSource {
  offset = 0;
  now = (): number => Date.now() + this.offset;
  setTimeout = systemClock.setTimeout;
  clearTimeout = systemClock.clearTimeout;
  setInterval = systemClock.setInterval;
  clearInterval = systemClock.clearInterval;
}

interface Calls {
  states: LinkState[];
  needsLogin: number;
  replaced: string[];
  refused: string[];
  incompatible: string[];
}

interface Setup {
  hub: FakeHub;
  link: LinkClient;
  calls: Calls;
  wall: ShiftedClock;
  clock: AwakeClock;
  /** What the credentials provider returns; a test swaps it as `agflow login` would. */
  credentials: { current: Credentials | null };
}

function setup(
  hubOptions: FakeHubOptions = {},
  options: { token?: string; timings?: Partial<LinkOptions['timings']>; handlers?: Partial<LinkHandlers> } = {},
): Setup {
  const hub = startFakeHub({ token: TOKEN, ...hubOptions });
  cleanups.push(() => hub.stop());
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-refusals-'));
  const db = openRunnerDb(join(dir, 'runner.db'));
  cleanups.push(() => {
    db.close();
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });
  const outbox = new Outbox(db);
  const wall = new ShiftedClock();
  const clock = new AwakeClock({ source: wall, gapMs: 5_000 });
  const calls: Calls = { states: [], needsLogin: 0, replaced: [], refused: [], incompatible: [] };
  const signedIn: Credentials = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: options.token ?? TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
  const credentials: { current: Credentials | null } = { current: signedIn };
  const link = new LinkClient({
    credentials: () => credentials.current,
    hubUrl: hub.url,
    outbox,
    clock,
    logger: memoryLogger(),
    random: () => 0,
    timings: {
      heartbeat: 10_000,
      deadLink: 10_000,
      handshake: 10_000,
      backoffBase: 10,
      backoffCap: 20,
      loginProbe: 60,
      ...options.timings,
    },
    hello: () => testHello(outbox),
    heartbeat: () => ({ attempts: [], power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
    handlers: {
      onCommand: async () => ({ ok: true }),
      onState: (state) => calls.states.push(state),
      onNeedsLogin: () => {
        calls.needsLogin += 1;
      },
      onReplaced: (reason) => calls.replaced.push(reason),
      onRefused: (reason) => calls.refused.push(reason),
      onIncompatible: (reason) => calls.incompatible.push(reason),
      ...options.handlers,
    },
  });
  cleanups.push(() => link.close());
  link.start();
  return { hub, link, calls, wall, clock, credentials };
}

describe('a refused upgrade', () => {
  test('whoami 401 enters needs_login and stops reconnecting; after agflow login a probe reconnects', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls, credentials } = setup({}, { token: 'expired_token' });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'needs_login');
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(1);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls[0]).toBe('Bearer expired_token');
    // Probes go on every loginProbe; the link itself is not tried again.
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.whoamiCalls.length >= 4);
    expect(hub.refusedUpgrades).toBe(1);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(link.state).toBe('needs_login');
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    const connection = await hub.connection(0);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(connection.authorization).toBe(`Bearer ${TOKEN}`);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls.at(-1)).toBe(`Bearer ${TOKEN}`);
    expect(hub.refusedUpgrades).toBe(1);
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(1);
    expect(calls.states).toEqual(['connecting', 'needs_login', 'connecting', 'online']);
  });

  test('a CLI without credentials enters needs_login once and connects when they appear', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls, credentials } = setup();
    credentials.current = null;
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    hub.connections[0]?.terminate();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'needs_login');
    // Probes go on without credentials; none reaches the hub, and onNeedsLogin is not repeated.
    await Bun.sleep(200);
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(1);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls).toEqual([]);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    await hub.connection(1);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(1);
  });

  test('credentials for another hub enter needs_login, and the token never goes to either hub', async () => {
    const other = startFakeHub({ token: 'other_token' });
    cleanups.push(() => other.stop());
    const { hub, link, calls, credentials } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: other.url, token: 'other_token', user: 'alice' };
    hub.connections[0]?.terminate();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'needs_login');
    await Bun.sleep(200);
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(1);
    expect(other.connections).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(other.whoamiCalls).toEqual([]);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls).toEqual([]);
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    await hub.connection(1);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
  });

  test('any other whoami answer backs off and tries the link again', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls } = setup({ whoamiStatus: 503 }, { token: 'expired_token' });
    await hub.waitFor(() => hub.refusedUpgrades >= 3);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(0);
    expect(calls.states).not.toContain('needs_login');
    expect(calls.states.slice(0, 3)).toEqual(['connecting', 'backoff', 'connecting']);
    expect(['connecting', 'backoff']).toContain(link.state);
  });

  test('a hub that cannot be reached backs off without entering needs_login', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    hub.stop();
    await Bun.sleep(150);
    expect(calls.needsLogin).toBe(0);
    expect(['connecting', 'backoff']).toContain(link.state);
  });

  test('a clock gap in needs_login probes at once instead of trying the link', async () => {
    const { hub, link, wall, clock, credentials } = setup(
      {},
      { token: 'expired_token', timings: { loginProbe: 60_000 } },
    );
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'needs_login');
    const probes = hub.whoamiCalls.length;
    credentials.current = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    wall.offset += 60_000;
    clock.awakeNow();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online', 2_000);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls.length).toBe(probes + 1);
    expect(hub.refusedUpgrades).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('close codes', () => {
  test('4409 on the current socket calls onReplaced and closes the link for good', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    (await hub.connection(0)).close(CLOSE_CODES.replaced, 'replaced by a newer connection');
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'closed');
    expect(calls.replaced).toEqual(['replaced by a newer connection']);
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('a 4409 on a socket that a reconnect already replaced is ignored', async () => {
    // Records every socket the link opens, so the replaced one can be handed a 4409 after the link moved on.
    const sockets: WebSocket[] = [];
    const RealWebSocket = globalThis.WebSocket;
    globalThis.WebSocket = class extends RealWebSocket {
      constructor(...args: ConstructorParameters<typeof WebSocket>) {
        super(...args);
        sockets.push(this);
      }
    } as typeof WebSocket;
    cleanups.push(() => {
      globalThis.WebSocket = RealWebSocket;
    });
    const { hub, link, calls, wall, clock } = setup();
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online');
    wall.offset += 60_000;
    clock.awakeNow();
    await hub.connection(1);
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'online' && sockets.length === 2);
    sockets[0]?.dispatchEvent(
      new CloseEvent('close', { code: CLOSE_CODES.replaced, reason: 'replaced by a newer connection' }),
    );
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(calls.replaced).toEqual([]);
    expect(link.state).toBe('online');
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  test("4403 calls onRefused with the hub's reason and never reconnects", async () => {
    const reason = 'this runner was retired; run agflow runner setup';
    const { hub, link, calls } = setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => {
        connection.close(CLOSE_CODES.refused, reason);
        return false;
      },
    });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'closed');
    expect(calls.refused).toEqual([reason]);
    expect(calls.states.at(-1)).toBe('closed');
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(hub.whoamiCalls).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('4426 calls onIncompatible and never reconnects', async () => {
    const { hub, link, calls } = setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => {
        connection.close(CLOSE_CODES.incompatible, 'protocol 1 is no longer supported; the minimum is 2');
        return false;
      },
    });
    await hub.waitFor(() => link.state === 'closed');
    expect(calls.incompatible).toEqual(['protocol 1 is no longer supported; the minimum is 2']);
    expect(calls.refused).toEqual([]);
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(hub.connections).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

interface Recorded {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  authorization: string | null;
  body: unknown;
}

/** A hub of scripted HTTP answers that records every request. */
function httpHub(answer: (request: Recorded) => Response) {
  const requests: Recorded[] = [];
  const server = Bun.serve({
    hostname: '127.0.0.1',
    port: 0,
    async fetch(request) {
      const text = await request.text();
      const recorded: Recorded = {
        method: request.method,
        path: new URL(request.url).pathname,
        authorization: request.headers.get('authorization'),
        body: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null,
      };
      requests.push(recorded);
      return answer(recorded);
    },
  });
  cleanups.push(() => server.stop(true));
  const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}`;
  const http = new RunnerHubHttp({ credentials: () => ({ hubUrl: `${url}/`, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }) });
  return { requests, http, url };
}

describe('RunnerHubHttp', () => {
  test('whoami returns the user, and a refused token is a 401 error', async () => {
    const { http, requests } = httpHub(() => Response.json({ user: 'alice' }));
    expect(await http.whoami()).toEqual({ user: 'alice' });
    expect(requests).toEqual([
      { method: 'GET', path: '/api/runner/whoami', authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, body: null },
    ]);
    const refused = httpHub(() => Response.json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })).http;
    const error = await refused.whoami().catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RunnerHttpError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ status: 401, code: 'unauthorized' });
  });

  test("projectStatus returns the project's name and repo", async () => {
    const { http, requests } = httpHub(() =>
      Response.json({
        project: { name: 'demo', repo: 'git@github.com:acme/demo.git', paused: false },
        goalVersion: 3,
        epoch: 1,
      }),
    );
    expect(await http.projectStatus()).toEqual({ name: 'demo', repo: 'git@github.com:acme/demo.git' });
    expect(requests[0]).toMatchObject({ method: 'GET', path: '/api/status', authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` });
  });

  test('uploadTranscript posts { tail } clipped to 64 KB with the CLI token', async () => {
    const { http, requests } = httpHub(() => Response.json({ ok: true }));
    // Three-byte characters, so the cut falls inside one unless it is moved to a boundary.
    const transcript = `${'start '.repeat(5_000)}${'€'.repeat(30_000)}the end`;
    await http.uploadTranscript('T-4-a1', transcript);
    const [request] = requests;
    expect(request).toMatchObject({
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/api/runner/attempts/T-4-a1/transcript',
      authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    });
    const { tail } = TranscriptInputSchema.parse(request?.body);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(tail)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(tail)).toBeGreaterThan(TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES - 3);
    expect(transcript.endsWith(tail)).toBe(true);
    expect(tail.startsWith('€')).toBe(true);
    await http.uploadTranscript('T-4-a1', 'short');
    expect(requests[1]?.body).toEqual({ tail: 'short' });
  });

  test('clipTranscriptTail keeps a short text and never splits a character', () => {
    expect(clipTranscriptTail('héllo', 64)).toBe('héllo');
    expect(clipTranscriptTail('aé', 2)).toBe('é');
    expect(clipTranscriptTail('aé', 1)).toBe('');
  });

  test('reads the credentials on every call and names an unreachable hub or a signed-out CLI', async () => {
    let credentials: Credentials | null = null;
    const http = new RunnerHubHttp({ credentials: () => credentials });
    await expect(http.whoami()).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 0, code: 'signed_out' });
    credentials = { hubUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:1', token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
    await expect(http.whoami()).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 0, code: 'unreachable' });
  });

  test('a body that does not match the schema is an error', async () => {
    const { http } = httpHub(() => Response.json({ who: 'alice' }));
    await expect(http.whoami()).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'bad_response' });
    await expect(http.projectStatus()).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'bad_response' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// The runner's HTTP calls to the hub (design 6.3, 6.16), all with the CLI token: whoami, which tells a refused token
// from anything else after a refused link; the project's name and repo from GET /api/status, which name the vault
// and work directories; and transcript tails for handoff notes. The credentials are read on every call, so a call
// after `agflow login` uses the new token.
import {
  OkResponseSchema,
  TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES,
  TranscriptInputSchema,
  WhoamiResponseSchema,
} from '@agflow/core';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { CredentialsProvider } from './link';

export type FetchFn = (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;

/** status is the HTTP status, or 0 when there was no answer: unreachable, signed out, or an unreadable body. */
export class RunnerHttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'RunnerHttpError';
  }
}

export interface RunnerHubHttpOptions {
  credentials: CredentialsProvider;
  fetch?: FetchFn;
  /** Per request; 15 s. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

/** Only the two fields the runner needs; the rest of the status may grow without breaking it. */
const ProjectStatusSchema = z.object({ project: z.object({ name: z.string().min(1), repo: z.string() }) });

/**
 * The end of a transcript within the byte limit, cut at a character boundary: UTF-8 continuation bytes at the cut
 * are dropped, never split.
 */
export function clipTranscriptTail(text: string, maxBytes: number = TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(text, 'utf8');
  if (bytes.length <= maxBytes) return text;
  let start = bytes.length - maxBytes;
  while (start < bytes.length && ((bytes[start] as number) & 0xc0) === 0x80) start += 1;
  return bytes.subarray(start).toString('utf8');
}

export class RunnerHubHttp {
  private readonly fetchFn: FetchFn;
  private readonly timeoutMs: number;

  constructor(private readonly options: RunnerHubHttpOptions) {
    this.fetchFn = options.fetch ?? ((input, init) => fetch(input, init));
    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 15_000;
  }

  /** GET /api/runner/whoami: the signed-in user. A refused token is a RunnerHttpError with status 401. */
  async whoami(): Promise<{ user: string }> {
    const path = '/api/runner/whoami';
    return this.parse(WhoamiResponseSchema, await this.request('GET', path), path);
  }

  /** The project's name and repo, from GET /api/status. */
  async projectStatus(): Promise<{ name: string; repo: string }> {
    const { project } = this.parse(ProjectStatusSchema, await this.request('GET', '/api/status'), '/api/status');
    return { name: project.name, repo: project.repo };
  }

  /** Posts the end of an attempt's transcript, clipped to 64 KB. */
  async uploadTranscript(attemptId: string, transcript: string): Promise<void> {
    const path = `/api/runner/attempts/${encodeURIComponent(attemptId)}/transcript`;
    const body = TranscriptInputSchema.parse({ tail: clipTranscriptTail(transcript) });
    this.parse(OkResponseSchema, await this.request('POST', path, body), path);
  }

  private parse<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, value: unknown, path: string): T {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      throw new RunnerHttpError(0, 'bad_response', `the hub answered ${path} with an unexpected body`);
    }
    return parsed.data;
  }

  private async request(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
    const credentials = await this.options.credentials();
    if (!credentials) throw new RunnerHttpError(0, 'signed_out', 'not signed in to an agflow hub; run agflow login');
    const base = credentials.hubUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      accept: 'application/json',
      authorization: `Bearer ${credentials.token}`,
    };
    if (body !== undefined) headers['content-type'] = 'application/json';
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await this.fetchFn(`${base}${path}`, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      throw new RunnerHttpError(0, 'unreachable', `cannot reach the agflow hub at ${base}: ${reason}`);
    }
    const text = await response.text();
    let json: unknown = null;
    try {
      json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
    } catch {
      json = null;
    }
    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = (json ?? {}) as { error?: unknown; message?: unknown };
      throw new RunnerHttpError(
        response.status,
        typeof error.error === 'string' ? error.error : 'http_error',
        typeof error.message === 'string' ? error.message : `${method} ${path} failed with HTTP ${response.status}`,
      );
    }
    return json;
  }
}
```
