```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { type AttemptSpec, capForCommand, judgeStall, parseRunnerMessage, type StallLimits } from '@agflow/core';
import { gitIn, originRepo } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { AgentEvent } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { AwakeClock, type ClockSource } from '../src/clock';
import { diffFingerprint, FactsTracker } from '../src/facts';
import { createTaskClone } from '../src/git/clone';
import { ensureRunnerGitFiles, localGitEnv, remoteGitEnv } from '../src/git/run';
import { Vault } from '../src/git/vault';
import { runnerPaths } from '../src/paths';
import { PLANTED_ATTRIBUTES, plantCloneConfig, touchLater } from './planted-config';

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

const cleanups: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) await cleanup();
});

function tempDir(prefix: string): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix));
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

const FENCE = { epoch: 1, counter: 4 };
const CAPS: AttemptSpec['toolCaps'] = {
  defaultMs: 30 * 60_000,
  longMs: 90 * 60_000,
  checks: [{ cmd: 'bun run check:all', capMs: 100 * 60_000 }],
};

/** Wall time the test moves by hand; the awake clock reads it, and no timer of it ever fires. */
class ManualSource implements ClockSource {
  t = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 30, 9, 0, 0);
  now = () => this.t;
  setTimeout = () => 0;
  clearTimeout = () => {};
  setInterval = () => 0;
  clearInterval = () => {};
}

/** Moves wall time in awake steps of 1 s, as the clock's 1 s tick sees it. */
function awake(source: ManualSource, clock: AwakeClock, ms: number): void {
  for (let left = ms; left > 0; left -= 1_000) {
    source.t += Math.min(1_000, left);
    clock.awakeNow();
  }
}

/** A sleep: one jump of wall time, of which the clock counts only a tick. */
function sleep(source: ManualSource, clock: AwakeClock, ms: number): void {
  source.t += ms;
  clock.awakeNow();
}

async function until(check: () => boolean, timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (!check()) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error('timed out waiting for a condition');
    await Bun.sleep(20);
  }
}

/** A tracker on a plain directory, with a fingerprint the test sets. */
function tracker(options: { clone?: string; fingerprint?: () => Promise<string> } = {}) {
  const source = new ManualSource();
  const clock = new AwakeClock({ source, tickMs: 1_000, gapMs: 5_000 });
  const clone = options.clone ?? tempDir('agflow-facts-');
  const facts = new FactsTracker({
    attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
    fence: FENCE,
    clone,
    toolCaps: CAPS,
    clock,
    fingerprint: options.fingerprint ?? (async () => 'same'),
  });
  cleanups.push(() => facts.close());
  return { source, clock, facts, clone };
}

const turnStarted: AgentEvent = { type: 'turn_started' };
function turnEnded(toolCalls: number, outcome: 'completed' | 'interrupted' | 'failed' = 'completed'): AgentEvent {
  return { type: 'turn_ended', outcome, toolCalls, error: null, errorKind: outcome === 'failed' ? 'vendor' : null };
}
const MINUTE = 60_000;
function toolStarted(toolId: string, name: string, input: string, command: string | null = null): AgentEvent {
  return { type: 'tool_started', toolId, name, input, command };
}
function toolEnded(toolId: string): AgentEvent {
  return { type: 'tool_ended', toolId, ok: true, denied: false, terminal: null, hubUnreachable: false };
}

describe('diffFingerprint', () => {
  test('changes with HEAD, with tracked and untracked changes, and with another edit of a modified file', async () => {
    const repo = await originRepo({ 'README.md': '# demo\n', 'src/app.ts': 'app\n' });
    cleanups.push(() => repo.remove());
    const paths = runnerPaths(tempDir('agflow-facts-runner-'));
    ensureRunnerGitFiles(paths);
    const home = tempDir('agflow-owner-');
    const vault = new Vault({
      paths,
      project: 'demo-0123456789',
      repo: { url: repo.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
      remote: () => remoteGitEnv({ base: { ...process.env, HOME: home, XDG_CONFIG_HOME: undefined } }),
    });
    await vault.ensure();
    await vault.fetchForAttempt({ taskId: 'T-4', start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null } }, 'refs/agflow/');
    const local = localGitEnv(paths);
    const clone = paths.clone('demo-0123456789', 'T-4-a1');
    await createTaskClone({
      vault,
      local,
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      clone,
      branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy',
      startSha: repo.mainSha,
    });
    const index = join(tempDir('agflow-facts-index-'), 'index');
    const take = () => diffFingerprint({ vault, local, clone, startSha: repo.mainSha, index });
    const clean = await take();
    expect(await take()).toBe(clean);
    mkdirSync(join(clone, '.agflow', 'run'), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(clone, '.agflow', 'run', 'note.txt'), 'runner-owned\n');
    expect(await take()).toBe(clean);
    writeFileSync(join(clone, 'src', 'app.ts'), 'changed\n');
    const modified = await take();
    expect(modified).not.toBe(clean);
    expect(await take()).toBe(modified);
    // An edit of the same size: only its mtime tells it apart.
    writeFileSync(join(clone, 'src', 'app.ts'), 'chanGed\n');
    touchLater(join(clone, 'src', 'app.ts'));
    const sameSize = await take();
    expect(sameSize).not.toBe(modified);
    writeFileSync(join(clone, 'src', 'app.ts'), 'changed again, longer\n');
    const again = await take();
    expect(again).not.toBe(sameSize);
    writeFileSync(join(clone, 'new.txt'), 'new\n');
    const untracked = await take();
    expect(untracked).not.toBe(again);
    // A commit the vault does not hold yet changes HEAD.
    await gitIn(clone, ['add', '-A']);
    await gitIn(clone, ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'work']);
    const committed = await take();
    expect(committed).not.toBe(untracked);
    expect(await take()).toBe(committed);
    // Another branch at the same commit: HEAD read as a file, not only its sha.
    await gitIn(clone, ['checkout', '-q', '-b', 'agflow/T-4-other']);
    expect(await take()).not.toBe(committed);
  });
```

```ts
// Stall facts (design 7.5, 6.8): one FactsTracker per attempt builds the AttemptFacts each heartbeat carries. Every
// age and activeMs comes from the awake clock, so sleep and freeze gaps are left out. File changes come from one
// recursive watch of the clone (.agflow/run/ ignored), commits from a watch on .git/logs/HEAD, and a periodic check
// notices a deleted clone, which silences the watcher. A tool's cap is core's capForCommand, so the hub and the
// runner read commands the same way (X-18); activeMs counts only the phases starting and turn (X-35). Turns that fail
// with a vendor error count toward neither no-progress nor loops (design 6.8). What adapters report is kept within
// the heartbeat's schema here, since one bad value would make the hub drop the whole heartbeat.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, type FSWatcher, watch } from 'node:fs';
import { lstat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  type AttemptFacts,
  type AttemptPhase,
  type AttemptSpec,
  capForCommand,
  type Fence,
  isLongCommand,
} from '@agflow/core';
import type { AgentEvent } from './adapters/types';
import type { AwakeClock } from './clock';
import { readCloneHead } from './git/clone';
import { type GitEnvironment, RUN_DIR_EXCLUDE, runGit } from './git/run';
import type { Vault } from './git/vault';

/** How often the clone's existence is checked by default. */
export const CLONE_CHECK_MS = 15_000;

/** The phases activeMs counts (X-35). */
const ACTIVE_PHASES: readonly AttemptPhase[] = ['starting', 'turn'];

export interface FactsTrackerOptions {
  attemptId: string;
  fence: Fence;
  /** The clone's path. */
  clone: string;
  toolCaps: AttemptSpec['toolCaps'];
  clock: Pick<AwakeClock, 'awakeNow'>;
  /** The diff fingerprint, taken at the start and after each completed turn: diffFingerprint for this attempt. */
  fingerprint(): Promise<string>;
  /** 'starting' by default. */
  phase?: AttemptPhase;
  /** CLONE_CHECK_MS by default. */
  existenceCheckMs?: number;
  /** Called once, when the clone is found gone. */
  onCloneGone?(): void;
}

interface ToolInFlight {
  name: string;
  command: string | null;
  startedAt: number;
  /** capForCommand's cap for the command. */
  capMs: number;
}

/** A path the tree watcher reports that is the runner's own: .agflow/run/ and the .agflow directory holding it. */
function runnerOwned(name: string): boolean {
  return name === '.agflow' || name === '.agflow/run' || name.startsWith('.agflow/run/');
}

export class FactsTracker {
  private readonly options: FactsTrackerOptions;
  private fence: Fence;
  private phase: AttemptPhase;
  private phaseSince: number;
  private activeBefore = 0;
  private vendorErrorSince: number | null = null;
  private lastEventAt: number;
  private lastFsAt: number | null = null;
  private lastCommitAt: number | null = null;
  private readonly tools = new Map<string, ToolInFlight>();
  private lastCall: string | null = null;
  private repeatedCalls = 0;
  /** The loop count as the running turn found it, restored if the turn fails with a vendor error. */
  private callsBeforeTurn: { lastCall: string | null; repeatedCalls: number } | null = null;
  private turns = 0;
  private turnsWithoutProgress = 0;
  private continuations = 0;
  private contextUsed: number | null = null;
  private fingerprint: string | null = null;
  /** Fingerprints are taken in turn order. */
  private progress: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  private treeWatcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  private commitWatcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private gone = false;
  private closed = false;

  constructor(options: FactsTrackerOptions) {
    this.options = options;
    this.fence = options.fence;
    this.phase = options.phase ?? 'starting';
    const now = options.clock.awakeNow();
    this.phaseSince = now;
    this.lastEventAt = now;
  }

  /** Starts the watches and the existence check, and takes the first fingerprint. */
  async start(): Promise<void> {
    this.watchTree();
    this.watchCommits();
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.checkClone(), this.options.existenceCheckMs ?? CLONE_CHECK_MS);
    this.timer.unref?.();
    this.fingerprint = await this.options.fingerprint().catch(() => null);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.closed = true;
    this.treeWatcher?.close();
    this.commitWatcher?.close();
    this.treeWatcher = null;
    this.commitWatcher = null;
    if (this.timer !== null) clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
  }

  /** Whether the clone was found gone. */
  get cloneGone(): boolean {
    return this.gone;
  }

  setFence(fence: Fence): void {
    this.fence = fence;
  }

  setPhase(phase: AttemptPhase): void {
    const now = this.now();
    if (ACTIVE_PHASES.includes(this.phase)) this.activeBefore += now - this.phaseSince;
    this.phase = phase;
    this.phaseSince = now;
    // Vendor errors stay continuous through the retry turns between them; anything else ends them.
    if (phase === 'vendor_error') this.vendorErrorSince ??= now;
    else if (phase !== 'turn') this.vendorErrorSince = null;
  }

  continuationSent(): void {
    this.continuations += 1;
  }

  /** Every agent event the controller reads. */
  observe(event: AgentEvent): void {
    const now = this.now();
    this.lastEventAt = now;
    // The model answers again: a period of vendor errors is over, even if this retry turn fails later.
    const output = event.type === 'text' || event.type === 'tool_started' || event.type === 'tool_ended';
    if (output && this.phase !== 'vendor_error') this.vendorErrorSince = null;
    switch (event.type) {
      case 'turn_started':
        this.turns += 1;
        this.callsBeforeTurn = { lastCall: this.lastCall, repeatedCalls: this.repeatedCalls };
        return;
      case 'tool_started': {
        const { name, command } = event;
        const capMs = capForCommand(this.options.toolCaps, command);
        this.tools.set(event.toolId, { name, command, startedAt: now, capMs });
        const call = JSON.stringify([name, event.input]);
        this.repeatedCalls = call === this.lastCall ? this.repeatedCalls + 1 : 1;
        this.lastCall = call;
        return;
      }
      case 'tool_ended':
        this.tools.delete(event.toolId);
        return;
      case 'turn_ended':
        this.tools.clear();
        if (event.outcome === 'completed') {
          this.vendorErrorSince = null;
          this.afterCompletedTurn(event.toolCalls);
        } else if (event.outcome === 'failed' && event.errorKind === 'vendor' && this.callsBeforeTurn !== null) {
          // The vendor failed the turn: its calls count toward no loop.
          ({ lastCall: this.lastCall, repeatedCalls: this.repeatedCalls } = this.callsBeforeTurn);
        }
        this.callsBeforeTurn = null;
        return;
      case 'context':
        // A share of the window, 0..1; a sum over a turn's requests can pass 1.
        this.contextUsed = Number.isFinite(event.used) ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, event.used)) : null;
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }

  /** Resolves once the fingerprints of every completed turn so far are taken. */
  settled(): Promise<void> {
    return this.progress;
  }

  facts(): AttemptFacts {
    this.checkClone();
    const now = this.now();
    let tool: AttemptFacts['tool'] = null;
    // With calls in parallel, the one nearest to or furthest past its own cap: caps differ by command, so a younger
    // call can be past a smaller cap while an older long one is not. Ties go to the older call.
    for (const inFlight of this.tools.values()) {
      const ageMs = now - inFlight.startedAt;
      if (tool !== null) {
        const over = ageMs - inFlight.capMs;
        const reported = tool.ageMs - (tool.capMs ?? 0);
        if (over < reported || (over === reported && ageMs <= tool.ageMs)) continue;
      }
      const { command, capMs } = inFlight;
      tool = {
        // The heartbeat's schema needs a name.
        name: inFlight.name === '' ? 'tool' : inFlight.name,
        command,
        long: command !== null && isLongCommand(command),
        capMs,
        ageMs,
      };
    }
    const active = ACTIVE_PHASES.includes(this.phase) ? now - this.phaseSince : 0;
    return {
      attemptId: this.options.attemptId,
      fence: this.fence,
      phase: this.phase,
      eventAgeMs: now - this.lastEventAt,
      tool,
      fsAgeMs: this.lastFsAt === null ? null : now - this.lastFsAt,
      commitAgeMs: this.lastCommitAt === null ? null : now - this.lastCommitAt,
      turns: this.turns,
      turnsWithoutProgress: this.turnsWithoutProgress,
      repeatedCalls: this.repeatedCalls,
      continuations: this.continuations,
      vendorErrorMs: this.vendorErrorSince === null ? 0 : now - this.vendorErrorSince,
      activeMs: this.activeBefore + active,
      contextUsed: this.contextUsed,
    };
  }

  private now(): number {
    return this.options.clock.awakeNow();
  }

  /** A completed turn with no tool call and no change to the fingerprint made no progress. */
  private afterCompletedTurn(toolCalls: number): void {
    this.progress = this.progress.then(async () => {
      const fingerprint = await this.options.fingerprint().catch(() => null);
      // An unreadable clone tells nothing either way: the count stays.
      if (fingerprint === null) return;
      const unchanged = fingerprint === this.fingerprint;
      this.fingerprint = fingerprint;
      this.turnsWithoutProgress = toolCalls === 0 && unchanged ? this.turnsWithoutProgress + 1 : 0;
    });
  }

  private watchTree(): void {
    try {
      this.treeWatcher = watch(this.options.clone, { recursive: true }, (_type, name) => {
        const path = typeof name === 'string' ? name : null;
        if (path !== null && runnerOwned(path)) return;
        this.lastFsAt = this.now();
        // The tree watcher may see the reflog too; the commit watch is the one that must.
        if (path === '.git/logs/HEAD') this.lastCommitAt = this.lastFsAt;
      });
      this.treeWatcher.on('error', () => {
        this.treeWatcher?.close();
        this.treeWatcher = null;
      });
    } catch {
      this.treeWatcher = null;
    }
  }

  /** .git/logs/HEAD may not exist yet, or be replaced by git; the existence check attaches the watch again. */
  private watchCommits(): void {
    const log = join(this.options.clone, '.git', 'logs', 'HEAD');
    if (this.closed || this.commitWatcher !== null || !existsSync(log)) return;
    try {
      const watcher = watch(log, (type) => {
        this.lastCommitAt = this.now();
        if (type === 'rename') this.dropCommitWatcher(watcher);
      });
      watcher.on('error', () => this.dropCommitWatcher(watcher));
      this.commitWatcher = watcher;
    } catch {
      this.commitWatcher = null;
    }
  }

  private dropCommitWatcher(watcher: FSWatcher): void {
    watcher.close();
    if (this.commitWatcher === watcher) this.commitWatcher = null;
  }

  private checkClone(): void {
    if (this.closed || this.gone) return;
    if (!existsSync(this.options.clone)) {
      this.gone = true;
      this.options.onCloneGone?.();
      return;
    }
    this.watchCommits();
  }
}

export interface FingerprintInput {
  vault: Vault;
  /** The local environment, localGitEnv(paths). */
  local: GitEnvironment;
  clone: string;
  /** The commit compared against while the vault does not hold the clone's HEAD (new commits not harvested yet). */
  startSha: string;
  /** A runner-owned index file kept between fingerprints, so only changed files are hashed again. */
  index: string;
}

/** The paths in NUL-separated git output: `diff-files --raw -z` pairs, or `ls-files -z` names. */
function listedPaths(diffFiles: string, untracked: string): string[] {
  const paths: string[] = [];
  const fields = diffFiles.split('\0');
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < fields.length; i += 2) paths.push(fields[i + 1] as string);
  for (const name of untracked.split('\0')) if (name !== '') paths.push(name);
  return paths;
}

/**
 * The diff fingerprint (design 7.5, Q11): a hash of HEAD read as a file, the changes of the work tree against HEAD's
 * commit as the vault sees them with --work-tree, and each listed path's size and mtime, so editing a file that is
 * already modified changes it too. No git runs in the clone, and nothing in it is written.
 */
export async function diffFingerprint(input: FingerprintInput): Promise<string> {
  const { vault, local, clone } = input;
  // Read as files, with no link followed: an unreadable HEAD is part of the fingerprint as such.
  const head = await readCloneHead(clone).catch(() => null);
  const headSha = head?.sha ?? null;
  const base = headSha !== null && (await vault.hasCommit(headSha)) ? headSha : input.startSha;
  const git = (args: string[]) =>
    runGit(local, [`--git-dir=${vault.path}`, `--work-tree=${clone}`, ...args], {
      cwd: clone,
      env: { GIT_INDEX_FILE: input.index },
      check: false,
    });
  // A one-tree merge keeps the stat data of unchanged entries, so the refresh hashes only files that changed.
  await git(['read-tree', '-m', base]);
  await git(['update-index', '-q', '--refresh']);
  const diff = await git(['diff-files', '--raw', '-z', '--ignore-submodules=dirty', '--', ':(top)', RUN_DIR_EXCLUDE]);
  const untracked = await git(['ls-files', '-z', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', ':(top)', RUN_DIR_EXCLUDE]);
  const hash = createHash('sha256');
  hash.update(`${JSON.stringify(head)}\0${base}\0${diff.stdout}\0${untracked.stdout}\0`);
  for (const path of listedPaths(diff.stdout, untracked.stdout)) {
    const stat = await lstat(join(clone, path)).catch(() => null);
    hash.update(stat === null ? `${path}\0-\0` : `${path}\0${stat.size}\0${stat.mtimeMs}\0`);
  }
  return hash.digest('hex');
}
```

### Task 21: The attempt controller: seams, the serial queue and admission

`AttemptController` owns one attempt (design 13). This task adds its serial queue, keyed by attempt id and shared by every controller, its dependencies (`ControllerDeps`), and the seams M2c fills, each with a no-op default (X-7): `RunnerHealth`, `DependencyPreparer` and `Notifier`. `start_attempt` is admitted first: draining, a full capacity and a vendor that is not ready are refused with core's `draining`, `at_capacity` and `vendor_not_ready`, and then the health seam may refuse; a refusal reports `attempt.failed_to_start` with `refused` set and starts nothing (design 6.3, X-3). `test/fixture.ts`, the controller test fixture that M2d and M2e reuse, starts here.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import {
  AttemptSpecSchema,
  parseRunnerEvent,
  RunnerCommandSchema,
  START_REFUSALS,
  type StartRefusal,
} from '@agflow/core';
import type { AttemptController } from '../src/attempt/controller';
import { SerialQueue } from '../src/queue';
import { defaultHealth, type RunnerHealth, silentNotifier, skipDependencyPreparer } from '../src/seams';
import { cleanupRunnerFixtures, createRunnerFixture } from './fixture';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerFixtures);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

/** A promise and its resolve, for jobs the test releases by hand. */
function gate() {
  let open!: () => void;
  const opened = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    open = resolve;
  });
  return { open, opened };
}

describe('SerialQueue', () => {
  test("runs one attempt's work in order and different attempts' work concurrently", async () => {
    const queue = new SerialQueue();
    const order: string[] = [];
    const first = gate();
    const a1 = queue.run('T-4-a1', async () => {
      order.push('a1 start');
      await first.opened;
      order.push('a1 end');
    });
    const a2 = queue.run('T-4-a1', async () => {
      order.push('a2');
    });
    // Another attempt does not wait for T-4-a1's first job.
    await queue.run('T-5-a1', async () => {
      order.push('b1');
    });
    expect(order).toEqual(['a1 start', 'b1']);
    first.open();
    await Promise.all([a1, a2]);
    expect(order).toEqual(['a1 start', 'b1', 'a1 end', 'a2']);
  });

  test('a failed job does not block the next, and its caller gets the error', async () => {
    const queue = new SerialQueue();
    const failed = queue.run('T-4-a1', async () => {
      throw new Error('git failed');
    });
    const next = queue.run('T-4-a1', async () => 'ran');
    await expect(failed).rejects.toThrow('git failed');
    expect(await next).toBe('ran');
    await queue.idle('T-4-a1');
  });
});

describe('AttemptController admission', () => {
  test('draining, a full capacity and a vendor that is not ready are refused, and nothing starts', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    f.config.draining = true;
    expect(await f.controller('T-4-a1').start(f.spec())).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'draining' });
    f.config.draining = false;
    f.liveAttempts = f.config.capacity;
    const full = await f.controller('T-4-a2').start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-4-a2' }));
    expect(full).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'at_capacity' });
    f.liveAttempts = 0;
    f.ready.codex = false;
    const codex = await f.controller('T-4-a3').start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-4-a3', vendor: 'codex' }));
    expect(codex).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'vendor_not_ready' });
    const refused = f.events('attempt.failed_to_start');
    expect(refused.map((event) => [event.attemptId, event.data.refused])).toEqual([
      ['T-4-a1', 'draining'],
      ['T-4-a2', 'at_capacity'],
      ['T-4-a3', 'vendor_not_ready'],
    ]);
    expect(refused[0]?.fence).toEqual({ epoch: 1, counter: 1 });
    expect(f.events()).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(f.store.list()).toEqual([]);
    expect(f.fakes.claude?.launches).toEqual([]);
    expect(f.fakes.codex?.launches).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('two starts at once with one slot left: the first takes it, the second is refused at_capacity', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    f.config.capacity = 1;
    const controllers: AttemptController[] = [];
    // The runtime's count: the other controllers that hold a slot.
    const liveAttempts = (self: string) => () =>
      controllers.filter((controller) => controller.attemptId !== self && controller.holdsSlot).length;
    // A seam that takes its time, as a disk check does.
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      ...defaultHealth,
      admit: async () => {
        await Bun.sleep(20);
        return null;
      },
    };
    for (const attemptId of ['T-4-a1', 'T-5-a1']) {
      controllers.push(f.controller(attemptId, { health, liveAttempts: liveAttempts(attemptId) }));
    }
    const other = f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-5-a1', taskId: 'T-5', branch: 'agflow/T-5-x', wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1' });
    const [first, second] = await Promise.all([controllers[0]?.start(f.spec()), controllers[1]?.start(other)]);
    expect(first).toEqual({ started: true });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'at_capacity' });
    expect(controllers[0]?.holdsSlot).toBe(true);
    expect(controllers[1]?.holdsSlot).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a seam refusal gives the slot back', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    const controller = f.controller('T-4-a1', { health: { ...defaultHealth, admit: () => 'battery_low' } });
    expect(await controller.start(f.spec())).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'battery_low' });
    expect(controller.holdsSlot).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a vendor with no adapter is not ready', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    f.adapters.delete('codex');
    const result = await f.controller().start(f.spec({ vendor: 'codex' }));
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'vendor_not_ready' });
  });

  test("the core's checks come first, then the health seam, whose refusal is reported with its code", async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    const asked: string[] = [];
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      ...defaultHealth,
      admit: async (spec): Promise<StartRefusal> => {
        asked.push(spec.attemptId);
        return 'disk_low';
      },
    };
    f.config.draining = true;
    await f.controller('T-4-a1', { health }).start(f.spec());
    expect(asked).toEqual([]);
    f.config.draining = false;
    const result = await f.controller('T-4-a2', { health }).start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-4-a2' }));
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: 'disk_low' });
    expect(asked).toEqual(['T-4-a2']);
    expect(f.events('attempt.failed_to_start').at(-1)?.data).toMatchObject({ refused: 'disk_low' });
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a2')).toBeNull();
  });

  test('every START_REFUSALS code round-trips through parseRunnerEvent', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    for (const [index, code] of START_REFUSALS.entries()) {
      const attemptId = `T-4-a${index + 1}`;
      const health: RunnerHealth = { ...defaultHealth, admit: () => code };
      await f.controller(attemptId, { health }).start(f.spec({ attemptId }));
    }
    const events = f.events('attempt.failed_to_start');
    expect(events).toHaveLength(START_REFUSALS.length);
    for (const [index, event] of events.entries()) {
      const parsed = parseRunnerEvent(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(event)));
      expect(parsed.ok).toBe(true);
      if (parsed.ok && parsed.value.type === 'attempt.failed_to_start') {
        expect(parsed.value.data.refused).toBe(START_REFUSALS[index] as StartRefusal);
      }
    }
  });

  test('an admitted start is recorded as starting, with its fence', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    const controller = f.controller();
    expect(controller.fence).toBeNull();
    expect(await controller.start(f.spec({ fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 7 } }))).toEqual({ started: true });
    expect(controller.fence).toEqual({ epoch: 1, counter: 7 });
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ state: 'starting', fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 7 } });
    expect(f.events('attempt.failed_to_start')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('the fixture', () => {
  test("spec() builds a valid AttemptSpec, a worker's and a lead's, that a start_attempt carries", async () => {
```

```ts
// The runner test fixture: everything an AttemptController needs, on local files only. A temporary AGFLOW_HOME
// with runner.db and the runner's git files, a local bare origin and the project's vault, a fake adapter per
// vendor, an outbox reader, a hub HTTP that records what the runner posts, and a spec builder. Each test file calls
// cleanupRunnerFixtures from afterEach. M2d's tests reuse it.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { type AttemptSpec, restoreSet, type RunnerEvent, type Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import { FakeAdapter, type FakeScript, type OriginRepo, originRepo } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { AttemptController, type ControllerDeps } from '../src/attempt/controller';
import { AttemptStore } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { type RunnerConfig, type RunnerConfigInput, RunnerConfigSchema } from '../src/config';
import { openRunnerDb, type RunnerDb } from '../src/db';
import { ensureRunnerGitFiles, type GitEnvironment, localGitEnv, remoteGitEnv } from '../src/git/run';
import { Vault } from '../src/git/vault';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';
import { Outbox } from '../src/outbox';
import { type RunnerPaths, runnerPaths } from '../src/paths';
import { SerialQueue } from '../src/queue';
import { defaultHealth, silentNotifier, skipDependencyPreparer } from '../src/seams';

export const FIXTURE_PROJECT = 'demo-0123456789';
export const FIXTURE_WIP_PREFIX = 'refs/agflow/';

/** The fixture's agent token of an attempt: well-formed (agt_ and 43 base64url characters), and one per attempt. */
export function fixtureAgentToken(attemptId: string): string {
  return `agt_${createHash('sha256').update(attemptId).digest('base64url')}`;
}

/** Timings short enough for tests; runner.json's test block allows them. */
const TEST_TIMINGS = {
  stopInterrupt: 500,
  stopClose: 500,
  stopKill: 500,
  continuationWait: 100,
  finalPush: 5_000,
  hold: 2_000,
  handoff: 2_000,
};

/** What the runner posted to the hub over HTTP. */
export class RecordingHubHttp {
  readonly transcripts: { attemptId: string; transcript: string }[] = [];

  async uploadTranscript(attemptId: string, transcript: string): Promise<void> {
    this.transcripts.push({ attemptId, transcript });
  }
}

export interface RunnerFixtureOptions {
  /** Over the fixture's runner.json. */
  config?: Partial<RunnerConfigInput>;
  /** The origin's files on main. */
  files?: Record<string, string>;
  /** The fake adapters' script; one turn that does nothing by default. */
  script?: FakeScript | ((launch: Parameters<FakeAdapter['start']>[0]) => FakeScript);
  /** Adapters instead of the fake ones. */
  adapters?: VendorAdapter[];
}

export interface RunnerFixture {
  /** The temporary AGFLOW_HOME. */
  home: string;
  paths: RunnerPaths;

  config: RunnerConfig;
  db: RunnerDb;

  outbox: Outbox;
  queue: SerialQueue;

  vault: Vault;
  local: GitEnvironment;
  adapters: Map<Vendor, VendorAdapter>;
  /** The fake adapter of each vendor, unless the options gave adapters. */
  fakes: Partial<Record<Vendor, FakeAdapter>>;
  hub: RecordingHubHttp;
  logger: ReturnType<typeof memoryLogger>;
  /** What deps.liveAttempts() answers. */
  liveAttempts: number;
  /** What deps.vendorReady(vendor) answers. */
  ready: Record<Vendor, boolean>;
  /** The outbox's events, oldest first; only those of the type when one is given. */
  events<T extends RunnerEvent['type']>(type?: T): Extract<RunnerEvent, { type: T }>[];
  /**
   * A valid AttemptSpec for this fixture's origin: a worker of T-4 on claude, starting from main. Its agent token is
   * fixtureAgentToken of its attempt id, unless the overrides give one.
   */
  spec(overrides?: Partial<AttemptSpec>): AttemptSpec;
  deps(overrides?: Partial<ControllerDeps>): ControllerDeps;
  controller(attemptId?: string, overrides?: Partial<ControllerDeps>): AttemptController;
}

const cleanups: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];

/** Removes every fixture made since the last call, newest first. */
export async function cleanupRunnerFixtures(): Promise<void> {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) await cleanup();
}

function tempDir(prefix: string): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix));
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

export async function createRunnerFixture(options: RunnerFixtureOptions = {}): Promise<RunnerFixture> {
  const home = tempDir('agflow-fixture-home-');
  const paths = runnerPaths(home);
  ensureRunnerGitFiles(paths);
  const config = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
    runnerKey: 'runner-key-test',
    machineId: 'machine-test',
    name: 'test runner',
    test: { skipAuthChecks: true, allowShortTimings: true },
    ...options.config,
    timings: { ...TEST_TIMINGS, ...options.config?.timings },
  });
  const db = openRunnerDb(paths.db);
  cleanups.push(() => db.close());
  const origin = await originRepo(options.files ?? { 'README.md': '# demo\n', 'src/app.ts': 'app\n' });
  cleanups.push(() => origin.remove());
  // The owner's git configuration never reaches the vault's fetches: an empty HOME stands in for theirs.
  const ownerHome = tempDir('agflow-fixture-owner-');
  const vault = new Vault({
    paths,
    project: FIXTURE_PROJECT,
    repo: { url: origin.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
    remote: () => remoteGitEnv({ base: { ...process.env, HOME: ownerHome, XDG_CONFIG_HOME: undefined } }),
  });
  await vault.ensure();
  const fakes: Partial<Record<Vendor, FakeAdapter>> = {};
  const adapters = new Map<Vendor, VendorAdapter>();
  if (options.adapters) {
    for (const adapter of options.adapters) adapters.set(adapter.vendor, adapter);
  } else {
    for (const vendor of ['claude', 'codex'] as const) {
      const fake = new FakeAdapter({ vendor, skipAuthChecks: true, script: options.script ?? { turns: [[]] } });
      fakes[vendor] = fake;
      adapters.set(vendor, fake);
    }
  }
  const store = new AttemptStore(db);
  const outbox = new Outbox(db);
  const fixture: RunnerFixture = {
    home,
    paths,
    config,
    db,
    store,
    outbox,
    queue: new SerialQueue(),
    origin,
    vault,
    local: localGitEnv(paths),
    adapters,
    fakes,
    hub: new RecordingHubHttp(),
    logger: memoryLogger(),
    liveAttempts: 0,
    ready: { claude: true, codex: true },
    events: <T extends RunnerEvent['type']>(type?: T) =>
      outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => type === undefined || event.type === type) as Extract<
        RunnerEvent,
        { type: T }
      >[],
    spec: (overrides = {}) => ({
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      taskId: 'T-4',
      role: 'worker',
      vendor: 'claude',
      model: null,
      fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 1 },
      agentToken: fixtureAgentToken(overrides.attemptId ?? 'T-4-a1'),
      hubUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:9',
      repo: { url: origin.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
      start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null },
      branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy',
      wipRef: `${FIXTURE_WIP_PREFIX}T-4/a1`,
      restore: { paths: restoreSet(null), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
      acceptanceIds: ['A1'],
      toolCaps: { defaultMs: 30 * 60_000, longMs: 90 * 60_000, checks: [] },
      taskPack: '# T-4 Tidy the app\n',
      brief: 'You are an agflow worker on T-4.',
      firstPrompt: 'Start working on T-4.',
      successor: false,
      ...overrides,
    }),
    deps: (overrides = {}) => ({
      config: () => fixture.config,
      paths,
      store,
      outbox,
      queue: fixture.queue,
      vault,
      local: fixture.local,
      adapters,
      health: defaultHealth,
      preparer: skipDependencyPreparer,
      notifier: silentNotifier,
      logger: fixture.logger,
      liveAttempts: () => fixture.liveAttempts,
      vendorReady: (vendor) => fixture.ready[vendor],
      ...overrides,
    }),
    controller: (attemptId = 'T-4-a1', overrides = {}) => new AttemptController(attemptId, fixture.deps(overrides)),
  };
  return fixture;
}
```

```ts
// The attempt controller (design 13): one per attempt, owning everything about it that is not vendor-specific. Its
// lifecycle and git work runs on the attempt's serial queue, one job at a time. A start is admitted first (X-3):
// a draining runner, a full capacity, a vendor that is not ready and the health seam each refuse it with one of
// core's START_REFUSALS, reported as attempt.failed_to_start with refused set, and nothing starts.
import type { AttemptPhase, AttemptSpec, Fence, StartRefusal, Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import type { VendorAdapter } from '../adapters/types';
import type { AttemptStore } from '../attempt-store';
import type { RunnerConfig } from '../config';
import type { GitEnvironment } from '../git/run';
import type { Vault } from '../git/vault';
import type { Logger } from '../log';
import type { NewEvent, Outbox } from '../outbox';
import type { RunnerPaths } from '../paths';
import type { SerialQueue } from '../queue';
import type { DependencyPreparer, Notifier, RunnerHealth } from '../seams';

export interface ControllerDeps {
  /** The runner's settings as they are now: capacity, draining, models and timings change while it runs. */
  config(): RunnerConfig;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  store: AttemptStore;
  outbox: Outbox;
  /** Shared by every controller; each runs its work under its attempt id. */
  queue: SerialQueue;
  /** The project's vault. */
  vault: Vault;
  /** The local environment, localGitEnv(paths). */
  local: GitEnvironment;
  adapters: ReadonlyMap<Vendor, VendorAdapter>;
  health: RunnerHealth;
  preparer: DependencyPreparer;
  notifier: Notifier;
  logger: Logger;
  /** The attempts that hold a capacity slot now (holdsSlot: a live process or a start under way), this one excluded. */
  liveAttempts(): number;
  /** Whether the vendor's last preflight found it ready. */
  vendorReady(vendor: Vendor): boolean;
}

export type StartOutcome = { started: true } | { started: false; refused: StartRefusal | null; error: string };

export class AttemptController {
  private currentFence: Fence | null = null;
  private currentPhase: AttemptPhase | null = null;

  constructor(
    readonly attemptId: string,
    private readonly deps: ControllerDeps,
  ) {}

  /** The attempt's fence: its spec's, then each resume's; null before a start. */
  get fence(): Fence | null {
    return this.currentFence;
  }

  /**
   * Whether the attempt holds a capacity slot: from the moment its start passes the core's checks, through its live
   * process, until its exit. The runtime counts these for every other controller's admission.
   */
  get holdsSlot(): boolean {
    return this.currentPhase !== null;
  }

  /** Runs a job on this attempt's serial queue. */
  enqueue<T>(job: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.deps.queue.run(this.attemptId, job);
  }

  /** start_attempt: admission first; a refused start reports attempt.failed_to_start and starts nothing. */
  start(spec: AttemptSpec): Promise<StartOutcome> {
    return this.enqueue(async () => {
      const refusal = await this.admit(spec);
      if (refusal !== null) {
        const data = { error: refusal.error, refused: refusal.code };
        this.report(spec.fence, { type: 'attempt.failed_to_start', data });
        return { started: false, refused: refusal.code, error: refusal.error };
      }
      this.currentFence = spec.fence;
      const { store } = this.deps;
      if (store.get(spec.attemptId) === null) store.create(spec, { clone: null, tmpDir: null, cliVersion: null });
      return { started: true };
    });
  }

  /** The core's checks in order, then the health seam's; null admits the start. */
  private async admit(spec: AttemptSpec): Promise<{ code: StartRefusal; error: string } | null> {
    const config = this.deps.config();
    if (config.draining) return { code: 'draining', error: 'the runner is draining and takes no new attempts' };
    if (this.deps.liveAttempts() >= config.capacity) {
      return { code: 'at_capacity', error: `the runner is at its capacity of ${config.capacity} attempts` };
    }
    if (!this.deps.adapters.has(spec.vendor) || !this.deps.vendorReady(spec.vendor)) {
      return { code: 'vendor_not_ready', error: `${spec.vendor} is not ready on this runner` };
    }
    // The slot is taken before the seam is asked, with no await since the capacity check, so a start of another
    // attempt admitted meanwhile counts it; a refusal gives it back.
    const previous = this.currentPhase;
    this.currentPhase = 'starting';
    let code: StartRefusal | null;
    try {
      code = await this.deps.health.admit(spec);
    } catch (error) {
      this.currentPhase = previous;
      throw error;
    }
    if (code === null) return null;
    this.currentPhase = previous;
    return { code, error: `the runner refused the start: ${code}` };
  }

  /** Appends one of this attempt's events with the fence it belongs to. */
  private report(fence: Fence, event: DistributiveOmit<AttemptEvent, 'attemptId' | 'fence'>): void {
    this.deps.outbox.append({ ...event, attemptId: this.attemptId, fence } as NewEvent);
  }
}

type AttemptEvent = Extract<NewEvent, { attemptId: string }>;
type DistributiveOmit<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? Omit<T, K> : never;
```

**File:** `packages/runner/src/queue.ts` (new)

```ts
// The serial queue (design 13): an attempt's lifecycle and git work runs one job at a time, in the order it was
// queued, while different attempts' work runs concurrently. A job that fails releases the queue like one that
// succeeds; its caller gets the error.

export class SerialQueue {
  private readonly tails = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();

  /** Runs job once every job queued earlier under the same key has settled. */
  run<T>(key: string, job: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const previous = this.tails.get(key) ?? Promise.resolve();
    const result = previous.then(job);
    const tail = result.then(
      () => {},
      () => {},
    );
    this.tails.set(key, tail);
    void tail.then(() => {
      if (this.tails.get(key) === tail) this.tails.delete(key);
    });
    return result;
  }

  /** Resolves once every job queued so far under the key has settled. */
  idle(key: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.tails.get(key) ?? Promise.resolve();
  }
}
```

```ts
// The seams M2c fills (X-7), each with a default that changes nothing, so the runner core runs and is tested without
// the service around it: RunnerHealth (admission, heartbeat health and the reported state), DependencyPreparer
// (design 7.7) and Notifier (design 6.10).
import type { AttemptSpec, Runner, RunnerMessage, StartRefusal, Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import type { Vault } from './git/vault';

type Hello = Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'hello' }>;

/** What each heartbeat carries about the machine. */
export interface HealthReport {
  power: Runner['power'];
  disk: Runner['disk'];
  /** Ms from now during which the runner takes no new attempt (wake, battery, disk); null when it takes them. */
  acceptingUntil: number | null;
}

/** The state hello and runner.state report. */
export interface HealthState {
  state: Hello['state'];
  detail: string | null;
}

export interface RunnerHealth {
  /** Asked for each start_attempt after the core's own checks: one of core's START_REFUSALS, or null to admit. */
  admit(spec: AttemptSpec): StartRefusal | null | Promise<StartRefusal | null>;
  heartbeat(): HealthReport;
  state(): HealthState;
}

/** Admits every start and reports nothing about the machine. */
export const defaultHealth: RunnerHealth = Object.freeze({
  admit: () => null,
  heartbeat: () => ({ power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
  state: () => ({ state: 'ok' as const, detail: null }),
});

export interface PrepareInput {
  attemptId: string;
  vendor: Vendor;
  clone: string;
  /**
   * The project's vault: the preparer reads its config there at baseSha, and restores the protected paths through it
   * (restoreProtected) before it runs anything in the clone.
   */
  vault: Vault;
  /** The restore base (X-16). */
  baseSha: string;
  /** The agent environment the preparation runs with. */
  env: Record<string, string>;
  /** The prepare_dependencies command's id; null for a preparation before a start or resume (X-40). */
  requestId: string | null;
}

/** What attempt.prepared reports; ran is false when the project configures no preparation. */
export interface PrepareOutcome {
  ran: boolean;
  ok: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  logTail: string | null;
}

export interface DependencyPreparer {
  /** Whether this runner can prepare dependencies at all; it feeds hello's profile.dependencyPrep. */
  readonly available: boolean;
  prepare(input: PrepareInput): Promise<PrepareOutcome>;
}

/** Prepares nothing and reports that it cannot. */
export const skipDependencyPreparer: DependencyPreparer = Object.freeze({
  available: false,
  prepare: async () => ({ ran: false, ok: true, error: null, logTail: null }),
});

export interface Notification {
  /**
   * The kind of notification. A notifier may drop a repeat of a key it showed recently (M2c's macOS notifier drops
   * repeats within NOTIFY_REPEAT_MS); it never replaces a notification already shown.
   */
  key: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
}

export interface Notifier {
  notify(notification: Notification): void | Promise<void>;
}

/** Posts nothing. */
export const silentNotifier: Notifier = Object.freeze({ notify: () => {} });
```

### Task 22: The attempt controller: preparing the clone for a start

Before an agent runs, `start_attempt` prepares its clone (design 7.3, 7.7, 9.2): fetch, create the task or lead clone at the start tip the vault holds (an existing clone is kept), delete `.claude/.cc-writes/`, write `.agflow/run` with the brief plus the working-directory line (X-17), resolve the restore base and restore protected paths. Protected changes between the base and the start commit are reported once as `attempt.violation` phase `start` (X-28). A Claude attempt gets a base checkout of main and a private `/tmp/agf/<id>`; a Codex attempt gets neither, and `projectConfigVerified` compares its `.codex/` with the restore base through the vault (X-5). A worker's dependencies are prepared through the seam; a failure reports `attempt.prepared` and then `attempt.failed_to_start` (X-40). Leads get no preparation. Reset an existing record's `finalizedAt` before workspace work begins; a failed start remains unfinalized.

```ts
/** Every file under dir, with its content, links shown as links. */
function snapshotOf(dir: string): Record<string, string> {
  const files: Record<string, string> = {};
  const walk = (relative: string) => {
    for (const name of readdirSync(join(dir, relative))) {
      const path = relative === '' ? name : `${relative}/${name}`;
      const stat = lstatSync(join(dir, path));
      if (stat.isDirectory()) walk(path);
      else files[path] = stat.isSymbolicLink() ? 'link' : readFileSync(join(dir, path), 'utf8');
    }
  };
  walk('');
  return files;
}

};

/** A preparer that records each call and the controller's phase during it. */
function recordingPreparer(outcome: { ok: boolean; error?: string }, phase: () => AttemptPhase | null) {
  const calls: { input: PrepareInput; phase: AttemptPhase | null }[] = [];
  const preparer: DependencyPreparer = {
    available: true,
    prepare: async (input) => {
      calls.push({ input, phase: phase() });
      return { ran: true, ok: outcome.ok, error: outcome.error ?? null, logTail: outcome.ok ? null : 'npm ERR!' };

  };
  return { calls, preparer };
}

    symlinkSync(home, clone);
    const events = f.events().length;
    const result = await f.controller().start(f.spec());
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: null });
    const reported = f.events().slice(events);
    expect(reported.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual(['attempt.failed_to_start']);
    expect(reported[0]?.data).toMatchObject({ error: expect.stringMatching(/^cannot prepare the clone: .*not a directory/) });
    expect(snapshotOf(home)).toEqual(before);
    expect(lstatSync(clone).isSymbolicLink()).toBe(true);
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.clone).not.toBe(realpathSync(home));
  });

  test('an existing clone is kept, not recreated', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ files: FILES });

    const ino = statSync(join(clone, '.git')).ino;

    expect(again.workspace).toMatchObject({ created: false, startSha: f.origin.mainSha });
    expect(readFileSync(join(clone, 'notes.txt'), 'utf8')).toBe('the agent was here\n');

  test('projectConfigVerified is true after the restore, and false when an untracked file stays under .codex/', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ files: { ...FILES, '.gitignore': '.codex/*.local.toml\n' } });
    const clone = f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1');

    expect(controller.workspace?.projectConfigVerified).toBe(true);
    const git = { vault: f.vault, local: f.local };
    const base = await resolveRestoreBase(f.vault, f.spec());
    expect(await verifyProjectConfig({ ...git, clone, base })).toBe(true);
    // Codex reads every file there, ignored ones too.
    writeFileSync(join(clone, '.codex', 'override.local.toml'), 'model = "mine"\n');
    expect(await verifyProjectConfig({ ...git, clone, base })).toBe(false);
    writeFileSync(join(clone, '.codex', 'extra.toml'), 'model = "other"\n');
    expect(await verifyProjectConfig({ ...git, clone, base })).toBe(false);
    // A changed tracked file is not verified either.
    writeFileSync(join(clone, '.codex', 'config.toml'), 'model = "changed"\n');
    expect(await verifyProjectConfig({ ...git, clone, base })).toBe(false);

    const again = f.controller();
    expect(await again.start(f.spec(CODEX_SPEC))).toEqual({ started: true });
    expect(readdirSync(join(clone, '.codex'))).toEqual(['config.toml']);
    expect(readFileSync(join(clone, '.codex', 'config.toml'), 'utf8')).toBe(FILES['.codex/config.toml']);

  test('a git failure with a huge error is reported clipped, and every later start from there too', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ files: FILES });
    // A tree of names no file system takes: the checkout fails with a line for each.
    const origin = f.origin.path;
    const blob = await gitIn(origin, ['hash-object', '-w', '--stdin'], { input: 'x\n' });
    const names = Array.from({ length: 3_500 }, (_, i) => `100644 blob ${blob}\t${'n'.repeat(300)}${i}\n`).join('');
    const tree = await gitIn(origin, ['mktree'], { input: names });
    const commit = await gitIn(origin, ['commit-tree', tree, '-p', f.origin.mainSha, '-m', 'unreadable names']);
    await gitIn(origin, ['update-ref', 'refs/heads/agflow/T-4-tidy', commit]);
    const spec = f.spec({ start: { ref: 'refs/heads/agflow/T-4-tidy', sha: commit } });
    for (const attempt of [1, 2]) {
      const controller = f.controller();
      expect(await controller.start(spec)).toMatchObject({ started: false, refused: null });
      const failed = f.events('attempt.failed_to_start');
      expect(failed).toHaveLength(attempt);
      const error = failed.at(-1)?.data.error as string;
      expect(error.startsWith('cannot prepare the clone')).toBe(true);
      expect(error.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(START_ERROR_MAX);
      expect(controller.phase).toBeNull();
    }
  }, 60_000);

    const start = await commitFiles(f.origin.path, { branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy', files, message: 'editor config' });
    const controller = f.controller();
    expect(await controller.start(f.spec({ start: { ref: 'refs/heads/agflow/T-4-tidy', sha: start } }))).toEqual({
      started: true,
    });
    const [violation] = f.events('attempt.violation');
    const paths = violation?.data.paths as string[];
    expect(paths.length).toBeLessThan(300);
    expect(paths.at(-1)).toBe(`… and ${300 - (paths.length - 1)} more`);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(paths.join('\n'))).toBeLessThan(VIOLATION_PATHS_MAX_BYTES + 100);
    expect(clipViolationPaths(['a', 'b'], 100)).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
    expect(clipViolationPaths(['aaaa', 'bbbb', 'cccc'], 10)).toEqual(['aaaa', 'bbbb', '… and 1 more']);
  }, 30_000);

  test('a recorded Claude tmp dir replaced by a link is left alone, and a new one made', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ files: FILES });
    const first = f.controller();
    await first.start(f.spec());
    const recorded = first.workspace?.tmpDir as string;
    const elsewhere = tempDir('agflow-elsewhere-');
    rmSync(recorded, { recursive: true, force: true });
    symlinkSync(elsewhere, recorded);
    const again = f.controller();
    expect(await again.start(f.spec())).toEqual({ started: true });
    const tmpDir = again.workspace?.tmpDir as string;
    expect(tmpDir).not.toBe(recorded);
    expect(lstatSync(tmpDir).isDirectory()).toBe(true);
    expect(lstatSync(recorded).isSymbolicLink()).toBe(true);
    expect(readdirSync(elsewhere)).toEqual([]);
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.tmpDir).toBe(tmpDir);
    // A recorded directory that is still the private one is kept.
    const kept = f.controller();
    await kept.start(f.spec());
    expect(kept.workspace?.tmpDir).toBe(tmpDir);
  });
});
```

```ts
// A start's work before the agent runs (design 7.3, "Attempt clone", "Starting point", "Protected paths at a
// start", "Base checkouts"). The vault is fetched, the clone made at the start tip the vault actually holds (an
// existing clone is kept, at the start it was made at), the Claude CLI's staging directory removed, .agflow/run/
// written with the brief extended by the clone's path (X-17), and the protected paths restored from the restore base
// (X-16). A Claude attempt also gets a base checkout of main and a private temporary directory (X-5). Right before
// the agent starts, after any dependency preparation, finishWorkspace restores the protected paths once more and
// verifies the clone's .codex/ (design 9.2).
// The clone and the recorded temporary directory belong to the agent, which can replace either with a link: the
// runner never follows their last component, and refuses the start when anything but a directory stands there.
import { lstat, mkdtemp, realpath, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { type AttemptSpec, localPinRefs, matchesProtectedPattern } from '@agflow/core';
import type { AttemptStore } from '../attempt-store';
import type { RunnerConfig } from '../config';
import { cloneExists, createLeadClone, createTaskClone } from '../git/clone';
import { detectProtected, resolveRestoreBase, restoreProtected } from '../git/protect';
import { type GitEnvironment, runGit } from '../git/run';
import type { BaseCheckout, Vault } from '../git/vault';
import { makeAttemptTmpDir, type RunnerPaths } from '../paths';
import { type RunDir, withWorkingDirectory, writeRunDir } from '../run-dir';

export interface WorkspaceDeps {
  config(): RunnerConfig;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  store: AttemptStore;
  vault: Vault;
  local: GitEnvironment;
  wipRefPrefix(): string;
  /** Where Claude attempts' private temporary directories go: /tmp. */
  tmpRoot: string;
}

export interface PreparedWorkspace {
  /** The clone's real path, the agent's cwd. */
  clone: string;
  /** False when the clone existed and was kept. */
  created: boolean;
  /** The commit the clone was made at: attempt.spawned.startSha. */
  startSha: string;
  /** The restore base (X-16). */
  base: string;
  runDir: RunDir;
  /** spec.brief plus the working-directory line, as .agflow/run/brief.md holds it. */
  brief: string;
  /** Protected paths the start commit changed against the base: restored in the clone, stripped from pushes. */
  violations: string[];
  /** Claude's project configuration root; null for Codex. */
  baseCheckout: BaseCheckout | null;
  /** Claude's CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR, <tmpRoot>/agf/<id>; null for Codex. */
  tmpDir: string | null;
  /**
   * The clone's .codex/ equals the restore base's (design 9.2); set by finishWorkspace right before the launch, after
   * any dependency preparation, and false until then.
   */
  projectConfigVerified: boolean;
}

/** The longest error text a start reports: a git failure's stderr can carry a line per file. */
export const START_ERROR_MAX = 4_000;
/** The most bytes of paths one start's attempt.violation lists; the outbox takes no event over 1 MB. */
export const VIOLATION_PATHS_MAX_BYTES = 16 * 1024;

/** An error text cut to START_ERROR_MAX characters, an ellipsis marking the cut. */
export function clipStartError(text: string): string {
  return text.length <= START_ERROR_MAX ? text : `${text.slice(0, START_ERROR_MAX - 1)}…`;
}

/** The first paths within maxBytes, and one '… and N more' entry for the rest. */
export function clipViolationPaths(paths: readonly string[], maxBytes: number = VIOLATION_PATHS_MAX_BYTES): string[] {
  const kept: string[] = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const path of paths) {
    bytes += Buffer.byteLength(path) + 1;
    if (bytes > maxBytes) break;
    kept.push(path);
  }
  return kept.length === paths.length ? kept : [...kept, `… and ${paths.length - kept.length} more`];
}

/**
 * Refuses a clone path where something other than a directory stands: a link the agent planted, or a file. Every
 * use of a recorded clone checks it first; a clone that does not exist passes.
 */
export async function assertCloneDirectory(path: string): Promise<void> {
  const stat = await lstat(path).catch(() => null);
  if (stat !== null && !stat.isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error(`${path} is not a directory: something other than the clone stands in its place`);
  }
}

/**
 * The clone's real path, for every use of it: the runner-owned parent is resolved (/tmp is /private/tmp), the last
 * component never is, since the agent can replace its clone with a link to anywhere. Throws when anything but a
 * directory stands at the path.
 */
export async function realClonePath(path: string): Promise<string> {
  await assertCloneDirectory(path);
  return join(await realpath(dirname(path)), basename(path));
}

/** The commit a vault ref names, or null. */
async function commitOf(vault: Vault, local: GitEnvironment, ref: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const args = [`--git-dir=${vault.path}`, 'rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', `${ref}^{commit}`];
  const result = await runGit(local, args, { check: false });
  const sha = result.stdout.trim();
  return result.code === 0 && sha !== '' ? sha : null;
}

/** Makes the clone, or keeps the one there; gives the commit it was made at. */
async function ensureClone(deps: WorkspaceDeps, spec: AttemptSpec, clone: string) {
  const { vault, local } = deps;
  const target = { vault, local, attemptId: spec.attemptId, clone };
  if (cloneExists(clone)) {
    const pinned = await commitOf(vault, local, localPinRefs(spec.attemptId).start);
    if (pinned !== null) return { created: false, startSha: pinned };
  }
  const { sha } = await vault.resolveStart(spec.start);
  let created: boolean;
  if (spec.role === 'lead') {
    created = (await createLeadClone({ ...target, startSha: sha })).created;
  } else {
    if (spec.branch === null) throw new Error(`the worker attempt ${spec.attemptId} has no task branch`);
    created = (await createTaskClone({ ...target, branch: spec.branch, startSha: sha })).created;
  }
  // A kept clone that lost its start pin is pinned at the start it resolves to now.
  if (!created) await vault.pin(spec.attemptId, { start: sha });
  return { created, startSha: sha };
}

/**
 * Whether a recorded temporary directory is still the private one makeAttemptTmpDir made: a real directory, not a
 * link, of this user, mode 0700, directly under <tmpRoot>/agf/. The agent can write there, so anything else is left
 * alone and a new directory made.
 */
async function reusableTmpDir(recorded: string | null, tmpRoot: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (recorded === null || dirname(recorded) !== join(tmpRoot, 'agf')) return false;
  const stat = await lstat(recorded).catch(() => null);
  if (stat === null || !stat.isDirectory() || (stat.mode & 0o777) !== 0o700) return false;
  return process.getuid === undefined || stat.uid === process.getuid();
}

/**
 * Deletes the Claude CLI's untracked staging directory, which is never a violation (X-28). .claude must be a real
 * directory: through a link the delete would reach outside the clone.
 */
async function removeStaging(clone: string): Promise<void> {
  const claude = await lstat(join(clone, '.claude')).catch(() => null);
  if (claude?.isDirectory()) await rm(join(clone, '.claude', '.cc-writes'), { recursive: true, force: true });
}

const CODEX_CONFIG = '.codex/**';

/**
 * Whether the clone's .codex/ equals the restore base's (design 9.2), compared through the vault with a temporary
 * index and --work-tree, never with git in the clone: every tracked file the same, and nothing else there, not even
 * an ignored file, since Codex reads them all. Paths are matched in code, case-insensitively.
 */
export async function verifyProjectConfig(input: {
  vault: Vault;
  local: GitEnvironment;
  clone: string;
  base: string;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-verify-'));
  try {
    const git = (args: string[]) =>
      runGit(input.local, [`--git-dir=${input.vault.path}`, `--work-tree=${input.clone}`, ...args], {
        cwd: input.clone,
        env: { GIT_INDEX_FILE: join(dir, 'index') },
        check: false,
      });
    await git(['read-tree', input.base]);
    await git(['update-index', '-q', '--refresh']);
    const changed = await git(['diff-files', '-z', '--name-only', '--ignore-submodules=all']);
    // --directory lists an untracked directory once ("node_modules/") instead of every file in it.
    const untracked = await git(['ls-files', '-z', '--others', '--directory']);
    if (changed.code !== 0 || untracked.code !== 0) return false;
    const paths = `${changed.stdout}${untracked.stdout}`.split('\0').filter((path) => path !== '');
    return !paths.some((path) => matchesProtectedPattern(path.replace(/\/+$/, ''), CODEX_CONFIG));
  } finally {
    await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

/**
 * Steps 1-3 of the attempt clone, and the base checkout and temporary directory of a Claude attempt. The
 * preparation of dependencies (step 4) is the controller's, through its seam, and finishWorkspace follows it.
 */
export async function prepareWorkspace(deps: WorkspaceDeps, spec: AttemptSpec): Promise<PreparedWorkspace> {
  const { vault, local, paths } = deps;
  const path = paths.clone(vault.project, spec.attemptId);
  // A link left at the clone path stays there for forensics; nothing is done through it.
  await assertCloneDirectory(path);
  await vault.fetchForAttempt({ taskId: spec.taskId, start: spec.start }, deps.wipRefPrefix());
  const { created, startSha } = await ensureClone(deps, spec, path);
  const clone = await realClonePath(path);
  await removeStaging(clone);
  const brief = withWorkingDirectory(spec.brief, clone);
  const runDir = writeRunDir({
    clone,
    tools: paths.agentTools(vault.project, spec.attemptId),
    taskPack: spec.taskPack,
    brief,
    identity: deps.config().commitIdentity,
  });
  const git = { vault, local };
  const base = await resolveRestoreBase(vault, spec);
  const changes = await detectProtected(git, { base, head: startSha, paths: spec.restore.paths });
  await restoreProtected(git, { clone, base, paths: spec.restore.paths });
  let baseCheckout: BaseCheckout | null = null;
  let tmpDir: string | null = null;
  if (spec.vendor === 'claude') {
    baseCheckout = await vault.acquireBaseCheckout(spec.attemptId);
    try {
      const recorded = deps.store.get(spec.attemptId)?.tmpDir ?? null;
      tmpDir = (await reusableTmpDir(recorded, deps.tmpRoot)) ? recorded : makeAttemptTmpDir({ root: deps.tmpRoot });
    } catch (error) {
      await baseCheckout.release();
      throw error;
    }
  }
  return {
    clone,
    created,
    startSha,
    base,
    runDir,
    brief,
    violations: [...new Set(changes.map((change) => change.path))].sort(),
    baseCheckout,
    tmpDir,
    projectConfigVerified: false,
  };
}

/**
 * The last step before the agent starts (design 9.2): when a dependency preparation ran, which may run the
 * project's scripts in the clone, the protected paths are restored once more, so the agent starts with the base's
 * agent config; then the clone's .codex/ is verified against the restore base.
 */
export async function finishWorkspace(
  deps: Pick<WorkspaceDeps, 'vault' | 'local'>,
  spec: Pick<AttemptSpec, 'restore'>,
  workspace: PreparedWorkspace,
  options: { prepared: boolean },
): Promise<void> {
  const { vault, local } = deps;
  const { clone, base } = workspace;
  if (options.prepared) await restoreProtected({ vault, local }, { clone, base, paths: spec.restore.paths });
  workspace.projectConfigVerified = await verifyProjectConfig({ vault, local, clone, base });
}
```

### Task 23: The attempt controller: launching the agent

The controller builds `AgentLaunch` and starts the adapter (design 13, 7.4, 7.6, 10): the model, the CLI version for this vendor, recorded with the attempt (X-13), the agent environment with the token in memory only, the bridge `<agflow> mcp --vendor <v> --runner` with `bridgeEnvOf` as its environment (X-32), the brief with the working-directory line (X-17), the profile, the private tmp directory and the attempt log. `launch.bridge.tools` names the agflow tools the bridge serves for the agent's role, unprefixed, from the new `BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES` in `adapters/bridge-tools.ts`: the runner never imports `packages/cli`, and Codex's Code Mode defers MCP tools, so M2e names them in the thread's developer instructions before the agent starts (design 9.2). `registerProcess` records pid, pgid and lstart before any of the agent's output is read. `start()` resolves once the agent is launched; `attempt.spawned` follows the adapter's `started` event, and an adapter failure reports `attempt.failed_to_start` with `refused` null.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { FakeAdapter, type FakeScript } from '@agflow/testkit';
import { BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES } from '../src/adapters/bridge-tools';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentSession, VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { bridgeEnvOf } from '../src/env';
import { type ProcessIdentity, processIdentity } from '../src/processes';
import { VENDOR_PINS } from '../src/vendor/pins';
import {
  cleanupRunnerFixtures,
  createRunnerFixture,
  FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
  FIXTURE_PROJECT,
  fixtureAgentToken,
  waitFor,
} from './fixture';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerFixtures);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

/** The fixture's attempts start with darwin-arm64's pin, on every platform. */
const CLAUDE_PIN = VENDOR_PINS['darwin-arm64']?.claude.version as string;

/** The bridge variables design 7.6 lists, which the bridge's own environment must hold. */
const BRIDGE_VARIABLES = [
  'AGFLOW_AGENT_TOKEN',
  'AGFLOW_HUB_URL',
  'AGFLOW_ATTEMPT_ID',
  'AGFLOW_ROLE',
  'AGFLOW_CLONE',
  'AGFLOW_BRIDGE_POLL_MS',
  'AGFLOW_BRIDGE_POLL_MAX_MS',
  'AGFLOW_CONFIG_DIR',
  'NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA',
];

/** An adapter that hands every call to the fake, with hooks around start and the first event read. */
function wrappedAdapter(
  fake: FakeAdapter,
  hooks: { start?: () => void; firstRead?: (session: AgentSession) => void },
): VendorAdapter {
  return {
    vendor: fake.vendor,
    preflight: () => fake.preflight(),
    readTranscriptTail: (input) => fake.readTranscriptTail(input),
    deleteTranscript: (input) => fake.deleteTranscript(input),
    async start(launch) {
      hooks.start?.();
      const session = await fake.start(launch);
      let read = false;
      const events: AsyncIterable<AgentEvent> = {
        [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => {
          const inner = session.events[Symbol.asyncIterator]();
          return {
            next: () => {
              if (!read) {
                read = true;
                hooks.firstRead?.(session);
              }
              return inner.next();
            },
          };
        },
      };
      return Object.assign(Object.create(session) as AgentSession, { events });
    },
  };
}

describe('AttemptController: launching the agent', () => {
  test('starts the agent in the clone with the agent environment, the bridge and the brief', async () => {
    const script: FakeScript = { turns: [[{ do: 'tool', command: 'pwd -P > where.txt' }]] };
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ script });
    expect(await f.controller().start(f.spec())).toEqual({ started: true });
    const clone = realpathSync(f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1'));

    expect(launch.clone).toBe(clone);

    expect(launch.bridge.env).toEqual(bridgeEnvOf(launch.env));

    expect(launch.firstPrompt).toBe('Start working on T-4.');
    expect(launch.resume).toBeNull();
    expect(launch.logFile).toBe(f.paths.attemptLog('T-4-a1'));

    await waitFor(() => existsSync(where) && readFileSync(where, 'utf8') !== '');

    const f = await createRunnerFixture();

    f.adapters.set(

        start: () => {

    );
    const outcome = await f.controller().start(f.spec());
    expect(outcome).toEqual({
      started: false,
      refused: null,
      error: expect.stringContaining('the claude binary is missing'),
    });
    expect(f.events('attempt.failed_to_start').map((event) => event.data)).toEqual([

  });

  test('a vendor with no CLI pin for this platform gives attempt.failed_to_start and releases the base checkout', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture();
    const cliVersion = (): string => {
      throw new Error('agflow pins no claude CLI for linux-x64');
    };
    const outcome = await f.controller('T-4-a1', { cliVersion }).start(f.spec());
    expect(outcome).toEqual({
      started: false,
      refused: null,
      error: expect.stringContaining('agflow pins no claude CLI for linux-x64'),
    });
    expect(f.events('attempt.failed_to_start').map((event) => event.data)).toEqual([
      { error: expect.stringContaining('agflow pins no claude CLI for linux-x64'), refused: null },
    ]);
    expect(f.fakes.claude?.launches).toEqual([]);
    expect(existsSync(f.paths.baseCheckout(FIXTURE_PROJECT, f.origin.mainSha))).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The agflow tools a runner agent's bridge serves (design 10): `agflow mcp --vendor <v> --runner` lists them by the
// role AGFLOW_ROLE names, without the MCP prefix. The runner never imports packages/cli, so the names live here and
// reach the adapters as AgentLaunch.bridge.tools before the agent starts: Codex's Code Mode defers MCP tools, so M2e
// names them in the thread's developerInstructions, which survive compaction (design 9.2). packages/cli's
// runner-tools test checks that runnerToolsFor(role) serves exactly these names, so the two cannot drift.
import type { AgentRole } from '@agflow/core';

export const BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES: Readonly<Record<AgentRole, readonly string[]>> = Object.freeze({
  worker: Object.freeze([
    'hello',
    'get_brief',
    'get_goal',
    'list_tasks',
    'get_task',
    'check_inbox',
    'ack_messages',
    'send_message',
    'search',
    'report_progress',
    'write_handoff',
    'declare_blocked',
    'declare_impossible',
    'release_task',
    'submit',
    'prepare_dependencies',
  ]),
  lead: Object.freeze([
    'hello',
    'get_brief',
    'get_goal',
    'list_tasks',
    'get_task',
    'check_inbox',
    'ack_messages',
    'send_message',
    'search',
    'get_status',
    'create_tasks',
    'update_task',
    'cancel_task',
    'accept_task',
    'reject_task',
    'unblock_task',
    'mark_merged',
    'add_goal_note',
    'get_events',
    'request_agents',
    'replace_agent',
    'stop_agent',
    'write_handoff',
    'get_lead_notes',
  ]),
});
```

```ts
// Launching the agent (design 13, 7.4, 7.6, 10). The controller hands the adapter one AgentLaunch: the model the
// runner resolved, the CLI version (the current pin for a new attempt, recorded so every resume and take-over runs
// the same one, X-13), the agent environment with the agent token held only in memory, the bridge command with its
// own environment (X-32), the brief with the clone's path (X-17), the profile, the temporary directory and the
// attempt log. registerProcess records the agent's group in runner.db; the controller reads no event before that
// record is written.
import type { AttemptSpec, Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import { BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES } from '../adapters/bridge-tools';
import type { AgentLaunch, AgflowCommand } from '../adapters/types';
import type { AttemptStore, ProcessRecord } from '../attempt-store';
import type { RunnerConfig } from '../config';
import { bridgeEnvOf, buildAgentEnv } from '../env';
import type { Logger } from '../log';
import type { RunnerPaths } from '../paths';
import { type ProcessIdentity, processIdentity, recordGroup } from '../processes';
import { profileOf } from '../profile';
import { VENDOR_PINS, vendorPlatform } from '../vendor/pins';
import type { PreparedWorkspace } from './workspace';

/** The CLI version a new attempt of the vendor starts with: this platform's pin. */
export function pinnedCliVersion(vendor: Vendor, platform: string = vendorPlatform()): string {
  const pins = VENDOR_PINS[platform];
  if (!pins) throw new Error(`agflow pins no ${vendor} CLI for ${platform}`);
  return pins[vendor].version;
}

/** spec.model, or runner.json's models[vendor][role] when the hub left it to the runner. */
export function resolveModel(spec: Pick<AttemptSpec, 'model' | 'vendor' | 'role'>, config: RunnerConfig): string {
  return spec.model ?? config.models[spec.vendor][spec.role];
}

/**
 * `<agflow> mcp --vendor <v> --runner`, run with the bridge's own environment (X-32), and the tools it serves: those
 * of the role its AGFLOW_ROLE names, as the bridge chooses them; none for any other value, which it refuses.
 */
export function bridgeOf(agflow: AgflowCommand, vendor: Vendor, agentEnv: Record<string, string>): AgentLaunch['bridge'] {
  const env = bridgeEnvOf(agentEnv);
  const role = env.AGFLOW_ROLE;
  return {
    command: agflow.command,
    args: [...agflow.args, 'mcp', '--vendor', vendor, '--runner'],
    env,
    tools: role === 'worker' || role === 'lead' ? BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES[role] : [],
  };
}

/**
 * The agent's process group as runner.db records it. register is what AgentLaunch.registerProcess calls: the pid
 * arrives synchronously, while its start time takes a ps call, so the record is written asynchronously and
 * recorded() resolves once it is. The agent leads its own group, so the group is its pid.
 */
export class ProcessRegistration {
  private pending: Promise<ProcessRecord | null> | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly store: AttemptStore,
    private readonly attemptId: string,
    private readonly clone: string,
    private readonly logger: Logger,
    private readonly identify: (pid: number) => Promise<ProcessIdentity | null> = processIdentity,
  ) {}

  register(pid: number): void {
    if (this.pending !== null) throw new Error(`the agent of ${this.attemptId} was already registered`);
    this.pending = this.identify(pid).then(
      (identity) => {
        // Gone already: there is no group left to stop.
        if (identity === null) return null;
        return recordGroup(this.store, this.attemptId, this.clone, identity);
      },
      (error) => {
        this.logger.error('cannot record the agent process', { attemptId: this.attemptId, pid, error: String(error) });
        return null;
      },
    );
  }

  /** The record, once written; null when the process was gone before it could be. */
  recorded(): Promise<ProcessRecord | null> {
    return this.pending ?? Promise.resolve(null);
  }
}

export interface LaunchInput {
  spec: AttemptSpec;
  workspace: PreparedWorkspace;
  config: RunnerConfig;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  cliVersion: string;
  resume: AgentLaunch['resume'];
  registration: ProcessRegistration;
}

/** The AgentLaunch of a start or resume. */
export function buildLaunch(input: LaunchInput): AgentLaunch {
  const { spec, workspace, config, paths } = input;
  const env = buildAgentEnv({
    vendor: spec.vendor,
    spec,
    clone: workspace.clone,
    tools: workspace.runDir.tools,
    tmpDir: workspace.tmpDir,
    config,
    paths,
  });
  return {
    attemptId: spec.attemptId,
    role: spec.role,
    model: resolveModel(spec, config),
    cliVersion: input.cliVersion,
    clone: workspace.clone,
    baseCheckout: workspace.baseCheckout?.path ?? null,
    projectConfigVerified: workspace.projectConfigVerified,
    // Claude: the private /tmp/agf/<id>; Codex: the tool commands' TMPDIR inside the clone (design 7.6).
    tmpDir: workspace.tmpDir ?? workspace.runDir.tmp,
    env,
    bridge: bridgeOf(input.agflow, spec.vendor, env),
    profile: profileOf(config),
    brief: workspace.brief,
    firstPrompt: spec.firstPrompt,
    resume: input.resume,
    logFile: paths.attemptLog(spec.attemptId),
    registerProcess: (pid) => input.registration.register(pid),
  };
}
```

Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

`bridgeOf(agflow, vendor, agentEnv)` fills `tools` from the bridge environment's `AGFLOW_ROLE`, the variable the bridge itself reads: `BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES[role]`, or none for any other value. The lists are frozen, in `runnerToolsFor`'s order, and Task 44's CLI test checks them against the bridge's own tools. The literal launches in `stop-ladder.test.ts` and testkit's `fake-helpers.ts` gain `tools: []`, since `bridge.tools` is required; those tests run as before. The agent may already be in its first turn when `start()` resolves, so two earlier tests now accept a phase other than `starting`. The fixture's cleanup closes each controller and SIGKILLs every recorded group.
