```ts
const cleanups: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) await cleanup();
});

function tempDir(prefix: string): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix));
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

interface Setup {
  hub: FakeHub;
  origin: OriginRepo;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  db: RunnerDb;
  logger: ReturnType<typeof memoryLogger>;
  /** Starts a runner on these files; stopped after the test. */
  start(options?: {
    config?: Partial<RunnerConfigInput>;
    health?: RunnerHealth;
    preparer?: DependencyPreparer;
    script?: FakeScript;
  }): Promise<RunnerHandle>;
}

/** A fake hub serving the project, an origin, and a runner home whose runner.db the test may fill first. */
async function setup(hubOptions: FakeHubOptions = {}): Promise<Setup> {
  const origin = await originRepo({ 'README.md': '# demo\n', 'src/app.ts': 'app\n' });
  cleanups.push(() => origin.remove());
  const hub = startFakeHub({ token: TOKEN, status: { name: PROJECT, repo: origin.path }, ...hubOptions });
  // Not waited for: Bun's server.stop(true) never settles once the hub side closed a socket, as some tests do.
  cleanups.push(() => {
    hub.stop();
  });
  const paths = runnerPaths(tempDir('agflow-runner-home-'));
  // The attempts' tools directories are read-only: they must be made writable before the home can go.
  cleanups.push(() => {
    if (!existsSync(paths.vaults)) return;
    for (const entry of readdirSync(paths.vaults).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.agent'))) {
      for (const attempt of readdirSync(join(paths.vaults, entry))) removeAgentTools(join(paths.vaults, entry, attempt));
    }
  });
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.db), { recursive: true });
  const db = openRunnerDb(paths.db);
  cleanups.push(() => db.close());
  const logger = memoryLogger();
  const credentials: Credentials = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
  // Short, as Claude's private temporary directories must be.
  const tmpRoot = mkdtempSync('/tmp/ag');
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(tmpRoot, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const start: Setup['start'] = async (options = {}) => {
    const config = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
      runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner',
      machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
      name: 'laptop',
      test: { skipAuthChecks: true, allowShortTimings: true },
      ...options.config,
    });
    saveRunnerConfig(paths.config, config);
    const script = options.script ?? { turns: [[]] };
    const adapters = (['claude', 'codex'] as const).map(
      (vendor) => new FakeAdapter({ vendor, skipAuthChecks: true, script }),
    );
    const runner = await createRunner({
      paths,
      config,
      db,
      credentials: () => credentials,
      adapters,
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      // The darwin-arm64 pins, so the fake agents start where no CLI is pinned (CI's linux-x64).
      cliVersion: fixtureCliVersion,
      health: options.health,
      preparer: options.preparer,
      logger,
      tmpRoot,
    });
    cleanups.push(async () => {
      // Whatever agent a test left running goes before the files do.
      for (const group of new AttemptStore(db).processes()) await killGroup(group, 'SIGKILL');
      await runner.close();
    });
    return runner;
  };
  return { hub, origin, paths, db, logger, start };
}

/** A worker spec of T-4 for the setup's origin. */
function specOf(s: Setup, overrides: Partial<AttemptSpec> = {}): AttemptSpec {
  return {
    attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
    taskId: 'T-4',
    role: 'worker',
    vendor: 'claude',
    model: null,
    fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 1 },
    agentToken: fixtureAgentToken('T-4-a1'),
    hubUrl: s.hub.url,
    repo: { url: s.origin.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
    start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null },
    branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy',
    wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-4/a1',
    restore: { paths: restoreSet(null), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
    acceptanceIds: ['A1'],
    toolCaps: { defaultMs: 30 * 60_000, longMs: 90 * 60_000, checks: [] },
    taskPack: '# T-4 Tidy the app\n',
    brief: 'You are an agflow worker on T-4.',
    firstPrompt: 'Start working on T-4.',
    successor: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const hellos = (hub: FakeHub) => hub.messages().filter((message): message is HelloMessage => message.t === 'hello');

/** Sends the command and waits for its result. */
async function run(hub: FakeHub, command: RunnerCommand, timeoutMs = 10_000) {
  const id = hub.command(command);
  return hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.get(id), timeoutMs);
}

/** A runner.settings that names a field: an edit, not a probe. */
const isEdit = (event: { type: string; [key: string]: unknown }) =>
  event.type === 'runner.settings' && Object.keys((event.data as { settings: object }).settings).length > 0;

/** Settings the hub confirmed at version 4: runner.json's defaults. */
const SNAPSHOT = {
  capacity: 2,
  keepAwake: 'ac' as const,
  draining: false,
  ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 }, codex: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } },
  allowPaidUsage: { claude: false, codex: false },
  version: 4,
};

/** runner.json as the runner last wrote it. */
async function runnerJson(s: { paths: { config: string } }) {
  return RunnerConfigSchema.parse(await Bun.file(s.paths.config).json());
}

describe('createRunner', () => {
  test('hello carries the identity, the confirmed settings, the vendors, git, the outbox and the recovered attempts', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const store = new AttemptStore(s.db);
    // What a previous run left: an attempt that was running, a push, an event, and the hub epoch it last saw.
    store.create(specOf(s), { clone: join(s.paths.work, 'gone'), tmpDir: null, cliVersion: null });
    store.update('T-4-a1', { state: 'running', sessionRef: 'session-1', lastPushAt: 1_700_000_000_000 });
    new Outbox(s.db).append({ type: 'runner.state', data: { state: 'ok', detail: null } });
    s.db.setMeta('lastHubEpoch', 2);
    const confirmed = {
      capacity: 3,
      keepAwake: 'ac' as const,
      draining: false,
      ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.7, weekly: 0.8 } },
      allowPaidUsage: { codex: true },
      version: 5,
    };
    await s.start({
      config: {
        // A drain made while the runner was down is a local edit: hello carries the snapshot only.
        capacity: 3,
        draining: true,
        ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.7, weekly: 0.8 } },
        allowPaidUsage: { codex: true },
        confirmedSettings: confirmed,
        models: { claude: { lead: 'claude-lead-model', worker: 'claude-worker-model' } },
      },
    });
    const [hello] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0 && hellos(s.hub));
    expect(s.hub.invalid).toEqual([]);
    expect(RunnerMessageSchema.safeParse(hello).success).toBe(true);
    expect(hello).toMatchObject({
      protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner',
      machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
      name: 'laptop',
      agflowVersion: AGFLOW_VERSION,
      platform: vendorPlatform(),
      settings: confirmed,
      git: { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: 1_700_000_000_000 },
      state: 'ok',
      stateDetail: null,
      firstSeq: 1,
      lastSeq: 1,
      lastHubEpoch: 2,
      attempts: [
        { attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 1 }, state: 'stopped', sessionRef: 'session-1', clone: false },
      ],
    });
    expect(hello?.outboxEpoch).toBe(s.db.outboxEpoch);
    const vendors = Object.fromEntries((hello?.vendors ?? []).map((vendor) => [vendor.vendor, vendor]));
    expect(vendors.claude).toMatchObject({
      ready: true,
      models: { lead: 'claude-lead-model', worker: 'claude-worker-model' },
      ceilings: { fiveHour: 0.7, weekly: 0.8 },
      allowPaidUsage: false,
      degraded: false,
    });
    expect(vendors.codex).toMatchObject({ ready: true, allowPaidUsage: true, ceilings: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } });
    expect(hello?.profile).toEqual({ name: 'standard', weakened: [], dependencyPrep: false });
    // Startup recovery recorded the attempt as stopped.
    expect(store.get('T-4-a1')?.state).toBe('stopped');
  });

  test("the project's name and repo come from GET /api/status and are cached for the next start", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const first = await s.start();
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
    const cached = { hubUrl: s.hub.url, name: PROJECT, repo: s.origin.path };
    expect(s.db.meta('project')).toEqual(cached);
    const vault = s.paths.vault(projectKey(s.hub.url, PROJECT));
    expect(existsSync(join(vault, 'HEAD'))).toBe(true);
    await first.close();

    // The hub answers no status now: the cached project names the same vault, and the runner says hello.
    const down = startFakeHub({ token: TOKEN, status: 503 });
    cleanups.push(() => down.stop());
    const runner = await createRunner({
      paths: s.paths,
      db: s.db,
      credentials: () => ({ hubUrl: s.hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }),
      adapters: [],
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      fetch: (input, init) => fetch(String(input).replace(s.hub.url, down.url), init),
    });
    cleanups.push(() => runner.close());
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 1);
    expect(s.db.meta('project')).toEqual(cached);

    // With neither the hub nor a cache, the runner cannot start.
    const empty = openRunnerDb(join(tempDir('agflow-runner-db-'), 'runner.db'));
    cleanups.push(() => empty.close());
    const refused = createRunner({
      paths: s.paths,
      db: empty,
      credentials: () => ({ hubUrl: down.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }),
      adapters: [],
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
    });
    await expect(refused).rejects.toThrow(/cannot read the project from the hub/);

    // Nor with another hub's cache: its repository would get this hub's work.
    const elsewhere = createRunner({
      paths: s.paths,
      db: s.db,
      credentials: () => ({ hubUrl: down.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }),
      adapters: [],
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
    });
    await expect(elsewhere).rejects.toThrow(/cannot read the project from the hub/);
    expect(s.db.meta('project')).toEqual(cached);
  });

  test("startup recovery kills a previous run's agents before it reads the credentials, signed in or not", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const clone = join(tempDir('agflow-clone-'), 'T-4-a1');
    mkdirSync(clone, { recursive: true });
    const child = Bun.spawn([process.execPath, '-e', 'setInterval(() => {}, 1000)'], {
      detached: true,
      cwd: clone,
      stdin: 'ignore',
      stdout: 'ignore',
      stderr: 'ignore',
    });
    try {
      let identity: ProcessIdentity | null = null;
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 100 && identity === null; tries++) {
        identity = await processIdentity(child.pid);
        if (identity === null) await Bun.sleep(10);
      }
      if (identity === null) throw new Error('the child never started');
      const store = new AttemptStore(s.db);
      store.create(specOf(s), { clone, tmpDir: null, cliVersion: null });
      store.update('T-4-a1', { state: 'running' });
      store.recordProcess({ ...identity, attemptId: 'T-4-a1', clone });
      // agflow logout after a crash: the runner cannot start, but what the crashed run left is gone.
      const refused = createRunner({
        paths: s.paths,
        config: RunnerConfigSchema.parse({ runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner', machineId: 'MACHINE-1', name: 'laptop' }),
        db: s.db,
        credentials: () => null,
        adapters: [],
        agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      });
      await expect(refused).rejects.toThrow(/not signed in/);
      await child.exited;
      expect(child.signalCode).toBe('SIGKILL');
      expect(store.processes()).toEqual([]);
      expect(store.get('T-4-a1')?.state).toBe('stopped');
    } finally {
      child.kill('SIGKILL');
      await child.exited;
    }
  });

  test('HTTP calls go only to the hub the runner serves: after a login to another hub, an upload fails', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    // Another hub, which records every request it gets.
    const requests: string[] = [];
    const other = Bun.serve({
      hostname: '127.0.0.1',
      port: 0,
      fetch: (request) => {
        requests.push(new URL(request.url).pathname);
        return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
      },
    });
    let hubUrl = s.hub.url;
    // A turn that says something, so the transcript has a tail to upload.
    const script = { turns: [[{ do: 'text', text: 'the parser is tidy' } as const]] };
    const runner = await createRunner({
      paths: s.paths,
      config: RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
        runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner',
        machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
        name: 'laptop',
        test: { skipAuthChecks: true, allowShortTimings: true },
      }),
      db: s.db,
      credentials: () => ({ hubUrl, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }),
      adapters: [new FakeAdapter({ vendor: 'claude', skipAuthChecks: true, script })],
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      cliVersion: fixtureCliVersion,
      logger: s.logger,
    });
    try {
      await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
      const spec = specOf(s);
      expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: spec })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      const stop = {
        kind: 'stop_attempt',
        attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
        fence: spec.fence,
        cause: 'stop',
        reason: 'done',
        handoff: false,
        interruptFirst: false,
        keepClone: true,
      } as const;
      expect(await run(s.hub, stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      // agflow login --hub <other>: the link to this hub is still up, and the hub asks for the transcript.
      hubUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${other.port}`;
      expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'upload_transcript', attemptId: 'T-4-a1' })).toMatchObject({
        ok: true,
        data: { uploaded: false },
      });
      expect(requests).toEqual([]);
      const warned = s.logger.entries.filter((entry) => entry.message === 'cannot upload the transcript tail');
      expect(String(warned.at(-1)?.fields.error)).toContain('not signed in');
    } finally {
      await runner.close();
      other.stop(true);
    }
  }, 30_000);

  test("the vault takes the main branch the hub's specs name and keeps it; another repository is refused", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    // The hub's repository has trunk and no main.
    await gitIn(s.origin.path, ['branch', '-m', 'main', 'trunk']);
    await gitIn(s.origin.path, ['symbolic-ref', 'HEAD', 'refs/heads/trunk']);
    await s.start();
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
    const trunk = {
      repo: { url: s.origin.path, mainBranch: 'trunk' },
      start: { ref: 'refs/heads/trunk', sha: null },
      restore: { paths: restoreSet(null), base: 'refs/heads/trunk' },
    };
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: specOf(s, trunk) })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(s.db.meta('mainBranch')).toBe('trunk');
    const vault = s.paths.vault(projectKey(s.hub.url, PROJECT));
    expect(await gitIn(vault, ['symbolic-ref', 'HEAD'])).toBe('refs/heads/trunk');
    expect(await gitIn(vault, ['rev-parse', 'refs/heads/trunk'])).toBe(s.origin.mainSha);
    // A spec naming a repository other than the vault's fails to start, before anything is fetched.
    const foreign = specOf(s, {
      ...trunk,
      attemptId: 'T-5-a1',
      taskId: 'T-5',
      branch: 'agflow/T-5-x',
      wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1',
      repo: { url: '/elsewhere/origin.git', mainBranch: 'trunk' },
    });
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: foreign })).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      error: expect.stringMatching(/the hub names the repository \/elsewhere\/origin\.git/),
    });
  }, 30_000);

  test('welcome sets the WIP ref prefix, the hub epoch and the timings, handoffMs and wipGraceMs included', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 10_000, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 300, wipGraceMs: 400 };
    const s = await setup({ welcome: { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-e3/', hubEpoch: 3, timings }, heartbeatAck: false });
    const write = { do: 'write', path: 'src/app.ts', content: 'tidy\n' } as const;
    await s.start({
      // runner.json's own handoff is far longer: only the welcome's 300 ms meets the bound below.
      config: { timings: { handoff: 20_000, submitRetry: 1_500, stopInterrupt: 500, stopClose: 500, stopKill: 500 } },
      script: {
        turns: [[write, { do: 'commit', message: 'tidy' }], [{ do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 }]],
      },
    });
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.db.meta('lastHubEpoch') === 3);
    expect(s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix')).toBe('refs/agflow-e3/');
    const spec = specOf(s, { wipRef: 'refs/agflow-e3/T-4/a1' });
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: spec })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.events().some((event) => event.type === 'attempt.activity'), 10_000);

    // No heartbeat_ack since the welcome: past wipGraceMs, the submission's push may not go.
    await Bun.sleep(500);
    const submitted = await run(s.hub, {
      kind: 'push_submission',
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      fence: spec.fence,
      submissionId: 'S-1',
      branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy',
      expectedBranchSha: null,
      adoptable: [],
    });
    expect(submitted).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      error: 'remote',
      data: { detail: 'the hub has not answered within the WIP grace' },
    });

    // The handoff turn never writes its note: it is waited for the welcome's handoffMs.
    const began = performance.now();
    const stop = {
      kind: 'stop_attempt',
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      fence: spec.fence,
      cause: 'stop',
      reason: 'a person stopped it',
      handoff: true,
      interruptFirst: false,
      keepClone: true,
    } as const;
    expect(await run(s.hub, stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(performance.now() - began).toBeLessThan(5_000);
  }, 30_000);

  test("a new attempt's CLI version comes from the cliVersion option, which tests give where no CLI is pinned", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await createRunner({
      paths: s.paths,
      config: RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
        runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner',
        machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
        name: 'laptop',
        test: { skipAuthChecks: true, allowShortTimings: true },
      }),
      db: s.db,
      credentials: () => ({ hubUrl: s.hub.url, token: TOKEN, user: 'alice' }),
      adapters: [new FakeAdapter({ vendor: 'claude', skipAuthChecks: true, script: { turns: [[]] } })],
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      cliVersion: (vendor) => (vendor === 'claude' ? '1.2.3' : '4.5.6'),
      logger: s.logger,
    });
    try {
      await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
      expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: specOf(s) })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      const spawned = await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.events().find((event) => event.type === 'attempt.spawned'));
      expect(spawned).toMatchObject({ data: { cliVersion: '1.2.3' } });
      expect(new AttemptStore(s.db).get('T-4-a1')?.cliVersion).toBe('1.2.3');
    } finally {
      for (const group of new AttemptStore(s.db).processes()) await killGroup(group, 'SIGKILL');
      await runner.close();
    }
  });

  test("late work a previous run could not push goes out after the next run's first welcome", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    // The first late-work retry waits a minute: the runner stops before it.
    const config = { timings: { finalPush: 300, lateRetry: { base: 60_000, cap: 60_000 } } };
    const write = { do: 'write', path: 'work.txt', content: 'late\n' } as const;
    const first = await s.start({ config, script: { turns: [[write, { do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 }]] } });
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
    const spec = specOf(s);
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: spec })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    await waitFor(() => existsSync(join(s.paths.clone(projectKey(s.hub.url, PROJECT), 'T-4-a1'), 'work.txt')));
    // The origin is away, so the final push fails.
    const away = `${s.origin.path}.away`;
    renameSync(s.origin.path, away);
    const stop = {
      kind: 'stop_attempt',
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      fence: spec.fence,
      cause: 'stop',
      reason: 'done',
      handoff: false,
      interruptFirst: false,
      keepClone: true,
    } as const;
    expect(await run(s.hub, stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    const exited = await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.events().find((event) => event.type === 'attempt.exited'));
    const finalSha = (exited.data as { finalSha: string }).finalSha;
    expect(exited.data).toMatchObject({ finalWip: null, pushError: expect.any(String) });
    expect(new AttemptStore(s.db).get('T-4-a1')?.lateWorkSha).toBe(finalSha);
    await first.close();
    renameSync(away, s.origin.path);

    await s.start({ config });
    const late = await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.events().find((event) => event.type === 'attempt.late_work'));
    const ref = 'refs/agflow/T-4/a1-late-1';
    expect(late.data).toEqual({ taskId: 'T-4', ref, sha: finalSha });
    expect(await gitIn(s.origin.path, ['rev-parse', ref])).toBe(finalSha);
    expect(new AttemptStore(s.db).get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ lateWorkSha: null, pushError: null });
  });

  test('after welcome, a drain made while the runner was down goes out as runner.settings; none when nothing changed', async () => {
    const snapshot = {
      capacity: 2,
      keepAwake: 'ac' as const,
      draining: false,
      ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 }, codex: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } },
      allowPaidUsage: { claude: false, codex: false },
      version: 4,
    };
    const s = await setup();
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: snapshot } });
    const settings = () => s.hub.events().filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings');
    const [sent] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings().length > 0 && settings());
    expect(sent?.data).toEqual({ settings: { draining: true }, baseVersion: 4 });

    const same = await setup();
    await same.start({ config: { confirmedSettings: snapshot } });
    // The welcome records the hub epoch and then sends the edits, in the same call.
    await waitFor(() => same.db.meta('lastHubEpoch') !== null);
    expect(new Outbox(same.db).eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a local edit the outbox still carries is not sent again after a reconnect: the replay delivers it, or the hub applied it and its echo is to come', async () => {
    const snapshot = {
      capacity: 2,
      keepAwake: 'ac' as const,
      draining: false,
      ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 }, codex: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } },
      allowPaidUsage: { claude: false, codex: false },
      version: 4,
    };
    for (const autoAck of [false, true]) {
      // The second link's welcome names another WIP ref prefix, so the test knows when the runner has handled it.
      const s = await setup({
        autoAck,
        welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
      });
      await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: snapshot } });
      // Probes aside: this hub acknowledges the drain and never echoes it, as a hub that refused it would.
      const settings = () => s.hub.events().filter(isEdit);
      const [sent] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings().length > 0 && settings());
      expect(sent?.data).toEqual({ settings: { draining: true }, baseVersion: 4 });
      (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
      await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') === 'refs/agflow-2/');
      const outbox = new Outbox(s.db);
      expect(outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter(isEdit)).toHaveLength(1);
      if (!autoAck) await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings().length === 2);
      expect(new Set(settings().map((event) => event.seq))).toEqual(new Set([sent?.seq as number]));
    }
  });

  test("an acknowledged edit is not sent again after a reconnect when the owner's echo came before its own", async () => {
    const snapshot = {
      capacity: 2,
      keepAwake: 'ac' as const,
      draining: false,
      ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 }, codex: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } },
      allowPaidUsage: { claude: false, codex: false },
      version: 4,
    };
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
    });
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: snapshot } });
    // Probes aside: this hub acknowledges the drain before its echo, which M2a never does.
    const settings = () => s.hub.events().filter(isEdit);
    const [sent] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings().length > 0 && settings());
    const outbox = new Outbox(s.db);
    await waitFor(() => outbox.ackedSeq() >= (sent?.seq as number));
    // The hub applied the owner's edit before the drain: its echo comes first, and the drain's is still to come.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { capacity: 3 }, version: 5 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') === 'refs/agflow-2/');
    expect(outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter(isEdit)).toHaveLength(1);
    // Its own echo: in flight no longer, and nothing to send after the next welcome either.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: true }, version: 6 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(outbox.settingsInFlight().filter(isEdit)).toEqual([]);
    expect(outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter(isEdit)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('an echo of an older edit leaves runner.json on the newer edit in flight, and the next welcome sends neither again', async () => {
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
    });
    // A drain and an undrain made before this start, still in the outbox: runner.json is back at the snapshot.
    const outbox = new Outbox(s.db);
    for (const draining of [true, false]) {
      outbox.append({ type: 'runner.settings', data: { settings: { draining }, baseVersion: 4 } });
    }
    await s.start({ config: { confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    await waitFor(() => outbox.ackedSeq() >= 2);
    // The hub applied both, and the drain's echo comes first.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: true }, version: 5 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({ draining: false, confirmedSettings: { draining: true, version: 5 } });
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') === 'refs/agflow-2/');
    const edits = outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter(isEdit);
    expect(edits.map((event) => (event.type === 'runner.settings' ? event.data.settings : null))).toEqual([
      { draining: true },
      { draining: false },
    ]);
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: false }, version: 6 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({ draining: false, confirmedSettings: { draining: false, version: 6 } });
    expect(outbox.settingsInFlight().filter(isEdit)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a refused edit: a probe follows its acknowledgement, and at the probe's echo runner.json takes the hub's value", async () => {
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
    });
    // A capacity edit made while the runner was down.
    await s.start({ config: { capacity: 3, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    const settings = () => s.hub.events().filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings');
    const [edit, probe] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings().length === 2 && settings());
    expect(edit?.data).toEqual({ settings: { capacity: 3 }, baseVersion: 4 });
    expect(probe?.data).toEqual({ settings: {}, baseVersion: 4 });
    // The hub acknowledged the edit and never echoed it: it refused it. The probe's echo says so.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: {}, version: 5 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({ capacity: 2, confirmedSettings: { capacity: 2, version: 5 } });
    expect(s.logger.entries).toContainEqual({
      level: 'warn',
      message: "the hub refused a settings edit; runner.json takes the hub's settings",
      fields: { seq: edit?.seq, settings: { capacity: 3 } },
    });
    expect(new Outbox(s.db).settingsInFlight()).toEqual([]);
    // Nothing goes again, after the next welcome either.
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') === 'refs/agflow-2/');
    expect(new Outbox(s.db).eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings')).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  test("after a hub restore, the replay leaves out the edits whose echo the snapshot holds, and a probe ends it", async () => {
    // The welcomes after the first are a restored hub's, of a new hub epoch: its backup acknowledged nothing.
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) =>
        connection.index === 0 ? {} : { ackedSeq: 0, hubEpoch: 2, wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' },
    });
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    const outbox = new Outbox(s.db);
    const settings = (index: number) =>
      (s.hub.connections[index]?.messages ?? [])
        .flatMap((message) => (message.t === 'events' ? message.events : []))
        .filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings');
    // The drain, and the probe this hub's ack without an echo brings; both echoed and acknowledged.
    const [drain, probe] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings(0).length === 2 && settings(0));
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: true }, version: 5 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: {}, version: 6 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    await waitFor(() => outbox.ackedSeq() >= (probe?.seq as number));
    expect(outbox.settingsInFlight()).toEqual([]);
    // The hub is restored. At its first welcome the runner records what it holds and says hello again at once, sending
    // nothing first. That hello reports version 6, which the hub adopts, and the replay starts from 0. Applying the
    // drain again would undo whatever came after it; so would the probe, were it an edit. A new probe goes instead, so
    // the hub's acknowledgement reaches hello.lastSeq.
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    const [replayed] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => settings(2).length > 0 && settings(2));
    expect(s.hub.connections[1]?.messages.map((message) => message.t)).toEqual(['hello']);
    expect(hellos(s.hub)[2]).toMatchObject({ settings: { draining: true, version: 6 }, lastHubEpoch: 2 });
    expect(replayed?.data).toEqual({ settings: {}, baseVersion: 6 });
    expect(replayed?.seq).toBeGreaterThan(probe?.seq as number);
    expect(settings(2).map((event) => event.seq)).not.toContain(drain?.seq);
    await waitFor(() => outbox.ackedSeq() >= (replayed?.seq as number), 5_000);
    // The welcomes of that hub that follow do not count as a restore.
    expect(s.hub.connections).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  test("after the welcome of a restored hub the runner says hello again before it runs or sends anything, so that hub's next welcome finds the runner's snapshot", async () => {
    const { version: _version, ...values } = SNAPSHOT;
    // The restored hub's backup predates this runner: M2a registers it anew, stores hello's settings at version 1, and
    // sends them right after the welcome. Run, that echo would be stale (the snapshot is at 4), and every version the
    // hub hands out next one the runner already has; the next hello instead reports 4, which the hub adopts,
    // cancelling the echo.
    const whole: RunnerCommand = { kind: 'update_settings', settings: values, version: 1 };
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => {
        if (connection.index === 0) return {};
        if (connection.index === 1) {
          queueMicrotask(() => connection.send({ t: 'command', id: '2-R-1001-1', seq: 1, command: whole }));
        }
        return { ackedSeq: 0, hubEpoch: 2, runnerId: 'R-1001' };
      },
    });
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    const edits = (index: number) =>
      (s.hub.connections[index]?.messages ?? [])
        .flatMap((message) => (message.t === 'events' ? message.events : []))
        .filter(isEdit);
    // The drain made while the runner was down went to the old hub, which acknowledged it and never echoed it.
    const [drain] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => edits(0).length > 0 && edits(0));
    await waitFor(() => new Outbox(s.db).ackedSeq() >= (drain?.seq as number));
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub was restored');
    const third = await s.hub.connection(2, 5_000);
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => third.messages.some((message) => message.t === 'hello'));
    expect(hellos(s.hub)[2]).toMatchObject({ settings: SNAPSHOT, lastHubEpoch: 2 });
    // Nothing ran or went out on the restored hub's first connection: no result, no event, no journal row.
    expect(s.hub.connections[1]?.messages.map((message) => message.t)).toEqual(['hello']);
    expect(new Journal(s.db).get('2-R-1001-1')).toBeNull();
    expect(s.db.meta('restoredThrough')).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(drain?.seq as number);
    // The drain is still in flight: the replay to the restored hub delivers it, and runner.json keeps it.
    const [replayed] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => edits(2).length > 0 && edits(2));
    expect(replayed?.seq).toBe(drain?.seq);
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({ draining: true, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT });
    expect(s.hub.results.size).toBe(0);
    expect(s.hub.connections).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  test("a restored hub's epoch is recorded after what the runner held at its welcome, so a death between the two records that again", async () => {
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { ackedSeq: 0, hubEpoch: 2 }),
    });
    // What runner.db holds as the restored hub's epoch is written: a death right after that write leaves this.
    const restoredThrough: (number | null)[] = [];
    const setMeta = s.db.setMeta.bind(s.db);
    s.db.setMeta = ((key: string, value: unknown) => {
      if (key === 'lastHubEpoch' && value === 2) restoredThrough.push(s.db.meta('restoredThrough'));
      (setMeta as (key: string, value: unknown) => void)(key, value);
    }) as typeof s.db.setMeta;
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    await waitFor(() => new Outbox(s.db).ackedSeq() > 0);
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub was restored');
    await waitFor(() => restoredThrough.length > 0);
    expect(restoredThrough[0]).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test('any replay but one to a restored hub sends every edit the hub has not acknowledged, one an equal echo answered included', async () => {
    // This hub acknowledges nothing; the second welcome names another prefix, so the test knows when it was handled.
    const s = await setup({
      autoAck: false,
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
    });
    // A drain made while the runner was down goes out after the welcome.
    await s.start({ config: { draining: true, confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    const edits = (index: number) =>
      (s.hub.connections[index]?.messages ?? [])
        .flatMap((message) => (message.t === 'events' ? message.events : []))
        .filter(isEdit);
    const [drain] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => edits(0).length > 0 && edits(0));
    // The owner drained in the browser before the hub read the runner's drain: that echo answers the drain.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: true }, version: 5 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(new Outbox(s.db).settingsInFlight().filter(isEdit)).toEqual([]);
    // The link drops before the hub applied the drain: the same hub's replay sends it, as nothing has applied it.
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    const [replayed] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => edits(1).length > 0 && edits(1));
    expect(replayed?.seq).toBe(drain?.seq);
  });

  test('a failed write of runner.json leaves the echo in the settings the runner holds, which the next hello reports', async () => {
    const s = await setup({
      welcome: (_hello, connection) => (connection.index === 0 ? {} : { wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow-2/' }),
    });
    await s.start({ config: { confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('lastHubEpoch') !== null);
    expect(s.db.meta('settingsSavedVersion')).toBe(4);
    // runner.json's directory is read-only for one echo.
    const dir = dirname(s.paths.config);
    chmodSync(dir, 0o500);
    let result: unknown;
    try {
      result = await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining: true }, version: 5 });
    } finally {
      chmodSync(dir, 0o700);
    }
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({ draining: false, confirmedSettings: { version: 4 } });
    expect(s.db.meta('settingsSavedVersion')).toBe(4);
    (await s.hub.connection(0)).close(1012, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') === 'refs/agflow-2/');
    expect(hellos(s.hub)[1]?.settings).toMatchObject({ draining: true, version: 5 });
    // The next echo writes runner.json with both.
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { capacity: 3 }, version: 6 })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
    });
    expect(await runnerJson(s)).toMatchObject({
      capacity: 3,
      draining: true,
      confirmedSettings: { capacity: 3, draining: true, version: 6 },
    });
    expect(s.db.meta('settingsSavedVersion')).toBe(6);
  });

  test("hello carries the health seam's state, and git not ready when the vault cannot be made", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    // A file where the vault goes.
    const vault = s.paths.vault(projectKey(s.hub.url, PROJECT));
    mkdirSync(dirname(vault), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(vault, 'not a repository\n');
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      admit: () => null,
      heartbeat: () => ({ power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
      state: () => ({ state: 'disk_low', detail: 'x' }),
    };
    await s.start({ health });
    const [hello] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0 && hellos(s.hub));
    expect(hello?.state).toBe('disk_low');
    expect(hello?.stateDetail).toBe('x');
    expect(hello?.git).toEqual({
      ready: false,
      problem: expect.stringMatching(/cannot prepare the vault/),
      lastPushAt: null,
    });
  });

  test('after three consecutive failed WIP pushes, hello says git is not ready', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 50, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 };
    const s = await setup({ welcome: { timings } });
    await s.start({
      config: { timings: { wip: 100, backoffBase: 50, backoffCap: 100 } },
      script: {
        turns: [
          [
            // Written once the origin is gone.
            { do: 'sleep', ms: 500 },
            { do: 'write', path: 'work.txt', content: 'work\n' },
            { do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 },
          ],
        ],
      },
    });
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
    expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: specOf(s) })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    renameSync(s.origin.path, `${s.origin.path}.gone`);
    const failed = () => s.hub.events().filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.wip_failed');
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => failed().length >= 3, 10_000);
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4000, 'the hub restarts');
    const again = await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub)[1], 10_000);
    expect(again.git).toMatchObject({
      ready: false,
      problem: expect.stringMatching(/^\d+ consecutive WIP pushes failed$/),
    });
  }, 30_000);

  test('after the first welcome, the journal rows a previous run left running are settled', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const journal = new Journal(s.db);
    journal.begin('0-R-1-1', 1, { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' });
    const fence = { epoch: 1, counter: 1 };
    journal.begin('0-R-1-2', 2, { kind: 'deliver', attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence, messages: [], more: 0 });
    await s.start();
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => journal.get('0-R-1-1')?.state === 'done', 10_000);
    expect(journal.get('0-R-1-1')?.result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    // A preflight is run again, and reported; a delivery is not, the hub resends what it still wants.
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.events().some((event) => event.type === 'runner.vendors'));
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => journal.get('0-R-1-2')?.state === 'done');
    expect(journal.get('0-R-1-2')?.result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'interrupted' });
  });

  test("heartbeats list the facts of every live attempt, a start still preparing included, and the health seam's power, disk and acceptingUntil", async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 50, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 };
    const s = await setup({ welcome: { timings } });
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      admit: () => null,
      heartbeat: () => ({
        power: { source: 'battery', batteryPercent: 64, lowPowerMode: false },
        disk: { freeBytes: 42_000_000_000, agflowBytes: 1_000_000 },
        acceptingUntil: 1_000,
      }),
      state: () => ({ state: 'ok', detail: null }),
    };
    // T-6's dependency preparation waits until the test lets it go.
    const release = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
    const preparer = {
      available: true,
      prepare: async (input: PrepareInput) => {
        if (input.attemptId === 'T-6-a1') await release.promise;
        return { ran: false, ok: true, error: null, logTail: null };
      },
    };
    await s.start({ health, preparer, config: { capacity: 3 }, script: { turns: [[{ do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 }]] } });
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => hellos(s.hub).length > 0);
    const heartbeat = (check: (attempts: { attemptId: string; phase: string }[], at: number) => boolean) =>
      s.hub.waitFor(
        () => s.hub.messages().find((message) => message.t === 'heartbeat' && check(message.attempts, message.at)),
        10_000,
      );
    const spec = specOf(s);
    const other = specOf(s, { attemptId: 'T-5-a1', taskId: 'T-5', branch: 'agflow/T-5-x', wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1' });
    for (const attempt of [spec, other]) {
      expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    }
    const both = await heartbeat(
      (attempts) => attempts.filter((facts) => facts.phase === 'turn').length === 2,
    );
    expect(both).toMatchObject({
      power: { source: 'battery', batteryPercent: 64, lowPowerMode: false },
      disk: { freeBytes: 42_000_000_000, agflowBytes: 1_000_000 },
      acceptingUntil: 1_000,
    });
    if (both.t !== 'heartbeat') throw new Error('not a heartbeat');
    const listed = both.attempts.map(({ attemptId, fence, phase }) => ({ attemptId, fence, phase }));
    expect(listed.sort((a, b) => a.attemptId.localeCompare(b.attemptId))).toEqual([
      { attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence: spec.fence, phase: 'turn' },
      { attemptId: 'T-5-a1', fence: other.fence, phase: 'turn' },
    ]);

    // A start held in its preparation has no process yet: its lease is renewed all the same.
    const held = specOf(s, {
      attemptId: 'T-6-a1',
      taskId: 'T-6',
      branch: 'agflow/T-6-x',
      wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-6/a1',
      fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 3 },
    });
    const starting = run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: held });
    const preparing = await heartbeat((attempts) => attempts.some((facts) => facts.phase === 'preparing'));
    if (preparing.t !== 'heartbeat') throw new Error('not a heartbeat');
    expect(preparing.attempts.find((facts) => facts.attemptId === 'T-6-a1')).toEqual({
      attemptId: 'T-6-a1',
      fence: held.fence,
      phase: 'preparing',
      eventAgeMs: 0,
      tool: null,
      fsAgeMs: null,
      commitAgeMs: null,
      turns: 0,
      turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
      repeatedCalls: 0,
      continuations: 0,
      vendorErrorMs: 0,
      activeMs: 0,
      contextUsed: null,
    });
    release.resolve();
    expect(await starting).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(s.hub.invalid).toEqual([]);

    const stop = {
      kind: 'stop_attempt',
      attemptId: 'T-4-a1',
      fence: spec.fence,
      cause: 'stop',
      reason: 'done',
      handoff: false,
      interruptFirst: true,
      keepClone: true,
    } as const;
    expect(await run(s.hub, stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    const stopped = Date.now();
    const later = await heartbeat((_attempts, at) => at > stopped);
    if (later.t !== 'heartbeat') throw new Error('not a heartbeat');
    expect(later.attempts.map((facts) => facts.attemptId).sort()).toEqual(['T-5-a1', 'T-6-a1']);
  }, 40_000);
});
```

```ts
// The runner runtime (design 6.3, 7.1, 7.2, 13): createRunner composes one runner from runner.json, runner.db, the
// awake clock, the link, the command executor and one attempt controller per attempt, with what its caller passes in:
// the adapters (M2c's host calls createAdapters, X-6), the dependency preparer, the health seam, the notifier, the
// credentials provider, the agflow command and the logger (X-7).
// - Start: startup recovery settles what a previous run left (recovery.ts) before anything else, signed in or not.
//   The project's name and repo come from GET /api/status and are cached in runner.db with the hub that gave them,
//   so a runner that starts while its hub is down still finds its vault, which projectKey names; another hub's cache
//   is never used. The vault's main branch is the one the hub's last start named (AttemptSpec.repo.mainBranch), kept
//   in runner.db too. Every adapter's preflight runs, and the link says hello.
// - Every HTTP call goes to the hub this runner serves: after a login to another hub they fail as signed out, as the
//   link's own connections do, so no transcript of one hub's project ever reaches another.
// - hello: the protocol, the runner's identity, the confirmed settings snapshot (never a local edit, X-12), the
//   vendors, quota and profile from vendorReport, git readiness (not ready when the vault could not be made, or after
//   three consecutive failed WIP pushes) and the last push, the health seam's state, the outbox's position
//   (outboxEpoch, firstSeq, lastSeq; X-1), the last hub epoch, and every recorded attempt. Each hello starts a new
//   lineage of commands in the executor, so no update_settings taken before it moves the snapshot it reported (X-12).
// - welcome: its wipRefPrefix and hub epoch are stored, and its timings (handoffMs, wipGraceMs) read from the link.
//   The executor applies its stop list before any command that follows it (X-28); after the first one, the journal
//   rows a previous run left running are settled, and late work it left pending (AttemptRecord.lateWorkSha) is
//   retried until it lands. Each controller then gets its outage nudge and held WIP, and every field runner.json
//   changed since the snapshot goes out as runner.settings (X-12).
// - Settings sync (settings-sync.ts, X-12): each ack, and each welcome, checks for a settings edit the hub
//   acknowledged and never echoed, once the commands received before it have run. A welcome of another hub epoch is
//   a restored hub's: the runner records the events it holds then and says hello again at once, before it runs or
//   sends anything, so that hub reconciles against the runner's snapshot, not what its backup knew of it. The replays
//   to it leave out the edits held then whose answer the snapshot holds, which it would apply twice. runner.json's
//   write may fail; the runner goes on with the settings it holds.
// - Heartbeats carry every live attempt's facts, a start still preparing included, which renews its lease, and the
//   health seam's power, disk and acceptingUntil.
// The runtime schedules no outbox pruning: M2c's retention calls pruneAcked (X-7).
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname } from 'node:path';
import {
  AGFLOW_VERSION,
  type AttemptFacts,
  type AttemptPhase,
  DEFAULT_WIP_REF_PREFIX,
  type Fence,
  PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  type Runner,
  type Vendor,
} from '@agflow/core';
import type { AgflowCommand, PreflightResult, VendorAdapter } from './adapters/types';
import { AttemptController, type ControllerDeps } from './attempt/controller';
import { pinnedCliVersion } from './attempt/launch';
import { WipFailures, wipGateOf } from './attempt/work';
import { AttemptStore } from './attempt-store';
import { AwakeClock } from './clock';
import { loadRunnerConfig, type RunnerConfig, saveRunnerConfig, settingsOf } from './config';
import { openRunnerDb, type RunnerDb } from './db';
import { CommandExecutor } from './executor';
import { ensureRunnerGitFiles, type GitEnvironment, localGitEnv, remoteGitEnv } from './git/run';
import { Vault } from './git/vault';
import { type FetchFn, RunnerHubHttp } from './hub-http';
import { Journal } from './journal';
import {
  type CredentialsProvider,
  type HeartbeatContent,
  type HelloMessage,
  LinkClient,
  sameHubUrl,
  type WelcomeMessage,
} from './link';
import { type Logger, noopLogger } from './log';
import { Outbox } from './outbox';
import { projectKey, type RunnerPaths } from './paths';
import { SerialQueue } from './queue';
import { liveAttemptsForHello, recoverOnStart } from './recovery';
import {
  defaultHealth,
  type DependencyPreparer,
  type Notifier,
  type RunnerHealth,
  silentNotifier,
  skipDependencyPreparer,
} from './seams';
import { vendorPlatform } from './vendor/pins';
import { type VendorReport, vendorReport } from './vendors';

export interface RunnerOptions {
  /** The runner's files: runnerPaths(AGFLOW_HOME). */
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  /** runner.json as the caller loaded it; read from paths.config when absent. The runtime writes it back. */
  config?: RunnerConfig;
  /** runner.db, opened by the caller with its own migrations; opened here, and closed by close(), when absent. */
  db?: RunnerDb;
  /** The CLI's credentials (M2c's readCliCredentials): the hub this runner serves, and its token. */
  credentials: CredentialsProvider;
  /** One per vendor this runner runs: createAdapters' in the service, fakes in tests. */
  adapters: VendorAdapter[];
  /** How the runner runs agflow itself: the bridge is `<agflow> mcp --vendor <v> --runner`. */
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  /**
   * The CLI version a new attempt of the vendor starts with: this platform's pin (pinnedCliVersion) when absent, which
   * throws where VENDOR_PINS has none. Tests give fixtureCliVersion, so the runtime runs on CI's linux-x64 too.
   */
  cliVersion?: (vendor: Vendor) => string;
  /** The seams' defaults, which change nothing, when absent. */
  health?: RunnerHealth;
  preparer?: DependencyPreparer;
  notifier?: Notifier;
  logger?: Logger;
  /** The fetch of the HTTP calls: the global one by default. */
  fetch?: FetchFn;
  /** Where Claude attempts' private temporary directories go: /tmp by default. */
  tmpRoot?: string;
}

/** What createRunner gives: the running runner. */
export interface RunnerHandle {
  /** Ends the link and the runner's timers. Agents keep running: a suspend or a stop ends them first. */
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

/** A vendor's last preflight and when it ran. */
interface Preflight {
  result: PreflightResult;
  at: number;
}

function describe(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

/** Three consecutive failed WIP pushes make git not ready on the hub (design 6.3, attempt.wip_failed). */
const WIP_FAILURES_NOT_READY = 3;

/**
 * The project's name and repo from GET /api/status, cached in runner.db with the hub's URL for a start while the hub
 * is down. Throws when neither the hub nor a cache of this hub has them: another hub's project is never used, since
 * its repository would get this hub's attempts' work.
 */
async function projectOf(
  http: RunnerHubHttp,
  db: RunnerDb,
  hubUrl: string,
  logger: Logger,
): Promise<{ name: string; repo: string }> {
  try {
    const { name, repo } = await http.projectStatus();
    db.setMeta('project', { hubUrl, name, repo });
    return { name, repo };
  } catch (error) {
    const cached = db.meta('project');
    if (cached === null || !sameHubUrl(cached.hubUrl, hubUrl)) {
      throw new Error(`cannot read the project from the hub: ${describe(error)}`);
    }
    logger.warn('cannot read the project from the hub; using the cached one', { error: describe(error) });
    return { name: cached.name, repo: cached.repo };
  }
}

/** The facts of a start or resume still under way: no agent event yet, so nothing for a stall rule to read. */
function startingFacts(attemptId: string, fence: Fence, phase: AttemptPhase): AttemptFacts {
  return {
    attemptId,
    fence,
    phase,
    eventAgeMs: 0,
    tool: null,
    fsAgeMs: null,
    commitAgeMs: null,
    turns: 0,
    turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
    repeatedCalls: 0,
    continuations: 0,
    vendorErrorMs: 0,
    activeMs: 0,
    contextUsed: null,
  };
}

/** One adapter's preflight; one that throws is not ready, with its error as the problem. */
async function preflightOf(adapter: VendorAdapter): Promise<Preflight> {
  try {
    return { result: await adapter.preflight(), at: Date.now() };
  } catch (error) {
    const facts = {
      vendor: adapter.vendor,
      cliVersion: null,
      ownerCliVersion: null,
      ready: false,
      problem: `the preflight failed: ${describe(error)}`,
      accountId: null,
      plan: null,
      managedPolicy: false,
    };
    return { result: { facts, quota: null, weakened: [] }, at: Date.now() };
  }
}

export async function createRunner(options: RunnerOptions): Promise<RunnerHandle> {
  const logger = options.logger ?? noopLogger;
  const config = options.config ?? loadRunnerConfig(options.paths.config);
  const ownDb = options.db === undefined;
  if (ownDb) mkdirSync(dirname(options.paths.db), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const db = options.db ?? openRunnerDb(options.paths.db);
  try {
    // Before anything that may fail: no agent or escaped tool of a previous run keeps writing, signed in or not.
    const store = new AttemptStore(db);
    await recoverOnStart(store, logger);
    const credentials = await options.credentials();
    if (credentials === null) throw new Error('not signed in to an agflow hub; run agflow login');
    const hubUrl = credentials.hubUrl;
    // Pinned to the hub this runner serves, as the link pins its own connections.
    const pinned: CredentialsProvider = async () => {
      const current = await options.credentials();
      return current !== null && sameHubUrl(current.hubUrl, hubUrl) ? current : null;
    };
    const http = new RunnerHubHttp({ credentials: pinned, fetch: options.fetch });
    const project = await projectOf(http, db, hubUrl, logger);
    ensureRunnerGitFiles(options.paths);
    const vault = new Vault({
      paths: options.paths,
      project: projectKey(hubUrl, project.name),
      // 'main' only until a start names the hub's main branch.
      repo: { url: project.repo, mainBranch: db.meta('mainBranch') ?? 'main' },
      mainBranchChanged: (mainBranch) => db.setMeta('mainBranch', mainBranch),
    });
    // A vault that cannot be made is reported in hello as git not ready; the starts that need it fail by themselves.
    const gitProblem = await vault.ensure().then(
      () => null,
      (error) => `cannot prepare the vault: ${describe(error)}`,
    );
    if (gitProblem !== null) logger.error('cannot prepare the vault', { error: gitProblem });
    const preflights = await Promise.all(options.adapters.map(preflightOf));
    const runtime = new Runtime({ options, logger, config, db, ownDb, hubUrl, http, vault, store });
    runtime.gitProblem = gitProblem;
    for (const preflight of preflights) runtime.preflights.set(preflight.result.facts.vendor, preflight);
    runtime.start();
    return { close: () => runtime.close() };
  } catch (error) {
    if (ownDb) db.close();
    throw error;
  }
}

interface RuntimeInput {
  options: RunnerOptions;
  logger: Logger;
  config: RunnerConfig;
  db: RunnerDb;
  /** runner.db was opened here, so close() closes it. */
  ownDb: boolean;
  hubUrl: string;
  http: RunnerHubHttp;
  vault: Vault;
  store: AttemptStore;
}

/** One running runner: its parts, and how they meet the link. */
class Runtime {
  /** Why the vault could not be made at start; hello reports git as not ready then. */
  gitProblem: string | null = null;
  /** Each vendor's last preflight. */
  readonly preflights = new Map<Vendor, Preflight>();
  private config: RunnerConfig;
  private readonly options: RunnerOptions;
  private readonly logger: Logger;
  private readonly db: RunnerDb;
  private readonly ownDb: boolean;
  private readonly http: RunnerHubHttp;
  private readonly vault: Vault;
  private readonly store: AttemptStore;
  private readonly outbox: Outbox;
  private readonly local: GitEnvironment;
  private readonly queue = new SerialQueue();
  private readonly clock: AwakeClock;
  private readonly link: LinkClient;
  private readonly executor: CommandExecutor;
  private readonly controllers = new Map<string, AttemptController>();
  private readonly adapters: ReadonlyMap<Vendor, VendorAdapter>;
  private readonly wipFailures = new WipFailures();
  /** The journal rows a previous run left running were settled after the first welcome. */
  private recovered = false;
  private readonly stopAcks: () => void;

  constructor(input: RuntimeInput) {
    const { options, logger, db } = input;
    this.options = options;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.config = input.config;
    this.db = db;
    this.ownDb = input.ownDb;
    this.http = input.http;
    this.vault = input.vault;
    this.store = input.store;
    // The marks of settings echoes count once the snapshot the runner holds has their version (X-12); an Outbox
    // built for retention alone counts them up to the version runner.json was last written with.
    this.outbox = new Outbox(db, { confirmedVersion: () => this.config.confirmedSettings.version });
    this.outbox.settingsSaved(this.config.confirmedSettings.version);
    this.local = localGitEnv(options.paths);
    this.adapters = new Map(options.adapters.map((adapter) => [adapter.vendor, adapter]));
    this.clock = new AwakeClock({ gapMs: this.config.timings.tickGap, logger });
    this.link = new LinkClient({
      credentials: options.credentials,
      hubUrl: input.hubUrl,
      outbox: this.outbox,
      clock: this.clock,
      timings: this.config.timings,
      // Each hello starts a new lineage of commands: the echoes taken before it answer nothing (X-12).
      hello: () => {
        this.executor.helloSent();
        return this.hello();
      },
      heartbeat: () => this.heartbeat(),
      resent: (event) => this.executor.settings.resent(event),
      handlers: {
        onCommand: (message) => this.executor.onCommand(message),
        onWelcome: (welcome) => this.welcomed(welcome),
      },
      http: this.http,
      logger,
    });
    this.executor = new CommandExecutor({
      journal: new Journal(db),
      controller: (attemptId) => this.controller(attemptId),
      known: (attemptId) => this.controllers.has(attemptId) || this.store.get(attemptId) !== null,
      config: () => this.config,
      // The runner holds the new settings even when runner.json cannot be written (SettingsSync).
      saveConfig: (config) => {
        this.config = config;
        saveRunnerConfig(options.paths.config, config);
      },
      outbox: this.outbox,
      vault: this.vault,
      local: this.local,
      remote: () => this.remote(),
      wipRefPrefix: () => this.wipRefPrefix(),
      adapters: this.adapters,
      preflighted: (result) => this.preflights.set(result.facts.vendor, { result, at: Date.now() }),
      // The executor sends it as runner.vendors.
      vendors: () => {
        const { vendors, quota } = this.vendorReport();
        return { vendors, quota };
      },
      logger,
    });
    this.stopAcks = this.outbox.onAck(() => void this.executor.settingsAcknowledged({ welcome: false }));
  }

  start(): void {
    this.clock.start();
    this.link.start();
  }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    this.link.close();
    this.executor.close();
    this.clock.stop();
    this.stopAcks();
    for (const controller of this.controllers.values()) controller.close();
    if (this.ownDb) this.db.close();
  }

  private get preparer(): DependencyPreparer {
    return this.options.preparer ?? skipDependencyPreparer;
  }

  /** The attempt's controller, made the first time a command or a welcome names it. */
  private controller(attemptId: string): AttemptController {
    let controller = this.controllers.get(attemptId);
    if (controller === undefined) {
      controller = new AttemptController(attemptId, this.deps(attemptId));
      this.controllers.set(attemptId, controller);
    }
    return controller;
  }

  private deps(attemptId: string): ControllerDeps {
    const { options } = this;
    return {
      config: () => this.config,
      paths: options.paths,
      store: this.store,
      outbox: this.outbox,
      queue: this.queue,
      vault: this.vault,
      local: this.local,
      adapters: this.adapters,
      health: options.health ?? defaultHealth,
      preparer: this.preparer,
      notifier: options.notifier ?? silentNotifier,
      logger: this.logger,
      liveAttempts: () =>
        [...this.controllers.values()].filter((other) => other.attemptId !== attemptId && other.holdsSlot).length,
      vendorReady: (vendor) => this.preflights.get(vendor)?.result.facts.ready === true,
      wipRefPrefix: () => this.wipRefPrefix(),
      tmpRoot: options.tmpRoot ?? '/tmp',
      agflow: options.agflow,
      cliVersion: options.cliVersion ?? ((vendor) => pinnedCliVersion(vendor)),
      clock: this.clock,
      remote: () => this.remote(),
      wipGate: wipGateOf(this.link, this.clock),
      wipFailures: this.wipFailures,
      hub: this.http,
      handoffMs: () => this.link.welcome?.timings.handoffMs ?? this.config.timings.handoff,
      linkUp: () => this.link.state === 'online',
    };
  }

  private remote(): Promise<GitEnvironment> {
    return remoteGitEnv({ gitDir: this.vault.path });
  }

  /** The last welcome's prefix; the stored one before a welcome; the hub's default before any. */
  private wipRefPrefix(): string {
    return this.link.welcome?.wipRefPrefix ?? this.db.meta('wipRefPrefix') ?? DEFAULT_WIP_REF_PREFIX;
  }

  /** What hello says about the vendors: each one's facts as of its own preflight, and the merged profile. */
  private vendorReport(): VendorReport {
    const preflights = [...this.preflights.values()];
    const each = preflights.map(({ result, at }) =>
      vendorReport({ config: this.config, preflights: [result], at, preparer: this.preparer }),
    );
    const merged = vendorReport({
      config: this.config,
      preflights: preflights.map(({ result }) => result),
      at: Date.now(),
      preparer: this.preparer,
    });
    return {
      vendors: each.flatMap((report) => report.vendors),
      quota: each.flatMap((report) => report.quota),
      profile: merged.profile,
    };
  }

  /** Git readiness: the vault's problem at start, or WIP pushes that keep failing; and the last push of any attempt. */
  private gitReport(): Runner['git'] {
    const pushes = this.store.list().flatMap((record) => (record.lastPushAt === null ? [] : [record.lastPushAt]));
    const failures = this.wipFailures.consecutive;
    const problem =
      this.gitProblem ?? (failures >= WIP_FAILURES_NOT_READY ? `${failures} consecutive WIP pushes failed` : null);
    return { ready: problem === null, problem, lastPushAt: pushes.length === 0 ? null : Math.max(...pushes) };
  }

  private hello(): HelloMessage {
    const { vendors, quota, profile } = this.vendorReport();
    const git = this.gitReport();
    const { state, detail } = (this.options.health ?? defaultHealth).state();
    return {
      t: 'hello',
      protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      runnerKey: this.config.runnerKey,
      machineId: this.config.machineId,
      name: this.config.name,
      agflowVersion: AGFLOW_VERSION,
      platform: vendorPlatform(),
      settings: settingsOf(this.config),
      vendors,
      quota,
      profile,
      git,
      state,
      stateDetail: detail,
      outboxEpoch: this.outbox.epoch,
      firstSeq: this.outbox.firstSeq(),
      lastSeq: this.outbox.lastSeq(),
      lastHubEpoch: this.db.meta('lastHubEpoch'),
      attempts: liveAttemptsForHello(this.store, this.controllers),
    };
  }

  private heartbeat(): HeartbeatContent {
    const attempts = [...this.controllers.values()].flatMap((controller): AttemptFacts[] => {
      const facts = controller.facts();
      if (facts !== null) return [facts];
      // A start or resume with no process yet holds its lease through the heartbeats that list it (design 6.4).
      const { phase, fence } = controller;
      if ((phase === 'starting' || phase === 'preparing') && fence !== null) {
        return [startingFacts(controller.attemptId, fence, phase)];
      }
      return [];
    });
    return { attempts, ...(this.options.health ?? defaultHealth).heartbeat() };
  }

  /**
   * Each welcome, before any message that follows it. A hub epoch other than the last welcome's is a hub restored from
   * a backup (X-12): the runner records the events it holds then (Outbox.hubRestored), whose settings edits the replays
   * to that hub leave out when the snapshot holds their answer, and says hello again at once, before it runs or sends
   * anything. The hub reconciled the first hello against what it knew of the runner, perhaps nothing (a backup older
   * than the runner): the second finds its snapshot there, at its version or adopted, and whatever the first one made
   * the hub send cancelled. The epoch is written last, so a death before it records the events again.
   */
  private welcomed(welcome: WelcomeMessage): void {
    const lastHubEpoch = this.db.meta('lastHubEpoch');
    try {
      this.db.setMeta('wipRefPrefix', welcome.wipRefPrefix);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot record the WIP ref prefix', { error: describe(error) });
    }
    if (lastHubEpoch !== null && lastHubEpoch !== welcome.hubEpoch) {
      try {
        this.outbox.hubRestored();
        this.db.setMeta('lastHubEpoch', welcome.hubEpoch);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error('cannot record the restored hub', { error: describe(error) });
        this.link.reconnectWithBackoff('cannot record the restored hub');
        return;
      }
      this.logger.warn('the hub was restored from a backup; saying hello again', {
        hubEpoch: welcome.hubEpoch,
        lastHubEpoch,
      });
      this.link.reconnectNow('a restored hub');
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.db.setMeta('lastHubEpoch', welcome.hubEpoch);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot record the hub epoch', { error: describe(error) });
    }
    // The attempts it ended are marked so at once; their stops run on their queues.
    void this.executor.onWelcome(welcome);
    if (!this.recovered) {
      this.recovered = true;
      this.executor.recover().catch((error) => {
        this.logger.error('cannot settle the commands a previous run left', { error: describe(error) });
      });
      this.resumeLateWork();
    }
    for (const controller of this.controllers.values()) {
      controller.onWelcome().catch((error) => {
        const fields = { attemptId: controller.attemptId, error: describe(error) };
        this.logger.error('a welcome failed for an attempt', fields);
      });
    }
    // A write that fails here is logged: the welcome's handling goes on, and the link replays the outbox after it.
    try {
      this.executor.settings.welcomed({ ackedSeq: welcome.ackedSeq });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('cannot send the settings edits after the welcome', { error: describe(error) });
    }
    void this.executor.settingsAcknowledged({ welcome: true });
  }

  /**
   * At the first welcome: late work a previous run left pending (AttemptRecord.lateWorkSha) is retried until it lands,
   * as that run's retries would have been, under the welcome's WIP ref prefix. A cleanup clears the record's.
   */
  private resumeLateWork(): void {
    for (const record of this.store.list()) {
      if (record.lateWorkSha === null) continue;
      try {
        this.controller(record.attemptId).resumeLateWork();
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error('cannot resume the late work', { attemptId: record.attemptId, error: describe(error) });
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```diff
+  /**
+   * Whether the replay leaves an event out: a runner.settings whose answer the snapshot holds (its echo, or its
+   * refusal) and that the hub a restore replaced may have had, one held at the restored hub's welcome
+   * (Outbox.restoredThrough). That replay starts below what the old hub processed, and the restored hub adopted the
+   * snapshot hello reported, so applying such an edit again would revert whatever came after it. Every other event
+   * goes: M2a acknowledges an event in the transaction that applies it, so no hub has applied those, and an edit that
+   * an equal echo answered before the hub had it is still a change to deliver.
+   */
+  resent(event: StoredEvent): boolean {
+    const { outbox } = this.options;
+    if (event.type !== 'runner.settings' || event.seq > outbox.restoredThrough()) return false;
+    return !outbox.settingsInFlight().some((open) => open.seq === event.seq);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * After each welcome (the runtime records a restored hub's first, Outbox.hubRestored, and says hello again): every
+   * field runner.json changed while the runner was down (a hand edit) goes out as runner.settings, less what the edits
+   * in flight carry: the replay delivers those, or the hub applied them and their echo is to come, and an edit sent
+   * twice would apply twice. When the newest event the outbox holds is in the replay and one it leaves out (resent), a
+   * probe follows it, so the hub's acknowledgement reaches hello.lastSeq and its replay completes (X-1).
+   */
+  welcomed(welcome: { ackedSeq: number }): void {
+    const { outbox } = this.options;
+    const config = this.options.config();
+    const view = this.view(config);
+    const settings = localSettingsEdits({ ...config, confirmedSettings: view });
+    if (Object.keys(settings).length > 0) {
+      outbox.append({ type: 'runner.settings', data: { settings, baseVersion: config.confirmedSettings.version } });
+      return;
+    }
+    const newest = outbox.eventsAfter(outbox.lastSeq() - 1, 1)[0];
+    if (newest !== undefined && newest.seq > welcome.ackedSeq && this.resent(newest)) {
+      outbox.append({ type: 'runner.settings', data: { settings: {}, baseVersion: config.confirmedSettings.version } });
+    }
+  }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/runner.test.ts packages/runner/test/db.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

The vault's main branch comes from `AttemptSpec.repo.mainBranch` and is stored in the runner.db meta key `mainBranch`; `Vault.useRepo` moves HEAD and refuses a spec that names another repository. The runtime's HTTP client is pinned to the hub this runner serves. `git.ready` turns false after three consecutive failed WIP pushes. The runtime schedules no outbox pruning; M2c's retention does (X-7). The restore path calls `Outbox.hubRestored()` (the meta key `restoredThrough`) before it writes `lastHubEpoch`, so a death between the two records the events again; then `LinkClient.reconnectNow`. That first welcome runs no stop list, recovery, settings check or replay; they wait for the next welcome, which has the same epoch. The replays to a restored hub leave out the edits held then whose answer the snapshot holds (`SettingsSync.resent`); a probe follows when the newest event held is one of them. After each welcome `SettingsSync.welcomed` sends only the fields where runner.json differs from the view, the snapshot with the edits in flight laid over it (Task 35's rule, with the answers in the runner.db meta key `settingsEchoed`), so an edit on its way is never sent twice. A failed write of runner.json is logged and the runner goes on with the settings it holds. A throw from the settings or the replay report inside a welcome is logged, and the welcome's handling goes on. `createRunner`'s tests pass `cliVersion: fixtureCliVersion`, so they run on CI's linux-x64, where `VENDOR_PINS` has no CLI. In Bun 1.3.11 `server.stop(true)` never settles once the hub side has closed a socket, so the test cleanups do not await it. The `wipRefPrefix` and ordinary `lastHubEpoch` writes are guarded and logged on failure. On a restored hub, `hubRestored()` runs before the epoch write in one guarded block; if either fails, the runner logs it, calls `reconnectWithBackoff` and returns before commands or replay. The epoch remains unrecorded so the next welcome retries. Successful bookkeeping still calls `reconnectNow` immediately. The restore test's separate `new Outbox(s.db)` shares persisted acknowledgement state but receives no waiter notifications from the runtime Outbox. It therefore uses `await waitFor(() => outbox.ackedSeq() >= (replayed?.seq as number), 5_000)` instead of `waitAcked`. Runtime write-failure regressions belong to Task 38 because they use `runner-setup.ts`.

Keep useRepo-specific assertions in this task, which introduces that API; earlier start/resume finalization regressions use fetchForAttempt.

### Task 38: The runner handle and events

`createRunner` returns the `RunnerHandle` that M2c drives (design 7.1, X-7, X-41): `status()`, `changeSettings`, `stopAgents`, `interruptAgents`, `pushWipNow`, `pause` and `resume`, `waitAcked`, `vault`, `close()` and `done`. `RunnerEvents` are exactly `link`, `gap`, `welcome`, `needsLogin` and `attemptState`, and `welcome` is called before the executor runs any command that follows it. `stopAgents` interrupts and stops every agent at once but runs their final pushes and `attempt.exited` one at a time, the oldest unpushed work first. Preflight runs again every `preflightEvery`, and `runner.vendors` and `runner.state` go out only on a change, and again after a replay that would leave the hub with an older report. `changeSettings` goes through `SettingsSync.change`, which changes nothing and rejects when runner.json or the `runner.settings` event cannot be written. A seeded model test drives the whole settings sync against a model of M2a's rules (X-12). Runtime regressions in `runner.test.ts`, through `runner-setup.ts`, exercise failed ordinary welcome/ack writes and restored-hub bookkeeping retries before replay.
