```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { chmodSync, existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import type { AttemptPhase, RunnerEvent, RunnerSettings } from '@agflow/core';
import { FakeAdapter, type FakeScript, type TranscriptLine } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { PreflightResult } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { handoffPrompt, RUNNER_STOP_REASON } from '../src/attempt/stop';
import { OUTAGE_NUDGE } from '../src/attempt/turns';
import { AttemptStore } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { loadRunnerConfig } from '../src/config';
import { Journal } from '../src/journal';
import type { LinkState } from '../src/link';
import { Outbox } from '../src/outbox';
import { projectKey } from '../src/paths';
import type { RunnerEvents, RunnerHandle } from '../src/runner';
import type { RunnerHealth } from '../src/seams';
import { testWelcome } from './fake-hub';
import { waitFor } from './fixture';
import {
  cleanupRunnerSetups,
  hellos,
  runCommand as run,
  SETUP_PROJECT,
  type RunnerSetup,
  setupRunner as setup,
  setupSpec as specOf,
} from './runner-setup';

afterEach(cleanupRunnerSetups);

// Every test here runs git or agent processes, which take several times as long on a machine loaded by other suites.
setDefaultTimeout(30_000);

/** A turn that writes work and stays live, then the handoff turn a stop may ask for. */
const WORKING: FakeScript = {
  turns: [
    [
      { do: 'write', path: 'work.txt', content: 'work\n' },
      { do: 'sleep', ms: 30_000 },
    ],
    [{ do: 'terminal', tool: 'handoff' }],
  ],
};

/** The settings the hub confirmed last, at version 4. */
const SNAPSHOT: RunnerSettings = {
  capacity: 2,
  keepAwake: 'ac',
  draining: false,
  ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 }, codex: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 } },
  allowPaidUsage: { claude: false, codex: false },
  version: 4,
};

const T5 = {
  attemptId: 'T-5-a1',
  taskId: 'T-5',
  branch: 'agflow/T-5-other',
  wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-5/a1',
  firstPrompt: 'Start working on T-5.',
};

const cloneOf = (s: RunnerSetup, attemptId = 'T-4-a1') =>
  s.paths.clone(projectKey(s.hub.url, SETUP_PROJECT), attemptId);

const eventsOf = <T extends RunnerEvent['type']>(s: RunnerSetup, type: T) =>
  s.hub.events().filter((event) => event.type === type) as Extract<RunnerEvent, { type: T }>[];

/**
 * The settings edits the hub received, probes aside: this hub acknowledges an edit before its echo, which M2a never
 * does, so a probe follows each one (SettingsSync.probeUnanswered).
 */
const editsOf = (s: RunnerSetup) =>
  eventsOf(s, 'runner.settings').filter((event) => Object.keys(event.data.settings).length > 0);

/** The prompts the agent received, from the fake adapter's transcript. */
function promptsOf(s: RunnerSetup, attemptId = 'T-4-a1'): string[] {
  const sessionRef = new AttemptStore(s.db).get(attemptId)?.sessionRef as string;
  const file = join(cloneOf(s, attemptId), '.agflow', 'run', 'fake-transcripts', `${sessionRef}.jsonl`);
  return readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as TranscriptLine)
    .filter((line) => line.role === 'user')
    .map((line) => line.text);
}

async function online(runner: RunnerHandle): Promise<void> {
  await waitFor(() => runner.status().link === 'online', 10_000);
}

/** Starts the attempt through the hub and waits until its agent wrote its work and is in its turn. */
async function startWorking(s: RunnerSetup, runner: RunnerHandle, overrides = {}) {
  const spec = specOf(s, overrides);
  expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: spec })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  await waitFor(
    () =>
      existsSync(join(cloneOf(s, spec.attemptId), 'work.txt')) &&
      runner.status().attempts.some((attempt) => attempt.attemptId === spec.attemptId && attempt.phase === 'turn'),
    10_000,
  );
  return spec;
}

describe('RunnerHandle', () => {
  test("status() lists each attempt with its phase, last push and its process's pid, pgid and lstart", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start({ script: WORKING });
    await online(runner);
    await startWorking(s, runner);
    const pushed = await runner.pushWipNow();

    expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(false);
    // So a drain now is a change, and goes out.
    expect(await runner.changeSettings({ draining: true })).toEqual(expect.any(Number));
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => sent().length === 3);
    expect(sent()).toEqual([{ draining: true }, { draining: false }, { draining: true }]);
    for (const [draining, version] of [
      [false, 6],
      [true, 7],
    ] as const) {
      expect(await run(s.hub, { kind: 'update_settings', settings: { draining }, version })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(loadRunnerConfig(s.paths.config)).toMatchObject({
      draining: true,
      confirmedSettings: { ...SNAPSHOT, draining: true, version: 7 },
    });
    expect(sent()).toHaveLength(3);
  }, 60_000);

  test('changeSettings changes nothing and rejects when runner.json cannot be written', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start({ config: { confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    await online(runner);
    const dir = dirname(s.paths.config);
    chmodSync(dir, 0o500);
    try {
      await expect(runner.changeSettings({ draining: true })).rejects.toThrow();
    } finally {
      chmodSync(dir, 0o700);
    }
    expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(false);
    expect(loadRunnerConfig(s.paths.config).draining).toBe(false);
    expect(new Outbox(s.db).eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings')).toEqual([]);
    // Written again, the drain goes.
    expect(await runner.changeSettings({ draining: true })).toEqual(expect.any(Number));
    expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(true);
  }, 60_000);

  test('changeSettings changes nothing and rejects when its runner.settings cannot be stored; a saved version that cannot be noted changes nothing', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start({ config: { confirmedSettings: SNAPSHOT } });
    await online(runner);
    const settings = () => new Outbox(s.db).eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings');
    // runner.db refuses the event, as a full disk would.
    s.db.sqlite.run(`CREATE TEMP TRIGGER refuse_settings BEFORE INSERT ON outbox WHEN NEW.type = 'runner.settings'
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'database or disk is full'); END`);
    try {
      await expect(runner.changeSettings({ draining: true })).rejects.toThrow(/full/);
    } finally {
      s.db.sqlite.run('DROP TRIGGER refuse_settings');
    }
    expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(false);
    expect(loadRunnerConfig(s.paths.config).draining).toBe(false);
    expect(settings()).toEqual([]);
    // The version runner.json was written with only bounds retention: the edit goes all the same.
    s.db.sqlite.run(`CREATE TEMP TRIGGER refuse_saved BEFORE UPDATE ON meta WHEN NEW.key = 'settingsSavedVersion'
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'database or disk is full'); END`);
    try {
      expect(await runner.changeSettings({ draining: true })).toEqual(expect.any(Number));
    } finally {
      s.db.sqlite.run('DROP TRIGGER refuse_saved');
    }
    expect(runner.status().settings.draining).toBe(true);
    expect(loadRunnerConfig(s.paths.config).draining).toBe(true);
    expect(settings().map((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings' && event.data.settings)).toEqual([
      { draining: true },
    ]);
    expect(s.logger.entries).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ level: 'error', fields: { error: expect.stringMatching(/full/) } }));
  }, 60_000);

    const s = await setup();

    const script: FakeScript = {

    expect(exited.map((event) => event.seq)).toEqual(seqs);
    expect(exited[0]?.data).toMatchObject({ cause: 'runner_stop', handoffWritten: true });
    expect(promptsOf(s)).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.', handoffPrompt(RUNNER_STOP_REASON)]);

  test("stopAgents('suspend', { handoff: false }) stops every agent at once, pushes the oldest unpushed work first and records the attempts suspended", async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    // When each attempt's ladder began: how many attempt.exited the outbox held then.
    const exited = () => new Outbox(s.db).eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.exited').length;
    const laddered = new Map<string, number>();
    const events: RunnerEvents = {
      attemptState: (change) => {
        if (change.phase === 'stopping' && !laddered.has(change.attemptId)) laddered.set(change.attemptId, exited());
      },
    };
    const runner = await s.start({ script: WORKING, events });
    await online(runner);
    await startWorking(s, runner);
    await startWorking(s, runner, T5);
    // T-4 pushed a moment ago; T-5's work has waited since long before.
    const store = new AttemptStore(s.db);
    store.update('T-4-a1', { lastPushAt: Date.now() });
    store.update('T-5-a1', { lastPushAt: 1_000 });
    // Every push to the origin takes a second: T-5's final push is still going when T-4's agent is stopped.
    writeFileSync(join(s.origin.path, 'hooks', 'pre-receive'), '#!/bin/sh\nsleep 1\n', { mode: 0o755 });
    const began = performance.now();
    const seqs = await runner.stopAgents('suspend', { handoff: false });
    expect(performance.now() - began).toBeGreaterThan(2_000);
    expect(Object.fromEntries(laddered)).toEqual({ 'T-4-a1': 0, 'T-5-a1': 0 });
    const reported = await s.hub.waitFor(
      () => eventsOf(s, 'attempt.exited').length > 1 && eventsOf(s, 'attempt.exited'),
    );
    expect(reported.map((event) => [event.attemptId, event.seq])).toEqual([
      ['T-5-a1', seqs[0]],
      ['T-4-a1', seqs[1]],
    ]);
    expect(reported.map((event) => event.data.cause)).toEqual(['suspend', 'suspend']);
    expect(promptsOf(s)).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.']);
    expect(promptsOf(s, 'T-5-a1')).toEqual(['Start working on T-5.']);
    expect(store.get('T-4-a1')?.state).toBe('suspended');
    expect(store.get('T-5-a1')?.state).toBe('suspended');
    // Nothing is left to stop.
    expect(await runner.stopAgents('suspend', { handoff: false })).toEqual([]);
  }, 30_000);

  test('interruptAgents({ outage: true }) ends the turn without an exit, and the next welcome brings the reconnect message', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start({ script: WORKING, config: { timings: { backoffBase: 50, backoffCap: 100 } } });
    await online(runner);

    await runner.interruptAgents({ outage: true });
    await waitFor(() => runner.status().attempts[0]?.phase === 'idle');
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'attempt.exited')).toEqual([]);
    expect(promptsOf(s)).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.']);
    // The link comes back: the welcome that follows sends the one nudge.
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4000, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.hub.connections.length > 1 && runner.status().link === 'online', 10_000);
    await waitFor(() => promptsOf(s).length > 1, 10_000);
    expect(promptsOf(s)).toEqual(['Start working on T-4.', OUTAGE_NUDGE]);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'attempt.exited')).toEqual([]);
    // pushWipNow pushes the changed clone once; unchanged, it pushes nothing.
    const [first] = await runner.pushWipNow();
    expect(first?.outcome.status).toBe('pushed');
    expect(await runner.pushWipNow()).toEqual([{ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', outcome: { status: 'unchanged' } }]);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'attempt.wip')).toHaveLength(1);
  }, 30_000);

  test('interruptAgents({ outage: false }) brings no reconnect message; pushWipNow holds what canPushWip forbids', async () => {
    // No heartbeat_ack ever: the hub has not answered within wipGraceMs, so no WIP push may go.
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 1_000, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 300 };
    const s = await setup({ heartbeatAck: false, welcome: { timings } });
    // Every turn after the first does nothing.
    const script: FakeScript = { turns: [WORKING.turns[0] ?? []] };
    const runner = await s.start({ script, config: { timings: { backoffBase: 50, backoffCap: 100 } } });
    await online(runner);
    const spec = await startWorking(s, runner);
    // The welcome is the last word from the hub: once wipGraceMs has passed since it, however fast the start was.
    await Bun.sleep(timings.wipGraceMs + 200);
    expect(await runner.pushWipNow()).toEqual([
      { attemptId: 'T-4-a1', outcome: { status: 'held', sha: expect.any(String) } },
    ]);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'attempt.wip')).toEqual([]);
    await runner.interruptAgents({ outage: false });
    await waitFor(() => runner.status().attempts[0]?.phase === 'idle');
    // The link comes back: a plain interrupt is no outage, so the next turn is the hub's delivery alone.
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4000, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => s.hub.connections.length > 1 && runner.status().link === 'online', 10_000);
    const message = { messageId: 7, authority: 'person' as const, text: 'carry on' };
    const delivery = { kind: 'deliver' as const, attemptId: 'T-4-a1', fence: spec.fence, messages: [message], more: 0 };
    expect(await run(s.hub, delivery)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    await waitFor(() => promptsOf(s).length > 1 && runner.status().attempts[0]?.phase === 'idle', 10_000);
    const prompts = promptsOf(s);
    expect(prompts).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(prompts[1]).toContain('carry on');
    expect(prompts).not.toContain(OUTAGE_NUDGE);
  }, 30_000);

  test('pause() holds commands unjournaled and unrun; resume() runs them in order', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start();
    await online(runner);
    runner.pause();
    const first = s.hub.command({ kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'codex' });
    const second = s.hub.command({ kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' });
    await Bun.sleep(300);
    const journal = new Journal(s.db);
    expect(journal.get(first)).toBeNull();
    expect(journal.get(second)).toBeNull();
    expect(s.hub.results.get(first)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.vendors')).toEqual([]);
    runner.resume();
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => s.hub.results.get(first) && s.hub.results.get(second));
    expect(journal.get(first)?.state).toBe('done');
    // Each preflight's report lists every vendor: the hub replaces the runner's list with it.
    const reports = eventsOf(s, 'runner.vendors').map((event) => event.data.vendors.map((vendor) => vendor.vendor));
    expect(reports.map((vendors) => vendors.sort())).toEqual([
      ['claude', 'codex'],
      ['claude', 'codex'],
    ]);
  }, 60_000);

  test('waitAcked resolves true once the hub acknowledges the seq, at once if it has, and false after the timeout', async () => {
    const s = await setup({ autoAck: false });

  test('4409, 4403 and 4426 closes resolve done with replaced, refused and incompatible; close() with closed', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const runner = await s.start();
    await online(runner);
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4409, 'another process uses this key');
    expect(await runner.done).toEqual({ kind: 'replaced', reason: 'another process uses this key' });

    const retired = await setup();
    const refused = await retired.start();
    await online(refused);
    retired.hub.connections[0]?.close(4403, 'retired');
    expect(await refused.done).toEqual({ kind: 'refused', reason: 'retired' });

    const newer = await setup();

    await online(incompatible);
    newer.hub.connections[0]?.close(4426, 'needs protocol 3');
    expect(await incompatible.done).toEqual({ kind: 'incompatible', reason: 'needs protocol 3' });

    const closed = await other.start();
    await online(closed);
    await closed.close();
    expect(await closed.done).toEqual({ kind: 'closed', reason: '' });
  }, 60_000);

describe('RunnerEvents', () => {
  test('link carries close codes; needsLogin, gap and attemptState are called as they happen', async () => {
    const s = await setup();
    const links: [LinkState, { code: number | null; reason: string }][] = [];
    const states: { attemptId: string; phase: AttemptPhase | null; live: number }[] = [];
    let needsLogin = 0;
    const gaps: number[] = [];
    const events: RunnerEvents = {
      link: (state, detail) => links.push([state, detail]),
      gap: (gap) => gaps.push(gap.ms),
      needsLogin: () => {
        needsLogin += 1;
      },
      attemptState: (change) => states.push(change),
    };
    const runner = await s.start({
      events,
      script: WORKING,
      config: { timings: { backoffBase: 50, backoffCap: 100, loginProbe: 100, tickGap: 2_000 } },
    });
    await online(runner);
    await startWorking(s, runner);
    expect(states[0]).toEqual({ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', phase: 'starting', live: 1 });
    expect(states.at(-1)).toEqual({ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', phase: 'turn', live: 1 });
    await runner.stopAgents('runner_stop', { handoff: false });
    expect(states.at(-1)).toEqual({ attemptId: 'T-4-a1', phase: null, live: 0 });

    // The hub drops the link; the CLI's token is refused meanwhile.
    s.credentials.token = 'revoked';
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4000, 'the hub restarts');
    await waitFor(() => needsLogin === 1, 10_000);
    expect(links).toContainEqual(['backoff', { code: 4000, reason: 'the hub restarts' }]);
    expect(runner.status().link).toBe('needs_login');
    // After agflow login, the probe finds the token good and the link comes back.
    s.credentials.token = 'cli_token_for_the_runner';
    await waitFor(() => runner.status().link === 'online', 10_000);
    expect(links.at(-1)).toEqual(['online', { code: null, reason: '' }]);

    // A freeze longer than the tick gap is a clock gap.
    Bun.sleepSync(3_500);
    await waitFor(() => gaps.length > 0, 5_000);
    expect(gaps[0]).toBeGreaterThan(2_000);
    expect(needsLogin).toBe(1);
  }, 40_000);

  test('welcome is called before the executor runs any command that follows it', async () => {
    const s = await setup({ welcome: false });
    const order: string[] = [];
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      admit: () => {
        order.push('admit');
        return null;
      },
      heartbeat: () => ({ power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
      state: () => ({ state: 'ok', detail: null }),
    };
    const runner = await s.start({
      health,
      events: { welcome: (welcome) => order.push(`welcome ${welcome.runnerId}`) },
      script: WORKING,
    });
    const connection = await s.hub.connection(0);
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => connection.messages.some((message) => message.t === 'hello'));
    connection.send(testWelcome(0));
    const started = run(s.hub, { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: specOf(s) });
    expect(await started).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(order).toEqual(['welcome R-1', 'admit']);
    await online(runner);
  }, 60_000);

  test('preflight runs again every preflightEvery and sends runner.vendors only on a change; a health state change sends runner.state', async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 50, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 };
    const s = await setup({ welcome: { timings } });
    let ready = true;
    let preflights = 0;
    const claude = new FakeAdapter({ vendor: 'claude', skipAuthChecks: true, script: { turns: [[]] } });
    const preflight = claude.preflight.bind(claude);
    claude.preflight = async (): Promise<PreflightResult> => {
      preflights += 1;
      const result = await preflight();
      return { ...result, facts: { ...result.facts, ready, problem: ready ? result.facts.problem : 'logged out' } };
    };
    let state: ReturnType<RunnerHealth['state']> = { state: 'ok', detail: null };
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      admit: () => null,
      heartbeat: () => ({ power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
      state: () => state,
    };
    const runner = await s.start({ adapters: [claude], health, config: { timings: { preflightEvery: 100 } } });
    await online(runner);
    await waitFor(() => preflights >= 4);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.vendors')).toEqual([]);
    ready = false;
    const reports = () => eventsOf(s, 'runner.vendors');
    const [report] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => reports().length > 0 && reports());
    expect(report?.data.vendors).toMatchObject([{ vendor: 'claude', ready: false, problem: 'logged out' }]);
    const after = preflights;
    await waitFor(() => preflights >= after + 3);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.vendors')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(runner.status().vendors[0]?.ready).toBe(false);

    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.state')).toEqual([]);
    state = { state: 'disk_low', detail: '2 GB free' };
    const [changed] = await s.hub.waitFor(() => eventsOf(s, 'runner.state').length > 0 && eventsOf(s, 'runner.state'));
    expect(changed?.data).toEqual({ state: 'disk_low', detail: '2 GB free' });
    await Bun.sleep(200);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.state')).toHaveLength(1);
    state = { state: 'ok', detail: null };
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => eventsOf(s, 'runner.state').length > 1);
    expect(eventsOf(s, 'runner.state').map((event) => event.data.state)).toEqual(['disk_low', 'ok']);
  }, 30_000);

  test("a runner.state the outbox replays after a newer hello is followed by the hello's own state", async () => {
    const timings = { heartbeatMs: 50, deadLinkMs: 60_000, handoffMs: 1_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 };
    const s = await setup({ autoAck: false, welcome: { timings } });
    let state: ReturnType<RunnerHealth['state']> = { state: 'ok', detail: null };
    const health: RunnerHealth = {
      admit: () => null,
      heartbeat: () => ({ power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null }),
      state: () => state,
    };
    // The disk recovers as the link drops: no heartbeat goes out until the next hello.
    const events: RunnerEvents = {
      link: (linkState) => {
        if (linkState === 'backoff') state = { state: 'ok', detail: null };
      },
    };
    const runner = await s.start({ health, events, config: { timings: { backoffBase: 50, backoffCap: 100 } } });
    await online(runner);
    state = { state: 'disk_low', detail: '2 GB free' };
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => eventsOf(s, 'runner.state').length > 0);
    // The link drops before the hub acknowledges it.
    s.hub.connections[0]?.close(4000, 'the hub restarts');
    const second = await s.hub.connection(1, 10_000);
    const states = () =>
      second.messages.flatMap((message) =>
        message.t === 'events'
          ? (message.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.state') as Extract<
              RunnerEvent,
              { type: 'runner.state' }
            >[])
          : [],
      );
    await s.hub.waitFor(() => states().length > 1, 10_000);
    expect(hellos(s.hub)[1]?.state).toBe('ok');
    // The replay brings the stale report back; the hello's state follows it, so the hub's last word is current.
    expect(states().map((event) => event.data)).toEqual([
      { state: 'disk_low', detail: '2 GB free' },
      { state: 'ok', detail: null },
    ]);
  }, 30_000);
});
```

```ts
// The runtime's test setup: a fake hub serving the project, a local origin, and a runner home whose runner.db a test
// may fill before the runner starts. Everything a test made, the runners it started included, goes in
// cleanupRunnerSetups, which the test files call after each test.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { type AttemptSpec, type Credentials, restoreSet, type RunnerCommand } from '@agflow/core';
import { FakeAdapter, type FakeScript, type OriginRepo, originRepo } from '@agflow/testkit';
import type { VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { AttemptStore } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { type RunnerConfigInput, RunnerConfigSchema, saveRunnerConfig } from '../src/config';
import { openRunnerDb, type RunnerDb } from '../src/db';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';
import { type RunnerPaths, runnerPaths } from '../src/paths';
import { killGroup } from '../src/processes';
import { removeAgentTools } from '../src/run-dir';
import { createRunner, type RunnerEvents, type RunnerHandle } from '../src/runner';
import type { DependencyPreparer, RunnerHealth } from '../src/seams';
import { type FakeHub, type FakeHubOptions, type HelloMessage, startFakeHub } from './fake-hub';
import { FIXTURE_AGFLOW, fixtureAgentToken, fixtureCliVersion } from './fixture';

export const SETUP_TOKEN = 'cli_token_for_the_runner';
export const SETUP_PROJECT = 'demo';

const cleanups: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];

/** Undoes everything the setups made, newest first; each test file calls it after each test. */
export async function cleanupRunnerSetups(): Promise<void> {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) await cleanup();
}

/** Registers a cleanup that runs after the test. */
export function afterThisTest(cleanup: () => void | Promise<void>): void {
  cleanups.push(cleanup);
}

/** A temporary directory removed after the test. */
export function tempDir(prefix: string): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix));
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

export interface StartOptions {
  config?: Partial<RunnerConfigInput>;
  health?: RunnerHealth;
  preparer?: DependencyPreparer;
  /** The fake adapters' script; one turn that does nothing by default. */
  script?: FakeScript;
  /** The adapters, instead of a fake one per vendor. */
  adapters?: VendorAdapter[];
  events?: RunnerEvents;
}

export interface RunnerSetup {
  hub: FakeHub;
  origin: OriginRepo;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  db: RunnerDb;
  logger: ReturnType<typeof memoryLogger>;
  /** What the credentials provider gives; a test may change its token. */
  credentials: Credentials;
  /** Starts a runner on these files; closed after the test. */
  start(options?: StartOptions): Promise<RunnerHandle>;
}

/** A fake hub serving the project, an origin, and a runner home whose runner.db the test may fill first. */
export async function setupRunner(hubOptions: FakeHubOptions = {}): Promise<RunnerSetup> {
  const origin = await originRepo({ 'README.md': '# demo\n', 'src/app.ts': 'app\n' });
  cleanups.push(() => origin.remove());
  const hub = startFakeHub({ token: SETUP_TOKEN, status: { name: SETUP_PROJECT, repo: origin.path }, ...hubOptions });
  // Not waited for: Bun's server.stop(true) never settles once the hub side closed a socket, as some tests do.
  cleanups.push(() => {
    hub.stop();
  });
  const paths = runnerPaths(tempDir('agflow-runner-home-'));
  // The attempts' tools directories are read-only: they must be made writable before the home can go.
  cleanups.push(() => {
    if (!existsSync(paths.vaults)) return;
    for (const entry of readdirSync(paths.vaults).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.agent'))) {
      for (const attempt of readdirSync(join(paths.vaults, entry))) removeAgentTools(join(paths.vaults, entry, attempt));
    }
  });
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.db), { recursive: true });
  const db = openRunnerDb(paths.db);
  cleanups.push(() => db.close());
  const logger = memoryLogger();
  const credentials: Credentials = { hubUrl: hub.url, token: SETUP_TOKEN, user: 'alice' };
  // Short, as Claude's private temporary directories must be.
  const tmpRoot = mkdtempSync('/tmp/ag');
  cleanups.push(() => rmSync(tmpRoot, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const start: RunnerSetup['start'] = async (options = {}) => {
    const config = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
      runnerKey: 'rk_test_runner',
      machineId: 'MACHINE-1',
      name: 'laptop',
      test: { skipAuthChecks: true, allowShortTimings: true },
      ...options.config,
    });
    saveRunnerConfig(paths.config, config);
    const script = options.script ?? { turns: [[]] };
    const adapters =
      options.adapters ??
      (['claude', 'codex'] as const).map((vendor) => new FakeAdapter({ vendor, skipAuthChecks: true, script }));
    const runner = await createRunner({
      paths,
      config,
      db,
      credentials: () => ({ ...credentials }),
      adapters,
      agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW,
      // The darwin-arm64 pins, so the fake agents start where no CLI is pinned (CI's linux-x64).
      cliVersion: fixtureCliVersion,
      health: options.health,
      preparer: options.preparer,
      events: options.events,
      logger,
      tmpRoot,
    });
    cleanups.push(async () => {
      // Whatever agent a test left running goes before the files do.
      for (const group of new AttemptStore(db).processes()) await killGroup(group, 'SIGKILL');
      await runner.close();
    });
    return runner;
  };
  return { hub, origin, paths, db, logger, credentials, start };
}

/** A worker spec of T-4 for the setup's origin. */
export function setupSpec(s: RunnerSetup, overrides: Partial<AttemptSpec> = {}): AttemptSpec {
  const attemptId = overrides.attemptId ?? 'T-4-a1';
  return {
    attemptId,
    taskId: 'T-4',
    role: 'worker',
    vendor: 'claude',
    model: null,
    fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 1 },
    agentToken: fixtureAgentToken(attemptId),
    hubUrl: s.hub.url,
    repo: { url: s.origin.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
    start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null },
    branch: 'agflow/T-4-tidy',
    wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-4/a1',
    restore: { paths: restoreSet(null), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
    acceptanceIds: ['A1'],
    toolCaps: { defaultMs: 30 * 60_000, longMs: 90 * 60_000, checks: [] },
    taskPack: '# T-4 Tidy the app\n',
    brief: 'You are an agflow worker on T-4.',
    firstPrompt: 'Start working on T-4.',
    successor: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** The hellos the hub received, in order. */
export const hellos = (hub: FakeHub) =>
  hub.messages().filter((message): message is HelloMessage => message.t === 'hello');

/** Sends the command and waits for its result. */
export async function runCommand(hub: FakeHub, command: RunnerCommand, timeoutMs = 20_000) {
  const id = hub.command(command);
  return hub.waitFor(() => hub.results.get(id), timeoutMs);
}

export { openRunnerDb, startFakeHub };
```

```ts
// A seeded model of settings sync (design 6.3, "Settings sync"; X-12). The runner side is real: the Outbox on a
// temporary runner.db, the command executor's update_settings path, SettingsSync and config.ts, wired as the runtime
// wires them (runner.ts: the ack check, the welcome and its hub epoch, the replay filter, runner.json's version at
// start). The link is a pair of queues, and the hub a small model of M2a's rules (runners.ts, events-in.ts,
// gateway.ts, commands.ts): runner.settings applied in seq order whatever their base, each at the next version, and
// echoed verbatim; the owner's edits echoed the same way; an update_settings echo flushed before the ack of the events
// message that carried its edit; hello's version comparison (a runner it does not know: hello's settings stored at
// version 1 and echoed; equal: nothing; older: the hub's whole settings; newer: adopted, pending echoes cancelled);
// commands resent after each welcome until answered, and a failed result never; refusals acknowledged and never
// echoed; a restore from a backup, or from one taken before the runner was set up, with a new hub epoch, whose first
// welcome the runner answers with a new hello.
//
// Random steps: local edits of one field, several, or per-vendor entries; the owner's edits, some naming every field
// but not every vendor; the hub taking events; command and ack delivery, several at once, the welcome among them, so
// work held from before a hello may run before its welcome; link drops and reconnects with the replay; pauses; a long
// preflight that holds the runner's queue; crashes between an echo's mark and runner.json's write, after the write,
// before the journal's finish, inside a local edit, and at a restored hub's welcome; a write of runner.json that fails
// while the runner lives on; an echo's run, or a command's journal row, that fails while it lives on, and the retry
// timers that run it again as time passes; hand edits while the runner is down; pruning at 48 h and 14 days, by the
// runtime's Outbox or one built as M2c's retention builds it; backups and restores, while paused or busy too.
//
// Invariants: the hub never applies a runner edit again once the runner ran its echo; every runner.settings the runner
// appends carries only fields a user changed since they last went out (so no stale edit reverts a newer owner change);
// runner.json always holds the snapshot with the edits in flight laid over it; settingsEchoed stays within the outbox;
// an echo that moves the snapshot moves it to the settings the hub had at that version; on a link that stays up, every
// command it carried gets its result; at quiescence runner.json, its snapshot and the
// hub agree on every field and version, with nothing in flight and nothing unsent; and there, a field whose last change
// was the person's has that value, unless the hub refused an edit of it, a 14-day prune dropped one undelivered, or a
// restore came since.
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { RunnerSettings } from '@agflow/core';
import type { PreflightResult, VendorAdapter } from '../src/adapters/types';
import type { AttemptController } from '../src/attempt/controller';
import {
  localSettingsOf,
  type RunnerConfig,
  RunnerConfigSchema,
  type SettingsEdits,
  type SettingsValues,
  settingsAfterEdits,
} from '../src/config';
import { openRunnerDb, type RunnerDb } from '../src/db';
import { CommandExecutor } from '../src/executor';
import type { GitEnvironment } from '../src/git/run';
import type { Vault } from '../src/git/vault';
import { type CommandResult, Journal } from '../src/journal';
import type { CommandMessage } from '../src/link';
import { memoryLogger } from '../src/log';
import { isSettingsProbe, Outbox, type SettingsEvent, type StoredEvent } from '../src/outbox';

// Each run's directory goes when it ends; a run that throws leaves its own to the afterAll.
const dirs = new Set<string>();
afterAll(() => {
  for (const dir of dirs) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

/** mulberry32: a small deterministic PRNG. */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let state = seed >>> 0;
  const next = (): number => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4_294_967_296;
  };
  const int = (n: number): number => Math.floor(next() * n);
  const pick = <T>(list: readonly T[]): T => list[int(list.length)] as T;
  return { next, int, pick, chance: (p: number) => next() < p };
}
type Rng = ReturnType<typeof rng>;

// Each scalar field and each vendor's entry of the per-vendor records is a key of its own, as on both sides.
const KEYS = [
  'capacity',
  'keepAwake',
  'draining',
  'ceilings.claude',
  'ceilings.codex',
  'allowPaidUsage.claude',
  'allowPaidUsage.codex',
] as const;
type Key = (typeof KEYS)[number];
const LOW = { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.6 };
const HIGH = { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 };
const VALUES: Record<Key, readonly unknown[]> = {
  capacity: [1, 2, 3],
  keepAwake: ['off', 'ac', 'always'],
  draining: [false, true],
  'ceilings.claude': [LOW, HIGH],
  'ceilings.codex': [LOW, HIGH],
  'allowPaidUsage.claude': [false, true],
  'allowPaidUsage.codex': [false, true],
};

function valueAt(settings: SettingsEdits, key: Key): unknown {
  const [field, vendor] = key.split('.') as [keyof SettingsEdits, string | undefined];
  const value = settings[field];
  return vendor === undefined ? value : (value as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.[vendor];
}

function keysOf(settings: SettingsEdits): Key[] {
  return KEYS.filter((key) => valueAt(settings, key) !== undefined);
}

function patchOf(entries: [Key, unknown][]): SettingsEdits {
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of entries) {
    const [field, vendor] = key.split('.') as [string, string | undefined];
    if (vendor === undefined) patch[field] = structuredClone(value);
    else patch[field] = { ...(patch[field] as object | undefined), [vendor]: structuredClone(value) };
  }
  return patch as SettingsEdits;
}

/** One field, several, or per-vendor entries, with values from small sets, so equal edits come often. */
function randomPatch(r: Rng): SettingsEdits {
  const count = r.pick([1, 1, 1, 2, 3]);
  const keys = new Set<Key>();
  while (keys.size < count) keys.add(r.pick(KEYS));
  return patchOf([...keys].map((key) => [key, r.pick(VALUES[key])]));
}

/** An owner's PATCH that names every field, but in each per-vendor record one vendor only: not the whole settings. */
function everyFieldPatch(r: Rng): SettingsEdits {
  const scalars: Key[] = ['capacity', 'keepAwake', 'draining'];
  const vendors: Key[] = [
    r.pick(['ceilings.claude', 'ceilings.codex']),
    r.pick(['allowPaidUsage.claude', 'allowPaidUsage.codex']),
  ];
  return patchOf([...scalars, ...vendors].map((key) => [key, r.pick(VALUES[key])]));
}

/** Lays changes over settings as both sides do: per-vendor records vendor by vendor. */
function merged(settings: SettingsValues, changes: SettingsEdits): SettingsValues {
  const next = structuredClone(settings);
  for (const key of keysOf(changes)) {
    const [field, vendor] = key.split('.') as [keyof SettingsValues, string | undefined];
    const value = structuredClone(valueAt(changes, key));
    if (vendor === undefined) Object.assign(next, { [field]: value });
    else Object.assign(next, { [field]: { ...(next[field] as object), [vendor]: value } });
  }
  return next;
}

function valuesOf(settings: RunnerSettings): SettingsValues {
  const { version: _version, ...values } = settings;
  return values;
}

function differences(a: SettingsEdits, b: SettingsEdits): Key[] {
  return KEYS.filter((key) => !Bun.deepEquals(valueAt(a, key), valueAt(b, key)));
}

/** The process died here: nothing more of it runs. */
class Crash extends Error {}

/** runner.json's write failed, and the process lives on. */
class WriteFailure extends Error {}

const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60_000;
/**
 * A failure names its seed. MODEL_SEED runs from that one, MODEL_SEEDS sets how many run (160), and MODEL_LOG how many
 * steps of a failing run's log show (60).
 */
const FIRST_SEED = Number(process.env.MODEL_SEED ?? 1);
const SEED_COUNT = Number(process.env.MODEL_SEEDS ?? 160);
const LOG_TAIL = Number(process.env.MODEL_LOG ?? 60);

interface HubCommand {
  id: string;
  settings: SettingsEdits;
  version: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'done' | 'cancelled';
  /** The runner.settings seq it echoes; null for the owner's and hello's. */
  source: number | null;
}

/** M2a's settings rules, for one runner with one outbox epoch. */
class HubModel {
  settings: SettingsValues;
  version: number;
  acked = 0;
  epoch = 1;
  nextSeq = 1;
  commands: HubCommand[] = [];
  /** The settings at each version this hub's history holds: a restore takes the backup's, an adopted hello adds one. */
  history = new Map<number, SettingsValues>();
  /**
   * No owner edit between a restore and the runner's hello that the restored hub's welcome answers: the first one
   * after the restore, or the runner's next after that welcome (an M2a limitation, out of scope here).
   */
  awaitingHello = false;
  private backupState: string | null = null;

  constructor(
    initial: RunnerSettings,
    private readonly refuse: (event: SettingsEvent) => boolean,
    private readonly applying: (event: SettingsEvent) => void,
    private readonly refused: (event: SettingsEvent) => void,
  ) {
    this.settings = valuesOf(initial);
    this.version = initial.version;
    this.history.set(this.version, structuredClone(this.settings));
  }

  private enqueue(settings: SettingsEdits, version: number, source: number | null): void {
    this.commands.push({ id: `${this.epoch}-R-${this.nextSeq++}`, settings, version, status: 'pending', source });
  }

  /** changeSettings: the hub's version + 1, written field by field, and echoed verbatim. */
  private change(changes: SettingsEdits, source: number | null): void {
    this.version += 1;
    this.settings = merged(this.settings, changes);
    this.history.set(this.version, structuredClone(this.settings));
    this.enqueue(structuredClone(changes), this.version, source);
  }

  /**
   * applyRunnerEvents: in seq order past the acknowledged position, gaps allowed; a refusal is acknowledged all the
   * same.
   */
  receive(events: StoredEvent[]): number {
    for (const event of events) {
      if (event.seq <= this.acked) continue;
      if (event.type === 'runner.settings') {
        if (this.refuse(event)) {
          this.refused(event);
        } else {
          this.applying(event);
          this.change(event.data.settings, event.seq);
        }
      }
      this.acked = event.seq;
    }
    return this.acked;
  }

  owner(patch: SettingsEdits): void {
    this.change(patch, null);
  }

  /** reconcileHelloSettings and acknowledgePosition; lastHubEpoch is the hello's. */
  hello(reported: RunnerSettings, firstSeq: number, lastHubEpoch: number | null): number {
    this.acked = Math.max(this.acked, firstSeq - 1);
    // A runner that has had a welcome of an older epoch says hello again at this one's.
    if (lastHubEpoch === null || lastHubEpoch === this.epoch) this.awaitingHello = false;
    if (this.version === 0) {
      // A runner the hub does not know: hello's settings stored at version 1, and echoed.
      this.settings = valuesOf(reported);
      this.version = 1;
      this.history.set(1, structuredClone(this.settings));
      this.enqueue(structuredClone(this.settings), 1, null);
    } else if (reported.version > this.version) {
      this.settings = valuesOf(reported);
      this.version = reported.version;
      this.history.set(this.version, structuredClone(this.settings));
      for (const command of this.commands) if (command.status === 'pending') command.status = 'cancelled';
    } else if (reported.version < this.version) {
      this.enqueue(structuredClone(this.settings), this.version, null);
    }
    return this.acked;
  }

  pending(): HubCommand[] {
    return this.commands.filter((command) => command.status === 'pending');
  }

  answered(id: string): void {
    const command = this.commands.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
    if (command?.status === 'pending') command.status = 'done';
  }

  backup(): void {
    this.backupState = JSON.stringify({
      settings: this.settings,
      version: this.version,
      acked: this.acked,
      commands: this.commands,
      history: [...this.history],
    });
  }

  get hasBackup(): boolean {
    return this.backupState !== null;
  }

  /**
   * A restore from the backup, or (early) from one taken before the runner was set up, which knows nothing of it: a
   * new hub epoch, so new command ids never meet the backup's.
   */
  restore(early: boolean): void {
    type State = Pick<HubModel, 'settings' | 'version' | 'acked' | 'commands'> & {
      history: [number, SettingsValues][];
    };
    const unknown: State = { settings: this.settings, version: 0, acked: 0, commands: [], history: [] };
    const { history, ...state } = early ? unknown : (JSON.parse(this.backupState as string) as State);
    Object.assign(this, structuredClone(state));
    this.history = new Map(history);
    // A backup older than that one counts its versions in another history: a restore to it is the known limit of a
    // restored hub ahead of the runner (design 6.3), which this model leaves out.
    if (early) this.backupState = null;
    this.epoch += 1;
    this.nextSeq = 1;
    this.awaitingHello = true;
  }
}

type ToRunner = CommandMessage | { t: 'ack'; seq: number } | { t: 'welcome'; ackedSeq: number; hubEpoch: number };

interface Link {
  /** The welcome first, then the commands and acks, in the order the hub sent them. */
  toRunner: ToRunner[];
  toHub: StoredEvent[][];
  /** The welcome came: events go out. */
  online: boolean;
  /** The link's own: the last event sent or left out. */
  sentSeq: number;
  /** Commands sent on this link. */
  sent: Set<string>;
}

/** A retry timer the executor set; the model fires it as time passes. */
interface Timer {
  run: () => void;
  done: boolean;
}

interface Life {
  db: RunnerDb;
  outbox: Outbox;
  executor: CommandExecutor;
  /** runner.json as this process holds it. */
  config: RunnerConfig;
  dead: boolean;
  welcomed: boolean;
  recovered: boolean;
  paused: boolean;
  timers: Timer[];
}

/**
 * Where the process dies, or (failSave) where runner.json's write fails while it lives on. welcome: at a restored hub's
 * welcome, before or after its epoch is written.
 */
type CrashPoint = 'beforeSave' | 'afterSave' | 'finish' | 'change' | 'failSave' | 'welcome';

class Model {
  readonly log: string[] = [];
  readonly hub: HubModel;
  private readonly r: Rng;
  readonly dir: string;
  private readonly dbPath: string;
  private readonly logger = memoryLogger();
  private disk: RunnerConfig;
  private life: Life | null = null;
  private link: Link | null = null;
  private readonly clock = { t: 1_000_000_000 };
  private crashAt: CrashPoint | null = null;
  /** How many of the next echo runs fail while the process lives on, as SQLITE_BUSY would. */
  private echoFailures = 0;
  /** How many of the next journal rows cannot be written while the process lives on, as SQLITE_FULL would. */
  private journalFailures = 0;
  private changing = false;
  /** Keys a user changed in runner.json since they last went out as runner.settings. */
  private readonly fresh = new Set<Key>();
  private scanned = 0;
  /** Runner edits whose echo the runner ran. */
  private readonly echoRan = new Set<number>();
  /** The runner.settings last sent while the runner held an answer for them (an echo or a refusal). */
  private readonly sentAnswered = new Set<number>();
  private readonly refuseRate: number;
  private refusing = true;
  /** The value of each key whose last change was the person's, while nothing has excused its loss since. */
  private readonly lastLocal = new Map<Key, unknown>();
  /** A long preflight holding the runner's queue, until a step ends it. */
  private preflight: PromiseWithResolvers<PreflightResult> | null = null;
  private preflights = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.r = rng(seed);
    this.dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-settings-model-'));
    dirs.add(this.dir);
    this.dbPath = join(this.dir, 'runner.db');
    this.disk = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({ runnerKey: 'rk_model', machineId: 'MACHINE-1', name: 'model' });
    this.disk.confirmedSettings.version = 1;
    this.refuseRate = this.r.pick([0, 0.05, 0.15]);
    this.hub = new HubModel(
      this.disk.confirmedSettings,
      (event) =>
        this.refusing && this.r.chance(isSettingsProbe(event) ? this.refuseRate / 2 : this.refuseRate),
      (event) => {
        // Matching is by content, so an echo may answer an equal edit the hub refused, leaving its own edit in flight
        // until a probe's echo; a restore meanwhile replays that edit. That one known case aside (the runner sent it
        // holding no answer for it), no edit whose echo ran is applied again. A probe applied again changes nothing.
        if (this.echoRan.has(event.seq) && this.sentAnswered.has(event.seq) && !isSettingsProbe(event)) {
          this.fail(`the hub applied runner.settings #${event.seq} again after its echo ran`);
        }
      },
      (event) => {
        this.note(`hub refused #${event.seq}`);
        for (const key of keysOf(event.data.settings)) this.lastLocal.delete(key);
      },
    );
  }

  /** The first failure, kept: one thrown inside the runner's code (an echo's run, say) may be caught there. */
  private failure: Error | null = null;

  fail(message: string): never {
    this.failure ??= new Error(`${message}\n${this.log.slice(-LOG_TAIL).join('\n')}`);
    throw this.failure;
  }

  /** Throws the failure kept, if any. */
  private failed(): void {
    if (this.failure !== null) throw this.failure;
  }

  private note(entry: string): void {
    this.log.push(entry);
  }

  // The runner process.

  private start(): void {
    const db = openRunnerDb(this.dbPath);
    const life = { db, config: structuredClone(this.disk), dead: false, welcomed: false, recovered: false } as Life;
    life.paused = false;
    life.timers = [];
    life.outbox = new Outbox(db, {
      now: () => this.clock.t,
      confirmedVersion: () => life.config.confirmedSettings.version,
    });
    life.outbox.settingsSaved(life.config.confirmedSettings.version);
    const mark = life.outbox.markSettingsEcho.bind(life.outbox);
    life.outbox.markSettingsEcho = (...args) => {
      if (this.echoFailures > 0 && !life.dead) {
        this.echoFailures -= 1;
        this.note('an echo fails');
        throw new Error('SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked');
      }
      return mark(...args);
    };
    const journal = new Journal(db);
    const begin = journal.begin.bind(journal);
    journal.begin = (...args) => {
      if (this.journalFailures > 0 && !life.dead) {
        this.journalFailures -= 1;
        this.note(`a journal row of ${args[0]} cannot be written`);
        throw new Error('SQLITE_FULL: database or disk is full');
      }
      return begin(...args);
    };
    const finish = journal.finish.bind(journal);
    journal.finish = (commandId: string, result: CommandResult) => {
      if (this.crashAt === 'finish' && !life.dead) this.crash(life, 'at the journal finish');
      if (life.dead) throw new Crash('dead');
      finish(commandId, result);
    };
    const unused = () => {
      throw new Error('not in this model');
    };
    life.executor = new CommandExecutor({
      journal,
      controller: unused as unknown as (attemptId: string) => AttemptController,
      known: () => false,
      config: () => life.config,
      saveConfig: (config) => this.save(life, config),
      outbox: life.outbox,
      vault: {} as Vault,
      local: {} as GitEnvironment,
      remote: unused as unknown as () => Promise<GitEnvironment>,
      wipRefPrefix: () => 'refs/agflow/',
      // A preflight holds the runner's queue while a step's long one runs; one run again after a restart does not.
      adapters: new Map([
        [
          'claude',
          {
            vendor: 'claude',
            preflight: () => this.preflight?.promise ?? Promise.resolve({} as PreflightResult),
          } as unknown as VendorAdapter,
        ],
      ]),
      vendors: () => ({ vendors: [], quota: [] }),
      logger: this.logger,
      // Fired as the model's time passes (fireTimers); a dead process's never are.
      timers: {
        setTimeout: (run: () => void) => {
          const timer: Timer = { run, done: false };
          life.timers.push(timer);
          return timer;
        },
        clearTimeout: (handle: unknown) => {
          (handle as Timer).done = true;
        },
      },
    });
    // The log notes each echo run, with what it left in flight. An echo that moves the snapshot moves it to the
    // settings this hub had at that version.
    const echo = life.executor.settings.echo.bind(life.executor.settings);
    life.executor.settings.echo = (update, arrivedAfter) => {
      const before = structuredClone(life.config.confirmedSettings);
      const answered = echo(update, arrivedAfter);
      const open = life.outbox.settingsInFlight().map((event) => event.seq);
      const snapshot = life.config.confirmedSettings;
      const ran = `ran v${update.version}${answered ? '' : ', unanswered'}`;
      this.note(`${ran}: snapshot v${snapshot.version}, in flight ${open}`);
      if (!Bun.deepEquals(snapshot, before)) {
        const hub = this.hub.history.get(snapshot.version);
        const off = hub === undefined ? ['every field'] : differences(valuesOf(snapshot), hub);
        if (off.length > 0) {
          this.fail(`the snapshot at v${snapshot.version} differs from the hub's in ${off.join(', ')}`);
        }
      }
      return answered;
    };
    // runner.ts: each ack checks the settings edits in flight.
    life.outbox.onAck(() => this.track(life.executor.settingsAcknowledged({ welcome: false })));
    this.life = life;
    this.note('start');
  }

  /**
   * runner.ts's saveConfig, with the crash points around runner.json's write: the process holds the new settings
   * first, then writes them, which may fail while it lives on.
   */
  private save(life: Life, config: RunnerConfig): void {
    if (life.dead) throw new Crash('dead');
    const point = this.crashAt;
    if (!this.changing && point === 'beforeSave') this.crash(life, 'between the mark and runner.json');
    life.config = config;
    if (point === 'failSave') {
      this.crashAt = null;
      this.note('runner.json cannot be written');
      throw new WriteFailure('ENOSPC');
    }
    this.disk = structuredClone(RunnerConfigSchema.parse(structuredClone(config)));
    if ((!this.changing && point === 'afterSave') || (this.changing && point === 'change')) {
      this.crash(life, this.changing ? 'between a local edit and its event' : 'after runner.json');
    }
  }

  private crash(life: Life, where: string): never {
    this.die(life, `crash ${where}`);
    throw new Crash(where);
  }

  private die(life: Life, why: string): void {
    if (life.dead) return;
    life.dead = true;
    this.crashAt = null;
    // A preflight the dead process waited on never ends for it.
    this.preflight = null;
    life.db.close();
    this.link = null;
    this.note(why);
  }

  private track(promise: Promise<unknown>): void {
    promise.catch(() => {});
  }

  private alive(): Life | null {
    return this.life !== null && !this.life.dead ? this.life : null;
  }

  // The link.

  /**
   * hello, as the runtime builds it, and the gateway's attach: the hub reconciles the hello at once and sends the
   * welcome, then the pending commands. The runner reads the welcome later, as deliverToRunner gets to it; work held
   * from before the hello may run meanwhile.
   */
  private connect(life: Life): void {
    life.executor.helloSent();
    const reported = life.config.confirmedSettings;
    const ackedSeq = this.hub.hello(reported, life.outbox.firstSeq(), life.db.meta('lastHubEpoch'));
    const welcome: ToRunner = { t: 'welcome', ackedSeq, hubEpoch: this.hub.epoch };
    const link: Link = { toRunner: [welcome], toHub: [], online: false, sentSeq: ackedSeq, sent: new Set() };
    this.link = link;
    this.note(`hello v${reported.version}: hub v${this.hub.version}, acked ${ackedSeq}`);
    this.flush();
  }

  /**
   * The runtime's welcomed, as the link runs it. A restored hub's first welcome: what the outbox holds is recorded,
   * then the hub's epoch, and the runner says hello again at once (LinkClient.reconnectNow).
   */
  private welcomed(life: Life, link: Link, welcome: { ackedSeq: number; hubEpoch: number }): void {
    const { ackedSeq, hubEpoch } = welcome;
    this.note(`welcome acked ${ackedSeq}, epoch ${hubEpoch}, runner v${life.config.confirmedSettings.version}`);
    life.outbox.ack(life.outbox.epoch, ackedSeq);
    const lastHubEpoch = life.db.meta('lastHubEpoch');
    if (lastHubEpoch !== null && lastHubEpoch !== hubEpoch) {
      life.outbox.hubRestored();
      if (this.crashAt === 'welcome' && this.r.chance(0.5)) this.crash(life, 'at a restored welcome, before its epoch');
      life.db.setMeta('lastHubEpoch', hubEpoch);
      if (this.crashAt === 'welcome') this.crash(life, 'at a restored welcome, after its epoch');
      this.note('a restored hub: hello again');
      this.link = null;
      this.connect(life);
      return;
    }
    link.online = true;
    life.db.setMeta('lastHubEpoch', hubEpoch);
    void life.executor.onWelcome({ stop: [] });
    if (!life.recovered) {
      life.recovered = true;
      this.track(life.executor.recover());
    }
    life.executor.settings.welcomed({ ackedSeq });
    this.track(life.executor.settingsAcknowledged({ welcome: true }));
    life.welcomed = true;
    this.scan();
    this.fresh.clear();
    this.pump();
  }

  /** link.ts's pump, with the runtime's replay filter. */
  private pump(): void {
    const life = this.alive();
    const link = this.link;
    if (life === null || link === null || !link.online) return;
    const events: StoredEvent[] = [];
    let through = link.sentSeq;
    const open = new Set(life.outbox.settingsInFlight().map((event) => event.seq));
    for (const event of life.outbox.eventsAfter(link.sentSeq)) {
      through = event.seq;
      if (life.executor.settings.resent(event)) continue;
      events.push(event);
      if (event.type !== 'runner.settings') continue;
      if (open.has(event.seq)) this.sentAnswered.delete(event.seq);
      else this.sentAnswered.add(event.seq);
    }
    if (events.length > 0) link.toHub.push(events);
    link.sentSeq = through;
  }

  /** The gateway's flush: the pending commands this link has not had, in order. */
  private flush(): void {
    const link = this.link;
    if (link === null) return;
    for (const command of this.hub.pending()) {
      if (link.sent.has(command.id)) continue;
      link.sent.add(command.id);
      const message: CommandMessage = {
        t: 'command',
        id: command.id,
        seq: Number(command.id.split('-').at(-1)),
        command: { kind: 'update_settings', settings: command.settings, version: command.version },
      };
      link.toRunner.push(message);
    }
  }

  private deliverToHub(): void {
    const link = this.link;
    const batch = link?.toHub.shift();
    if (link === null || batch === undefined) return;
    const acked = this.hub.receive(batch);
    this.note(`hub took ${batch.map((event) => event.seq).join(',')}: v${this.hub.version}, acked ${acked}`);
    // The echoes of the edits it applied go out before the ack.
    this.flush();
    link.toRunner.push({ t: 'ack', seq: acked });
  }

  private deliverToRunner(count: number): void {
    const life = this.alive();
    const link = this.link;
    if (life === null || link === null) return;
    for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
      // A connection the runner replaced (a restored hub's welcome) has nothing more to say.
      if (this.link !== link) return;
      const message = link.toRunner.shift();
      if (message === undefined) return;
      if (message.t === 'ack') {
        life.outbox.ack(life.outbox.epoch, message.seq);
        continue;
      }
      if (message.t === 'welcome') {
        this.welcomed(life, link, message);
        continue;
      }
      const command = this.hub.commands.find((entry) => entry.id === message.id) as HubCommand;
      this.note(`echo ${message.id} v${command.version} ${JSON.stringify(command.settings)}`);
      // As LinkClient.runCommand: a throw or a rejection answers ok false, which the hub records and never resends.
      let result: Promise<CommandResult | null>;
      try {
        result = life.executor.onCommand(message);
      } catch (error) {
        result = Promise.reject(error);
      }
      this.track(
        result
          .catch((error): CommandResult => {
            if (error instanceof Crash || life.dead) throw error;
            this.note(`echo ${message.id} failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);
            return { ok: false, error: (error as Error).message };
          })
          .then((answer) => {
            // No answer: the hub sends it again after the next welcome.
            if (life.dead || answer === null) return;
            if (answer.ok && command.source !== null) this.echoRan.add(command.source);
            if (this.link === link) this.hub.answered(message.id);
          }),
      );
    }
  }

  /** Time passes: the retry timers the executor set run. */
  private fireTimers(life: Life | null): void {
    if (life === null) return;
    for (const timer of life.timers.splice(0)) {
      if (timer.done) continue;
      timer.done = true;
      this.note('a retry timer fires');
      timer.run();
    }
  }

  // Checks.

  /** Every runner.settings appended since the last scan names only keys a user changed since they last went out. */
  private scan(): void {
    const life = this.alive();
    if (life === null) return;
    for (const event of life.outbox.eventsAfter(this.scanned)) {
      this.scanned = event.seq;
      if (event.type !== 'runner.settings') continue;
      this.note(`sent #${event.seq} ${JSON.stringify(event.data.settings)}`);
      for (const key of keysOf(event.data.settings)) {
        if (!this.fresh.has(key)) this.fail(`runner.settings #${event.seq} sent ${key} again, with no user change`);
        this.fresh.delete(key);
      }
    }
  }

  /** runner.json holds the snapshot with the edits in flight laid over it. */
  private checkView(): void {
    const life = this.alive();
    if (life === null || !life.welcomed) return;
    const local = localSettingsOf(life.config);
    const view = valuesOf(life.executor.settings.view(life.config));
    const off = differences(local, view);
    if (off.length > 0) this.fail(`runner.json differs from the view in ${off.join(', ')}`);
  }

  private checkMarks(life: Life): void {
    const settings = life.outbox.eventsAfter(0).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings');
    const kept = new Set(settings.map((event) => event.seq));
    const marks = life.db.meta('settingsEchoed') ?? [];
    if (marks.some((mark) => !kept.has(mark.seq))) this.fail('a mark outlived its event');
    if (marks.length > kept.size) this.fail('more marks than settings events');
  }

  /** Lets the runner's queued work run: all of it is synchronous SQLite and promises, with no timers. */
  private async settle(): Promise<void> {
    for (let round = 0; round < 3; round += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
  }

  // Steps.

  begin(): void {
    this.start();
    this.connect(this.alive() as Life);
  }

  async step(): Promise<void> {
    const r = this.r;
    const life = this.alive();
    const roll = r.int(100);
    try {
      if (roll < 14) {
        if (life === null) return;
        const patch = randomPatch(r);
        const before = localSettingsOf(life.config);
        const view = valuesOf(life.executor.settings.view(life.config));
        this.note(`local edit ${JSON.stringify(patch)}`);
        this.changing = true;
        try {
          life.executor.settings.change(patch);
        } catch (error) {
          // A failed write makes no edit.
          if (!(error instanceof WriteFailure)) throw error;
          const off = differences(before, localSettingsOf(life.config));
          if (off.length > 0) this.fail(`a local edit whose write failed changed ${off.join(', ')}`);
        } finally {
          // The settings the runner holds, which a crash inside the edit leaves in runner.json: the next welcome sends
          // the fields where they differ from the view, and a field back at its view's value is no change it can tell.
          this.changing = false;
          const after = localSettingsOf(life.config);
          for (const key of differences(before, after)) {
            this.fresh.add(key);
            if (life.dead && Bun.deepEquals(valueAt(after, key), valueAt(view, key))) this.lastLocal.delete(key);
            else this.lastLocal.set(key, valueAt(after, key));
          }
        }
      } else if (roll < 24) {
        if (this.hub.awaitingHello) return;
        const patch = r.chance(0.35) ? everyFieldPatch(r) : randomPatch(r);
        this.note(`owner edit ${JSON.stringify(patch)}`);
        this.hub.owner(patch);
        for (const key of keysOf(patch)) this.lastLocal.delete(key);
        this.flush();
      } else if (roll < 38) {
        this.deliverToHub();
      } else if (roll < 55) {
        this.deliverToRunner(1 + r.int(4));
      } else if (roll < 58) {
        if (this.link !== null) this.note('link drops');
        this.link = null;
      } else if (roll < 64) {
        if (life !== null && this.link === null) this.connect(life);
      } else if (roll < 67) {
        if (life === null) return;
        if (r.chance(0.3)) this.die(life, 'stop');
        else this.crashAt = r.pick(['beforeSave', 'afterSave', 'finish', 'change', 'failSave', 'welcome'] as const);
      } else if (roll < 73) {
        if (life !== null) return;
        if (r.chance(0.5)) this.handEdit();
        this.start();
      } else if (roll < 76) {
        if (life === null) return;
        if (life.paused) life.executor.resume();
        else life.executor.pause();
        life.paused = !life.paused;
        this.note(life.paused ? 'pause' : 'resume');
      } else if (roll < 79) {
        this.preflightStep(life);
      } else if (roll < 84) {
        this.clock.t += r.pick([1_000, 60_000, 6 * 60 * 60_000, DAY, 5 * DAY]);
        this.fireTimers(life);
      } else if (roll < 87) {
        this.echoFailures += r.pick([1, 1, 2]);
      } else if (roll < 89) {
        this.journalFailures += r.pick([1, 1, 2]);
      } else if (roll < 92) {
        if (life === null) return;
        this.prune(life);
      } else if (roll < 95) {
        this.hub.backup();
        this.note('backup');
      } else {
        const early = !this.hub.hasBackup || r.chance(0.25);
        this.note(early ? 'hub restored from before the runner was set up' : 'hub restored');
        this.hub.restore(early);
        // A restore may lose what the person changed last (design 6.3); runner and hub must still agree.
        this.lastLocal.clear();
        this.link = null;
        if (life !== null) this.connect(life);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error;
    } finally {
      await this.settle();
      this.failed();
      this.scan();
      this.pump();
      this.checkView();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Edits runner.json while the runner is down. The next welcome sends the fields where it differs from the view the
   * runner reads at start; a field edited back to that view's value is no change it can tell.
   */
  private handEdit(): void {
    const patch = randomPatch(this.r);
    const before = localSettingsOf(this.disk);
    this.disk = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({ ...structuredClone(this.disk), ...merged(before, patch) });
    const disk = localSettingsOf(this.disk);
    const db = openRunnerDb(this.dbPath);
    let view: SettingsValues;
    try {
      const outbox = new Outbox(db, { confirmedVersion: () => this.disk.confirmedSettings.version });
      const edits = outbox.settingsInFlight().map((event) => event.data.settings);
      view = valuesOf(settingsAfterEdits(this.disk.confirmedSettings, edits));
    } finally {
      db.close();
    }
    for (const key of differences(before, disk)) {
      this.fresh.add(key);
      if (Bun.deepEquals(valueAt(disk, key), valueAt(view, key))) this.lastLocal.delete(key);
      else this.lastLocal.set(key, valueAt(disk, key));
    }
    this.note(`hand edit ${JSON.stringify(patch)}`);
  }

  /** A long preflight starts, holding the runner's queue, or the one running ends. */
  private preflightStep(life: Life | null): void {
    if (this.preflight !== null) {
      this.note('preflight ends');
      this.preflight.resolve({} as PreflightResult);
      this.preflight = null;
      return;
    }
    if (life === null) return;
    this.preflight = Promise.withResolvers<PreflightResult>();
    this.preflights += 1;
    this.note('preflight starts');
    const message: CommandMessage = {
      t: 'command',
      id: `P-${this.preflights}`,
      seq: 0,
      command: { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' },
    };
    this.track(life.executor.onCommand(message));
  }

  /**
   * M2c's retention: pruneAcked at 48 h or pruneBefore at 14 days, by the runtime's Outbox or by one built without
   * confirmedVersion, as M2c's host builds it. pruneBefore drops undelivered events too: the person's change one of
   * them carried may be lost.
   */
  private prune(life: Life): void {
    const outbox = this.r.chance(0.5) ? life.outbox : new Outbox(life.db, { now: () => this.clock.t });
    const acked = life.outbox.ackedSeq();
    const undelivered = life.outbox.eventsAfter(acked);
    const pruned = this.r.chance(0.5) ? outbox.pruneAcked(2 * DAY) : outbox.pruneBefore(this.clock.t - 14 * DAY);
    if (pruned > 0) this.note(`pruned ${pruned}${outbox === life.outbox ? '' : ' (retention)'}`);
    const kept = new Set(life.outbox.eventsAfter(acked).map((event) => event.seq));
    for (const event of undelivered) {
      if (kept.has(event.seq) || event.type !== 'runner.settings') continue;
      this.note(`pruned #${event.seq} undelivered`);
      for (const key of keysOf(event.data.settings)) this.lastLocal.delete(key);
    }
    this.checkMarks(life);
  }

  /** Everything delivered, no refusal, no new edit: then runner.json, its snapshot and the hub agree. */
  async quiesce(): Promise<void> {
    this.refusing = false;
    this.crashAt = null;
    this.echoFailures = 0;
    this.journalFailures = 0;
    let life = this.alive();
    if (life === null) {
      this.start();
      life = this.alive() as Life;
    }
    if (life.paused) {
      life.executor.resume();
      life.paused = false;
    }
    this.preflight?.resolve({} as PreflightResult);
    this.preflight = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
      if (this.link === null) this.connect(life);
      let link = this.link as Link;
      for (let round = 0; round < 200; round += 1) {
        await this.settle();
        this.failed();
        // A restored hub's welcome makes the runner say hello again: the new link goes on.
        if (this.link !== null) link = this.link;
        this.scan();
        this.pump();
        this.checkView();
        const timers = life.timers.some((timer) => !timer.done);
        if (link.toHub.length === 0 && link.toRunner.length === 0 && !timers) break;
        this.deliverToHub();
        this.deliverToRunner(link.toRunner.length);
        this.fireTimers(life);
      }
      await this.settle();
      this.failed();
      // A link that stays up needs no reconnect for its commands: each one it carried got its result.
      const stalled = this.hub.pending().filter((command) => link.sent.has(command.id));
      if (stalled.length > 0) {
        const ids = stalled.map((command) => command.id).join(', ');
        this.fail(`commands left unanswered on a link that stayed up: ${ids}`);
      }
      // An edit the hub acknowledged that no echo answered gets a probe at a welcome; a command left unanswered is
      // sent again after one.
      const acked = life.outbox.ackedSeq();
      const waiting = life.outbox.settingsUnanswered().some((event) => !isSettingsProbe(event) && event.seq <= acked);
      if (!waiting && this.hub.pending().length === 0) break;
      this.note('reconnect to settle');
      this.link = null;
    }
    if (this.hub.pending().length > 0) {
      this.fail(`commands never answered: ${this.hub.pending().map((command) => command.id).join(', ')}`);
    }
    const unanswered = life.outbox.settingsUnanswered().filter((event) => !isSettingsProbe(event));
    if (unanswered.length > 0) this.fail(`edits still unanswered: ${unanswered.map((event) => event.seq).join(',')}`);
    // Every event went out, but those the replay leaves out, whose answer the snapshot holds.
    const unacked = life.outbox.eventsAfter(life.outbox.ackedSeq());
    const unsent = unacked.filter((event) => !life.executor.settings.resent(event));
    if (unsent.length > 0) this.fail(`events never acknowledged: ${unsent.map((event) => event.seq).join(',')}`);
    const local = localSettingsOf(life.config);
    const snapshot = life.config.confirmedSettings;
    const off = [
      ...differences(local, valuesOf(snapshot)).map((key) => `runner.json/snapshot ${key}`),
      ...differences(valuesOf(snapshot), this.hub.settings).map((key) => `snapshot/hub ${key}`),
    ];
    if (off.length > 0) this.fail(`at quiescence they differ: ${off.join(', ')}`);
    if (snapshot.version !== this.hub.version) this.fail(`snapshot v${snapshot.version}, hub v${this.hub.version}`);
    if (this.fresh.size > 0) this.fail(`changes never sent: ${[...this.fresh].join(', ')}`);
    const lost = [...this.lastLocal].filter(([key, value]) => !Bun.deepEquals(valueAt(this.hub.settings, key), value));
    if (lost.length > 0) this.fail(`the person's last change of ${lost.map(([key]) => key).join(', ')} was lost`);
    this.checkMarks(life);
    // With nothing in flight, retention keeps no runner.settings, a probe the hub refused included; but the edits
    // whose echo runner.json, after a failed write, has not taken yet.
    this.clock.t += 3 * DAY;
    new Outbox(life.db, { now: () => this.clock.t }).pruneAcked(2 * DAY);
    const saved = life.db.meta('settingsSavedVersion') ?? 0;
    const marks = life.db.meta('settingsEchoed') ?? [];
    const unsaved = new Set(marks.flatMap((mark) => (mark.version > saved ? [mark.seq] : [])));
    const left = life.outbox
      .eventsAfter(0)
      .filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.settings' && (isSettingsProbe(event) || !unsaved.has(event.seq)));
    if (left.length > 0) this.fail(`retention kept runner.settings ${left.map((event) => event.seq).join(',')}`);
    this.die(life, 'end');
  }
}

describe('settings sync model', () => {
  test('random runs keep the invariants and end with runner.json, its snapshot and the hub in agreement', async () => {
    const SEEDS = FIRST_SEED - 1 + SEED_COUNT;
    const STEPS = 140;
    for (let seed = FIRST_SEED; seed <= SEEDS; seed += 1) {
      const model = new Model(seed);
      try {
        model.begin();
        for (let step = 0; step < STEPS; step += 1) await model.step();
        await model.quiesce();
      } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(`seed ${seed}: ${(error as Error).message}`);
      }
      rmSync(model.dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      dirs.delete(model.dir);
    }
    expect(true).toBe(true);
  }, Math.max(60_000, SEED_COUNT * 200));
});
```

```diff
+
+/**
+ * A local edit (drain, undrain, the crash-loop self-drain): runner.json takes the patch, and changed holds the fields,
+ * and of the per-vendor records the vendors, whose value it changed; runner.settings sends those. An empty changed
+ * means the patch changed nothing.
+ */
+export function editLocalSettings(
+  config: RunnerConfig,
+  patch: SettingsEdits,
+): { config: RunnerConfig; changed: SettingsEdits } {
+  const changed: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+  const next: RunnerConfig = structuredClone(config);
+  for (const field of SCALAR_FIELDS) {
+    const value = patch[field];
+    if (value !== undefined && value !== config[field]) {
+      changed[field] = value;
+      Object.assign(next, { [field]: value });
+    }
+  }
+  for (const field of VENDOR_FIELDS) {
+    const given: Partial<Record<Vendor, unknown>> = patch[field] ?? {};
+    const vendors = VENDORS.filter(
+      (vendor) => given[vendor] !== undefined && !Bun.deepEquals(given[vendor], config[field][vendor]),
+    );
+    if (vendors.length === 0) continue;
+    const values = Object.fromEntries(vendors.map((vendor) => [vendor, structuredClone(given[vendor])]));
+    changed[field] = values;
+    Object.assign(next, { [field]: { ...next[field], ...values } });
+  }
+  return { config: next, changed: changed as SettingsEdits };
+}
+
 /**
  * The snapshot with runner.settings edits laid over it in order: what the hub holds once it has applied them. Of the
  * per-vendor records an edit replaces only the vendors it names.
```

```diff
+   * A local edit (drain, undrain, the crash-loop self-drain): runner.json takes the patch, and the fields it changed
+   * go out as runner.settings on the confirmed snapshot's version. runner.json holds the view, so an edit back to the
+   * value an older edit in flight changed is a change, and is sent. Gives that event's seq, or null when the patch
+   * changed nothing. When runner.json cannot be written, or the runner.settings cannot be stored, nothing changes and
+   * the error is thrown.
+   */
+  change(patch: SettingsEdits): number | null {
+    const current = this.options.config();
+    const { config, changed } = editLocalSettings(current, RunnerSettingsChangesSchema.parse(patch));
+    if (Object.keys(changed).length === 0) return null;
+    try {
+      this.options.saveConfig(config);
+    } catch (error) {

+      throw error;

+      this.options.saveConfig(current);

+      this.options.logger.warn('cannot write runner.json back after a failed edit', { error: describe(error) });
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/runner-handle.test.ts packages/runner/test/settings-model.test.ts packages/runner/test/config.test.ts packages/runner/test/executor.test.ts packages/runner/test/runner.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass; then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

`pause()` holds a command before it is journaled, so a held command is neither journaled nor run. `changeSettings` checks the patch with core's `RunnerSettingsChangesSchema` and resolves null when nothing changed. It compares the patch with runner.json, which holds the view (the snapshot with the edits in flight laid over it, by Task 35's rule and the answers in the runner.db meta key `settingsEchoed`), so an edit back to the value an older edit in flight changed is sent. A failed note of `settingsSavedVersion` is logged and does not fail the edit. `AttemptStatus.lateWorkSha` shows work not yet on the origin. A restored hub's first welcome is not reported through `RunnerEvents.welcome`: the runner says hello again before it handles that welcome (Task 37). With the settings sync, a drain made while the runner was down and an owner's change made meanwhile both survive, and the drain is sent once. `settings-model.test.ts` runs 160 seeds of 140 steps (about 4 s) of the real Outbox, Journal, CommandExecutor and SettingsSync on a temporary runner.db, against a model of M2a's settings rules with link drops, pauses, crashes, write and journal failures, retention, backups and restores; `MODEL_SEED`, `MODEL_SEEDS` and `MODEL_LOG` reproduce a run. The pushWipNow test waits past `wipGraceMs` after the welcome before it checks a held push. The write-failure tests inject SQLite failures for `wipRefPrefix`, `lastHubEpoch`, the outbox ack and `restoredThrough`. They check continued command handling after ordinary write failures, and an unrecorded epoch plus no replay until restore bookkeeping succeeds after backoff.

The restore/replay test gates the fake hub's acknowledgements and subscribes through RunnerHandle.waitAcked before releasing each probe ack; assert snapshot, replay, sequence and connection count. The three-failed-WIP-pushes hello test uses RunnerHandle.pushWipNow: leave the fake idle after its first turn, remove origin, release and await the writing turn, await three failed pushes with failure counts [1,2,3], reconnect only then, keep the git.ready/problem assertions, restore origin and stop the fake agent in finally.
